resources.string: Ithuluzi lokusebenzisana nomsebenzisi, ukuzulazula, i-DataStore, i-CameraX kanye nokugcwalisa ngokuzenzakalelayo
Ilulayisha izithombe kumaphaneli e-GIF, isitikha kanye nokusesha
Izinhlobo zefonti zekhibhodi, uhlelo oluzilanda uma uzidinga
Amakhodi amafushane e-emoji, amagama :tada: asetshenziswa yi-GitHub, Discord ne-Slack
Ihlola uhlelo lolimi nesitayela ungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi (ilabhulali yomdabu)
Amagridi okhiye ezakhiwo ezingama-862, ikakhulukazi izilimi ezingekho kwenye ikhibhodi
Isikhathi sokusebenza kolimi, ukusebenzisana kanye nokulandelana kwezilungiselelo
Isebenzisa inkulumo ye-Whisper engaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi ukuya embhalweni kudivayisi yakho
Umhumushi we-Lua osebenzisa ama-plugin endaweni yawo evikelekile
Ifunda ukubhala ngesandla, iskena umbhalo namabhakhodi, iskena imibhalo, futhi isusa ingemuva esitikeni
Imephu phakathi kwezinhlamvu ezilula nezendabuko, kanye nesilulumagama sase-Taiwan nase-Hong Kong
Izindikimba ezikuhlelo lokusebenza: Dracula, Nord, Solarized, Catppuccin kanye ne-Tokyo Night
Inikeza inguqulo entsha yalolu hlelo lokusebenza, futhi iyilanda (izakhiwo ze-Play Store kuphela)
Imitapo yolwazi (libraries) ethembele kumtapo wolwazi wohlelo lolimi
Izinhlobo zezinhlamvu zalolu hlelo lokusebenza: Manrope ezihlokweni, Inter embhalweni
Ikhathalogu ye-emoji, amagama, amagama angukhiye kanye nokulandelana kwethoni yesikhumba
Inkomba ye-mel spectrogram kanye ne-tokenizer port
Imodeli yokuqaphela inkulumo, ezinhlobonhlobo ze-TFLite ezisebenza kudivayisi yakho
Uhlelo lokusebenza lulanda amaphakethe edatha kusuka endaweni yokugcina idatha ye-WM Keyboard uma uwadinga. Iphakethe ngalinye ligcina ilayisensi yomthombo walo, noma ngabe uyifaka noma cha.
Irekhodi lalokho okwenziwe ikhibhodi. Lifunde, noma ulithumele nombiko wephutha

Ama-bigram embewu, imephu yamagama abolekiwe kanye nohlu lwamagama anenhlamba kwenziwe ngesandla kule phrojekthi, futhi asebenzisa ilayisensi yayo. Izinhlu zamagama ozilanda zigcina izilayisensi zemithombo yazo. Isikrini sezilayisensi zomthombo ovulekile sinikeza uhlu oluphelele.

Inkinga iyisinqumo sokuqala esingcono. Omunye umuntu angaba nenkinga efanayo. I-imeyili nayo ilungile uma umbiko wakho uyimfihlo. Kuzo zombili izimo, thumela umbhalo we-Diagnostics ongenhla nombiko wakho. Usho ukuthi yiluphi uhlobo nokuthi iyiphi idivayisi lena, futhi awuqukethe umbhalo owuthayiphile.
I-WM Keyboard iyisoftware yamahhala. Ungayisebenzisa, uyishintshe futhi uyinikeze abanye abantu. Kufanele ugcine isaziso se-copyright nombhalo welayisensi nayo.

Lokhu kushintsha kuphela igama elingaphansi kwesithonjana, kudrowa yakho yezinhlelo zokusebenza nasesikrinini sasekhaya. Kuyo yonke indawo, njengezilungiselelo zohlelo lokusebenza lwe-Android, uhlu lwekhibhodi nezitolo zezinhlelo zokusebenza, uhlelo lokusebenza lugcina igama lalo eligcwele. Uma uvule uhlelo lokusebenza kusuka kusithonjana salo, lesi sikrini sivuleka futhi uma ushintsha igama. Isiqalisi sakho singathatha imizuzwana embalwa ukukhombisa igama elisha. Uma isithonjana siphuma esikrinini sasekhaya, sengeze futhi kusuka kudrowa yezinhlelo zokusebenza.
Bonisa \"WMK\" ngaphansi kwesithonjana sohlelo lokusebenza, hhayi \"WM Keyboard\"
Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazi ukufunda lo mbhalo welayisensi.

Lesi sikrini sibala izingxenye ezingaphakathi kwale yakhiwo kanye nedatha uhlelo lokusebenza olungayilanda. Cindezela umugqa ukuze ufunde umbhalo wawo ogcwele welayisensi. Umugqa ongenambhalo welayisensi kuhlelo lokusebenza uvula imigomo yomhlinzeki.
Imitapo yolwazi nedatha engaphakathi kwalokhu okwakhiwe
Idivayisi yakho ayinayo uhlelo lokusebenza lwe-imeyili. Bhala ku-%1$s esikhundleni salokho.
I-emoji enyakazayo ethunyelwa ngokucindezela nokubamba, evela ku-Noto Animated Emoji
Uhlu lwamagama olukhethiwe lwezilimi ezingama-23 olusetshenziswa ikhibhodi ye-Android uqobo, olukhethwayo lapho ulimi lunalo
Isisusi sangemuva somhleli wezitika, esisetshenziswa lapho i-Google Play services ingakwazi ukunikeza esisodwa
Amagama angukhiye okusesha ama-emoji ngezilimi eziyi-141, avela ku-kemoji ye-KDE
Amamodeli e-AI akudivayisi akukhathalogu. Umugqa ngamunye wemodeli ubala ilayisensi yawo; I-Gemma 3 inemigomo yakwa-Google, eminye i-Apache-2.0
Isichazamazwi sokuguqula i-kana yaseJapane ibe yi-kanji (dictionary_oss)
Izinhlu zokuhlunga ozikhethela zona zeziphakamiso ezilimini ozilanda
Izinhlu zamagama okubikezela zezilimi ezingaphezu kuka-300, ezivela ku-FrequencyWords (OpenSubtitles), Leipzig Corpora, Wikimedia, wordfreq nabanye
Izimpendulo zakho kusukela ekusethweni. Zisanquma ukuthi ikhibhodi ikubonisa malini
Yini eshiya idivayisi yakho, nokuthi yini engalokothi iyishiye
Hamba phinda izinqumo zokuqala. Izilungiselelo zakho zizohlala zinjalo.
Vula inkinga ku-GitHub. Izinkinga zisobala, kulula ukuzisesha futhi kulula ukuzilandelela
Ithuluzi elisebenzisa isevisi eku-inthanethi kuphela elixhumana nayo, futhi lokho kwenzeka kuphela uma uvula lelo thuluzi. Uhlelo lokusebenza aluqukethe ikhodi evela kulezo zinsiza.
Zama i-WM Keyboard, uhlelo lokusebenza lwekhibhodi oluhle kakhulu!
Bona ukuthi uhlelo lokusebenza lugcina ini kudivayisi yakho, bese ulususa
Ikhibhodi yenza imigqa yamalebula okhiye ibe mnyama. Sebenzisa lokhu ngokhiye abagqamile esikrinini esincane, noma esikrinini esinokukhanya okuphansi.

Lesi silungiselelo sishintsha imibala yekhibhodi. Imibala ebukeka ifana kuwe iba ehlukile. Khetha uhlobo oluvumelana nombono wakho. I-Deuteranopia ne-protanopia yizinhlobo ezimbili ezibomvu-eziluhlaza. I-Deuteranopia iyona evame kakhulu. I-Tritanopia yuhlobo oluluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka-ophuzi. Okumpunga kususa yonke imibala. Lesi silungiselelo silungisa imibala. Asiyilingisi. Asikukhombisi lokho umuntu onobumpumputhe bemibala akubonayo. Kwenza ikhibhodi ibe lula ukuthi uyifunde.
Shintsha imibala yekhibhodi ngenxa yokungaboni kahle kwemibala

Lesi silungiselelo esokuthuthumela kwezandla noma ukuqina kwemisipha. Ngemva kokuba ukhiye ubhalisile, ikhibhodi ilahla ukucindezelwa kwesibili kwalowo khiye phakathi nalesi sikhathi. Ukucindezela okukodwa okufunayo akuphenduki izinhlamvu ezimbili. Ikhibhodi ihlunga ukuphindwa kokhiye ofanayo kuphela. Ungahlala uthayipha okhiye ababili abahlukene ngokushesha. Khulisa isikhathi kuze kube yilapho izinhlamvu eziphindwe kabili ziyeka. Uma isikhathi side kakhulu, ikhibhodi iphinde ilahle izinhlamvu eziphindwe kabili ozifunayo, isibonelo \"ll\" kanye \"ee\".
Ikhibhodi ayinaki ukucindezelwa kwesibili kokhiye ofanayo ngalesi sikhathi
Ngenkathi i-TalkBack isebenza, ukuthinta kwayo kuthatha indawo yokuswayipha kwebha yesikhala kanye nokucindezela nokubamba okuhlukile kwekhibhodi.
Qinisekisa ukucindezela kokhiye ngamunye ngokudlidliza noma ngomsindo

Ikhibhodi ithatha indawo yemibala yokhiye nemibala yebhodi yengqikithi ngemibala ephezulu ehlukile (high contrast). Wonke amalebula aba mnyama qwembe noma amhlophe qwembe. Ikhibhodi igcina umbala wokugqamisa wengqikithi yakho. U-Shift namathuluzi asebenzayo ahlala elula ukuwubona. Lesi silungiselelo sithatha indawo yemibala yengqikithi ekhethiwe ngenkathi sivuliwe.
Amalebula anokugqama okuphezulu kakhulu ebhodini elimnyama noma elimhlophe eliyisicaba
Dweba umngcele uzungeze zonke izinkinobho nethuluzi ngalinye lebhara lamathuluzi
Okhiye abade nezikhala ezibanzi kulula ukubacindezela ngokunembile
Bona wonke amafonti, noma ngenisa ifonti yakho
Isikhathi osibamba ngaso ukhiye ngaphambi kokuba izikhiye zawo ezinye zivuleke
Ivuliwe. Izinkinobho zithola ukuthinta kwakho. I-TalkBack igcina okunye kwesikrini
Hambisa umunwe wakho ukuze uzwe ukhiye, bese uwuvula ukuze uthayiphe
Izinkomba zekhibhodi ziyaqhubeka nokusebenza ngenkathi i-TalkBack isebenza
Wonke ukhiye unegama elikhulunywayo. Uthayipha ngokuthinta okuqondile

Indawo yokugcina ishicilela uhlu lwalokho ekunikezayo. Ikhibhodi ilanda lolo hlu njalo uma uvula lesi sikrini, ngakho itimu noma isakhiwo esingeziwe kusukela ekuvakasheni kwakho kokugcina siyavela ngaphandle kokuthi wenze lutho. Uhlu ngalunye luncane, kodwa ikhibhodi ilanda olulodwa kuyo yonke indawo yokugcina oyengezile. Vala lokhu ukuze ungalandi lutho uze ucindezele Vuselela. Vuselela kuhlale kulanda, noma yini lezi zilungiselelo ezimbili ezishoyo, ngoba ukuyicindezela kuyisicelo. Lesi silungiselelo sivuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Landa uhlu lwayo yonke indawo yokugcina njalo uma uvakashela
Le-add-on idinga inguqulo entsha ye-WM Keyboard.
Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazi ukuthola lelo add-on. Indawo yokugcina kungenzeka ishintshile.
Lesi sikrini sibonisa idatha uhlelo lokusebenza oluyilondoloze ngesikhathi sokufaka. Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazi ukufunda indawo yokugcina manje, ngakho alukwazi ukuhlola izibuyekezo.

Ama-plugin avaliwe. Vula okuthi “Vumela ama-plugin” ngaphansi kwe-Tools › Plugins. Bese ufaka le-add-on. Ithuluzi lama-Plugin kubha yamathuluzi liyisilungiselelo esihlukile. Lilawula kuphela lapho iphaneli ivuleka khona.
Le ndawo yokugcina ayikho ohlwini lwakho. Ukufaka kuyayengeza.
Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazi ukulanda umbhalo welayisensi.
Ama-plugin asebenza endaweni evaliwe. Leli plugin alikwazi ukubona lokho okuthayiphayo, ukufunda ibhodi lakho lokunamathisela, noma ukusebenzisa i-inthanethi. I-plugin ayikwazi ukucela lezo zinkonzo.
Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazi ukulanda ukubuka kuqala.

resources.string: Yeqa ukuhlola uma uxhumano lwakho lusebenzisa idatha
Namathisela ikheli lereposithri. Sebenzisa isixhumanisi se-GitHub, noma isixhumanisi esiqondile kufayela layo le-%1$s.
Lelo akulona ikheli lendawo yokugcina. Kumele kube isixhumanisi se-https esiya endaweni yokugcina ye-GitHub, noma isixhumanisi esiqondile sefayela le-%1$s.
Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazi ukufunda indawo yokugcina yezengezo kulelo kheli.
Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazi ukufunda le ndawo yokugcina. Yivuselele kusuka esikrinini sama-Add-ons.
Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazi ukufunda lelo kheli. Kumele kube ikheli le-https.
Awekho ama-repository okwamanje. Engeza elilodwa nekheli lalo ukuze ubone ukuthi linikezani.

Izindawo zokugcina izengezo (add-ons) ngamakhasi ewebhu ajwayelekile. Afaka izingqikithi, izakhiwo, izichazamazwi, imishwana, amaphakethe ezitikha, amaphakethe ezithonjana, amafonti, amafonti e-emoji nemisindo yezikhiye. Izengezo ziqukethe idatha elula. Uhlelo lokusebenza alusebenzisi ikhodi uma ufaka eyodwa.
Ufuna: %1$s. Vula isilondolozi ukuze ubone ukuthi yini ekunikezayo. Isihlungi sikubekelwe futhi ungasisabalalisa lapho.
Le-add-on yenziwe kanye nama-add-on angezansi. Ungawafaka wonke, noma ufake lolu kuphela. Isebenza yodwa futhi.
Amafonti we-Google, noma ngenisa ifayela lakho lefonti
Shintsha noma yisiphi isithonjana sethuluzi noma isithonjana sokhiye, noma ufake iphakethe lezithonjana
0 inikeza okhiye abayisikwele. 28 inikeza okhiye abanomumo wephilisi ophelele.
Ku-0 dp iseluleko sithinta onqenqemeni olungaphezulu lokhiye. Amanani amakhulu ahambisa iseluleko phansi, siseduze nelebhuli. Okuzenzakalelayo yi-1 dp.
Ibanga leseluleko sekhona kusuka emaphethelweni aphezulu okhiye

Lokhu kushintsha usayizi wokusikisela okuncane okubhalwa ikhibhodi ekhoneni lokhiye. Ikhibhodi ikhombisa ukusikisela uma \"Cindezela ubambe izinkomba\" kuvuliwe. Amanani amakhulu enza izinkomba zifundeke kalula. Okuzenzakalelayo ngu-×1.00.
Isikali somlingiswa omncane osesikhaleni sekhi ngalinye
Lokhu kushintsha usayizi wawo wonke amalebula akukhiye. Amabhamuza e-popup anobukhulu bawo befonti ngaphansi kokuthi Ukucindezela ukhiye → I-popup yokhiye.

I-radius yekona eliyisihluthulelo, osayizi belebula necebo, iqembu lonke lethuluzi kanye neqembu lonke lebhokisi lamathuluzi kubuyela kokuzenzakalelayo. Itimu yakho, ifonti yakho kanye nephakethe lakho lezithonjana akuthinteki: kunezikrini zazo.
Buyisela zonke izilungiselelo kulesi sikrini ekubeni kwazo okuzenzakalelayo
Amathuluzi kugridi yethuluzi abuyela ekulandelaneni kwawo kwasekuqaleni. Amathuluzi avuliwe, nalawa abhalwe kubha yamathuluzi, awathinteki.
Buyisela amathuluzi kugridi yethuluzi endaweni yawo yasekuqaleni

Umugqa udweba isiphakamiso sawo sokuqala ngokugqamile. Khetha umbala lapha futhi lelo gama lithatha umbala kuphela uma ukulungisa okuzenzakalelayo kunqume ukukufaka lapho uthayipha isikhala. Igama eligqamile ngaphandle kombala yisiphakamiso esiphezulu, futhi isikhala sigcina lokho okuthayiphile. Ezinye iziphakamiso zigcina umbala wetimu. Setha kabusha umugqa ukuze ulandele itimu futhi.
Umbala wegama okuzolifaka ukulungisa okuzenzakalelayo esikhaleni

Yehlisa ukuze ulinganise igama elide ngaphambi kokuba kudingeke ukuthi linciphe, noma ukuze ufake iziphakamiso eziningi esikrinini esincane. Yiphakamise ukuze uvimbele amagama angomakhelwane ukuthi angafundwa njengelilodwa lapho umugqa ushaya umqulu. Lesi silungiselelo singu-6 dp ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Igebe ohlangothini ngalunye lwegama emgqeni weziphakamiso

Amalebula okhiye anokusethwa kwawo kosayizi futhi iziphakamiso ezingenhla kwawo bezingenawo, ngakho okhiye abakhulu bangase beze neziphakamiso ezincane. Lokhu futhi kulinganisa umugqa wamakhandidethi wokufaka kwesiShayina, isiJapane nesiCantonese, njengoba kuwumugqa ofanayo kwimodi ehlukile. Lokhu kusethwa ku-100% ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Ukuthi amagama akumugqa wokuphakamisa makhulu kangakanani
Kubekwe yindikimba yakho \"%1$s\". Kushintshe lapho, ngaphansi kwe-Layout yale ndikimba.
Izindikimba ezikhanyayo, ezimnyama kanye ne-AMOLED, imibala, izithombe zangemuva, ukungenisa nokuthumela ngaphandle
20 idweba isiyingi esigcwele ngemuva kwesithonjana sethuluzi ngalinye, njenge-Gboard. Amanani amancane anikeza izikwele eziyindilinga. 0 isusa ingemuva futhi ishiye izithonjana kuphela.
Ukuthi umbuthano ngemuva kwethuluzi ngalinye le-toolbar uyindilinga kangakanani
Uhlaka lomumo ngemuva kwethuluzi ngalinye lethuluzi

38 igcina umbuthano wakudala. Amanani abanzi awelula abe yiphilisi, njenge-Gboard. Ingemuva libonakala kuphela uma iradiyasi yombuthano wethuluzi ingaphezu kuka-0. Ihambisana kahle nebha yamathuluzi engapheqeka.
Ububanzi besimo ngemuva kwethuluzi ngalinye lebhokisi lamathuluzi

Umugqa ophezulu ogcwele uyanyamalala. Ulahlekelwa iziphakamiso zamagama nokufinyelela okusheshayo kuyo yonke ithuluzi eliphiniwe, njenge-emoji, ibhodi lokunamathisela, nokhiye besikhombisi. Okhiye basebenzisa ubude obukhululekile. Ungavula ibha yamathuluzi futhi lapha nganoma yisiphi isikhathi.

Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, ukucindezela nokubamba okuhambayo kuthatha ithuluzi ukuze ukwazi ukulibeka kwenye indawo kubha yamathuluzi. Uma kuvaliwe, ukucindezela nokubamba okuhambayo kuhlala kuyikucindezela nokubamba, futhi ibhokisi lamathuluzi yilapho uhlela khona kabusha ibha yamathuluzi. Kucishe uma ukubamba kuqhubeka kuphenduka ukuhudula ngephutha.
Cindezela ubambe ithuluzi kubha yamathuluzi, bese ulihudulela endaweni entsha
Amathuluzi agcina usayizi owodwa, epakishwe ngakwesobunxele

Usayizi omisiwe ugcina amathuluzi ngosayizi owodwa kwesobunxele. Ukusabalalisa kwabelana ngobubanzi obugcwele bebha yamathuluzi phakathi kwawo, njengoba kwenza iziphakamiso zamagama. Ukuskrola kugcina ithuluzi ngalinye ngosayizi okhululekile uma uphina okungaphezu kokulingana, futhi kukuvumela ukuthi uswayiphe phakathi kwawo. Ukhetha amathuluzi kubha yamathuluzi kusuka kukhibhodi: vula ibhokisi lamathuluzi ngenkinobho yegridi, bese ucindezela ubambe ithuluzi bese ulihudula phakathi kwebha yamathuluzi kanye nebhokisi lamathuluzi. Ngokuskrola, shintsha ukuhleleka kusuka ebhokisini lamathuluzi, ngoba ukuhudula ngaphakathi kwebha yamathuluzi eskrolayo kunzima.
Ithuluzi ngalinye ligcina usayizi okhululekile futhi ibha iyaskrola eceleni
Amathuluzi abelana ngobubanzi obugcwele bebha yamathuluzi
Indlela amathuluzi aphiniwe abelana ngayo nebha yamathuluzi

Uma uxhuma ikhibhodi ye-Bluetooth noma ikhibhodi yedokhi, okhiye abasesikrinini bayanyamalala futhi kubonakale ibha yamathuluzi kuphela. I-Emoji, ibhodi lokunamathisela namanye amathuluzi ahlala ekude ngokucindezela okukodwa ngenkathi uthayipha kukhibhodi yehadiwe. Lesi silungiselelo sivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Uma ikhibhodi yezingxenyekazi (hardware) ixhunyiwe, khombisa ibha yamathuluzi kuphela
Usayizi wefonti wamalebula wamathuluzi kubha yamathuluzi
Ikhibhodi idweba igama elincane ngaphansi kwethuluzi ngalinye eliphiniwe. Khulisa ukuphakama kwebha yamathuluzi ukuze unikeze amalebula isikhala.
Bonisa igama lethuluzi ngalinye ngaphansi kwesithonjana salo kubha yamathuluzi

Ikhibhodi ivuleka phezu kwesikrini sakho sokukhiya uma uphendula isaziso noma usebenzisa ibhokisi lokusesha lapho. Lesi silungiselelo bese sifihla umugqa ophezulu ogcwele futhi sivimbe iphaneli yebhodi lokunamathisela. Umugqa ubamba iziphakamiso zamagama nethuluzi ngalinye eliphiniwe, ngakho ithuluzi lebhodi lokunamathisela kanye ne-chip yalo yokunamathisela nayo iyanyamalala. Umbhalo okopishiwe njengamakhodi esikhathi esisodwa namaphasiwedi kuhlala kude nesikrini esingavuswa yinoma ubani. Lesi silungiselelo sivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo. Uma idivayisi yakho ivuliwe, ikhibhodi ayishintshi.
Fihla umugqa ongaphezulu futhi uvimbele ibhodi lokunamathisela ngenkathi idivayisi yakho ikhiyiwe
Fihla ibha yamathuluzi kanye nebhodi lokunamathisela esikrinini sokukhiya
Lokhu kwengeza isikhala phakathi kwebha yamathuluzi nomugqa wokuqala wezinkinobho. Okuzenzakalelayo ngu-0 dp. Ibha yamathuluzi nekhibhodi ziba zinde ngesilinganiso esifanayo.
Lokhu kwengeza isikhala phakathi konqenqema olungaphezulu lwekhibhodi nebha yamathuluzi. Okuzenzakalelayo yi-4 dp. Ibha yamathuluzi nekhibhodi ziba zinde ngesilinganiso esifanayo.
Amathuluzi agcina umugqa wawo, evulekile njalo
Amathuluzi athola umugqa wawo, ovulwa futhi uvalwe kusuka kumcibisholo

Ngo-\"Umugqa\", amathuluzi neziphakamiso babelana ngomugqa owodwa. Amathuluzi aphumula lapho, iziphakamiso zithatha umugqa ngenkathi uthayipha, futhi inkinobho yomcibisholo ishintsha phakathi kwawo. Lokhu akubizi ukuphakama. Ngo-\"Inkinobho\", inkinobho yomcibisholo ivula umugqa wamathuluzi ngaphezu kweziphakamiso, futhi inkinobho iwuvale futhi. Ngo-\"Njalo\", lowo mugqa wamathuluzi uhlala uvuliwe. Zombili lezi zokugcina zigcina amathuluzi ekufinyeleleni ngenkathi uthayipha, futhi zombili zisebenzisa ukuphakama komugqa owodwa ngaphezulu.
Amathuluzi neziphakamiso babelana ngomugqa owodwa, futhi umcibisholo uphenduka phakathi kwawo
Yabelana ngomugqa wesiphakamiso, noma sebenzisa umugqa ongenhla kwawo
Ibha yamathuluzi, amalebula ayo, umugqa weziphakamiso kanye nokuma kwethuluzi kubuyela kokuzenzakalelayo. Amathuluzi aphiniwe awathinteki.
Buyisela zonke izilungiselelo kulesi sikrini kuzilungiselelo zazo ezizenzakalelayo

Ezinhlelweni zokubhala ezisuka kwesokudla ziye kwesobunxele, njengesi-Arabhu nesi-Hebheru, amathuluzi aphiniwe nawo asuka kwesokudla aya kwesobunxele, ngakho ibha yamathuluzi ilandela umbhalo. Lesi silungiselelo sivuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo. Igridi yebhokisi lamathuluzi ayishintshi.
Phindaphinda ukuhleleka kwamathuluzi uma uthayipha umbhalo osuka kwesokudla uye kwesobunxele
Hlehlisa ukulandelana kwezilimi ezibhalwa kusuka kwesokudla kuye kwesobunxele
Okuboniswa umugqa ongaphezu kwezinkinobho, nokuthi kanjani

Ibha yamathuluzi iwumugqa ongaphezu kokhiye. Ibonisa iziphakamiso zamagama ngenkathi uthayipha. Ngezikhathi ezinye ibonisa amathuluzi akho aphiniwe, njenge-emoji, ibhodi lokunamathisela kanye nokhiye besikhombisi. Yicime ukuze unikeze ukuphakama kwayo kokhiye. Uhlelo lokusebenza lukucela ukuthi uqinisekise, ngoba lokhu kuphinde kufihle iziphakamiso nawo wonke amathuluzi.

Vala lokhu ukuze ususe umugqa weziphakamiso futhi ugcine umugqa wamathuluzi kuphela. Ikhibhodi iba mfushane ngomugqa owodwa. Kuwusizo uma uvale iziphakamiso futhi umugqa usala ungenalutho. Konke okunye okuvela kulowo mugqa nakho kuyasuswa: isiqeshana sokunamathisela sokukopisha kwakho kokugcina, amakhodi esikhathi esisodwa, okunikezwayo kweziqephu nezinye iziqeshana. Ibha ehlangene yokuthayipha ngezwi isavela lapho ngenkathi udictata.
Gcina umugqa wesiphakamiso ngaphezu komugqa wamathuluzi
Umugqa ongaphezu kwezinkinobho ophethe iziphakamiso namathuluzi

Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, ukuswayiphela phansi noma kuphi kubha yamathuluzi kuvala ikhibhodi. Ivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo, ukuze ukunyakaza kungaqali ngenkathi upheqa noma uhlela kabusha ibha yamathuluzi. Ukuze uhambise ithuluzi uyalicindezela ubambe, ukuze lokho kunyakaza kungayivali ikhibhodi.
Swayiphela phansi kubha yamathuluzi ukuze uvale ikhibhodi

Ibhokisi lamathuluzi yigridi engemuva kwenkinobho yegridi kubha yamathuluzi. Amathuluzi ambalwa emugqeni enza ithuluzi ngalinye libe likhulu futhi kube lula ukulicindezela. Amathuluzi amaningi emugqeni abonisa amathuluzi amaningi ngaphandle kokuskrola.

Ngokuzenzakalelayo lokhu kulandela usayizi welebula yebha yamathuluzi, ukuze zombili zivumelane. Setha usayizi lapha ukuze wenze amagama ebhokisi lamathuluzi abe makhulu noma abe mancane ngokwawo. Lesi silungiselelo silandela ibha yamathuluzi ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Igama elingaphansi kwethuluzi ngalinye kuphaneli yamathuluzi egcwele

Izithonjana ziyigridi. Ibonisa isithonjana esiyindilinga sethuluzi ngalinye elinegama elingezansi. Ama-Pills anika ithuluzi ngalinye umugqa obanzi onamaphetho ayindilinga. Isithonjana singakwesobunxele kanti igama liseduze kwaso. Umcibisholo ongakwesokudla umaka amathuluzi avula okuthile, njengezindikimba (Themes) kanye ne-Clipboard. Amanye amathuluzi enza umsebenzi wawo ngokushesha, njenge-Flashlight kanye ne-Undo. Amathuluzi ambalwa alingana esikrinini, kodwa ungafunda wonke amagama.
Indlela ibhokisi lamathuluzi elidweba ngayo amathuluzi alo

Khetha okuphindaphindwayo kosayizi womugqa wakho ukuze ugcwalise umugqa wokugcina wekhasi ngalinye. Uma ukhetha amathuluzi amaningi kunalokho iphaneli elingakubonisa, ikhasi liyapheqa kanye nokuswayipha.
Mangaki amathuluzi ikhasi ngalinye lebhokisi lamathuluzi elikuphathayo

Uma lokhu kuvaliwe, ibhokisi lamathuluzi liyigridi eyodwa ephequlula phezulu naphansi. Uma kuvuliwe, ibhokisi lamathuluzi liba amakhasi ophequlula phakathi kwawo. Amachashazi angaphansi kwegridi akhombisa indawo okuyo. Ithuluzi ngalinye ligcina indawo efanayo, ukuze ukwazi ukulithola ngokukhumbula. Ungahudula ithuluzi uye endaweni entsha ngaphakathi kwekhasi olibonayo.
Amakhasi amisiwe oswayipha ngawo eceleni, hhayi igridi eyodwa epheqululayo

Okuzenzakalelayo kubili. Okukodwa kunika ithuluzi ngalinye ububanzi obugcwele, okuhle kumagama amade nombhalo omkhulu. Okuthathu kusebenza kuphela ekubukekeni kwe-landscape noma kuthebhulethi. Esikrinini esincane amagama ayanqunywa.

Uma lokhu kuvaliwe, iphilisi ngalinye ligcina ingemuva lengqikithi futhi isithonjana kuphela esibonisa umbala wethuluzi. Uma kuvuliwe, iphilisi lithola lowo mbala. Isithonjana negama kushintshela kumbala ongawufunda kuwo: omhlophe emibaleni eminingi, cishe omnyama emibaleni ekhanyayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi \"Izithonjana zamathuluzi anemibala\" (Izilungiselelo → Amathuluzi) kuvulwe. Uma leso silungiselelo sivaliwe, awukho umbala wokugcwalisa iphilisi.
Faka umbala ku-pill ephelele hhayi esithonjaneni sayo kuphela
Isakhiwo segridi, amakholomu, ukukhasi nokusayizi welebula kubuyela kokuzenzakalelayo. Ukuhleleka kwamathuluzi, nokuthi yimaphi amathuluzi avuliwe, akuthinteki.
Buyisela zonke izilungiselelo kulesi sikrini ekubeni okuzenzakalelayo
Igridi yamathuluzi: isakhiwo sayo, amakholomu kanye nokukhasi
Kopisha amagama akho kusichazamazwi somuntu siqu se-Android, ukuze uwasebenzise kwamanye amakhibhodi kanye nesihloli sokupela
Engeza amagama alondolozwe kusichazamazwi somuntu siqu se-Android
Wonke amagama asesichazamazwini sakho somuntu siqu asevele esesichazamazwini se-Android.
Wonke amagama asesichazamazwini se-Android asevele esesichazamazwini sakho somuntu siqu.
I-Android yabelana kuphela ngesichazamazwi sayo somuntu siqu nekhibhodi esetshenziswayo. Yenza i-WM Keyboard ibe ikhibhodi yakho yamanje, bese uzama futhi.

Lokhu yikho okuhlale kwenziwa uhlelo lokusebenza. Kucime uma ungavamile ukushaja idivayisi yakho isikhathi eside ngokwanele, ngoba isipele esingalutholi ishaja asikaze sisebenze, futhi akukho okukutshela ukuthi asisebenzanga. Umsebenzi ngokwawo uthatha imizuzwana embalwa ukukopisha, ngakho udla ibhethri elincane.
Linda kuze kube yilapho idivayisi yakho ixhunyiwe
I-akhawunti yakho ye-Google, endaweni yohlelo lokusebenza eyimfihlo ezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza ezingakwazi ukuyifunda
I-akhawunti yakho ye-Dropbox, kufolda yohlelo lokusebenza
Ifolda kudivayisi yakho, noma leyo enikezwe olunye uhlelo lokusebenza lokugcina
Iseva ye-FTP. Idinga umsingathi, igama lomsebenzisi kanye nephasiwedi
I-akhawunti yakho yakwa-Microsoft, kufolda yohlelo lokusebenza
Ibhakede ku-AWS, R2, B2 noma i-MinIO. Lidinga ukhiye kanye nemfihlo
Akukho kulokhu okuthumela noma yini kuseva yekhibhodi ye-WM.
Iseva yakho, efana ne-Nextcloud. Idinga i-URL, igama lomsebenzisi kanye nephasiwedi
Uhlelo lokusebenza lubhale %1$s. Lushiye %2$s, ngoba isipele besikhulu kakhulu.
Uhlelo lokusebenza lungabhala kufolda yalo ku-Drive yakho.

Uhlelo lokusebenza lubhalela kufolda efihliwe yalo ku-Drive yakho. Ayikwazi ukubona amanye amafayela akho, futhi ifolda ayiveli eceleni kwemibhalo yakho. Ukuze ubuyise le mvume, hamba ku-akhawunti yakho ye-Google bese uvula uhlu lwezinhlelo zokusebenza ezifinyelela ku-akhawunti. Uhlelo lwakho lokusebenza lwe-Drive lungaphinda lubonise le folda: khetha ifolda kokuthi Ifolda ngenhla esikhundleni salokho uma ufuna ukubona amafayela.
Uhlelo lokusebenza ludinga imvume yakho kuqala.

Uhlelo lokusebenza luthola ifolda yalo ngaphakathi kwe-Dropbox yakho futhi alikwazi ukubona okunye. Ungathola ifolda ngaphansi kwezinhlelo zokusebenza, futhi ungayisusa. Ukuze ubuyise le mvume, vula uhlu lwezinhlelo zokusebenza ezixhunyiwe ku-akhawunti yakho ye-Dropbox.
Uhlelo lokusebenza lubhala isipele ngenkathi idivayisi yakho ishaja.

Uhlelo lokusebenza lugcina iphasiwedi kule divayisi, ngoba isipele esizenzakalelayo asinawo umuntu ozoyithayipha. Lokhu kuvikela ifayela lesipele lapho liya khona, isibonelo kufolda yefu. Akuyivikeli kumuntu ophethe idivayisi yakho evuliwe. Bhala phansi iphasiwedi: ngaphandle kwayo, isipele asikwazi ukubuyiselwa.
Uhlelo lokusebenza lubethela isipele ngasinye. Udinga iphasiwedi ukuze ubuyisele esisodwa.
Isipele sokugcina asiphelanga. Uhlelo lokusebenza luzama futhi kamuva.
Uhlelo lokusebenza alusakwazi ukubhala kufolda yakho yokulondoloza. Khetha ifolda futhi.
Asikho isikhala esanele sokwenza ikhophi yasenqolobaneni.
Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazi ukuthola ifolda yakho yokwenza isipele. Kungenzeka isusiwe, noma ikhadi lingase lingekho.
Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazi ukubhala kuleyo folda. Khetha enye.
Lapho ongabeka khona izipele. Khetha ifolda kuhlelo lokusebenza lwamafu ukuze ugcine amakhophi ngaphandle kwedivayisi.
Ngaphandle kwe-TLS, iphasiwedi yakho kanye nesipele sakho konke kuwela inethiwekhi njengombhalo ocacile noma ubani ophakathi angafunda. Vula iphasiwedi ngezansi uma kufanele ushiye lokhu kuvaliwe.
Kushiye kungenalutho ukuze usebenzise umkhombandlela ofika kuwo ngemva kokungena ngemvume.
Ibethela uxhumano ngaphambi kokuba uhlelo lokusebenza lungene ngemvume. Ishiye ivuliwe ngaphandle uma iseva yakho ingakwazi ukukwenza.
Uhlelo lokusebenza lususa isipele esidala kakhulu uma kukhona okungaphezu kwalokhu. Luhlala lugcina esisha kakhulu.
Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazi ukwenza isipele ngenkathi idivayisi ikhiyiwe. Yivule bese uzama futhi.
Ishejuli, indawo oya kuyo kanye nokubethela
Uhlelo lokusebenza alukakwenzi ukwenza ikhophi yasenqolobaneni ezenzakalelayo.
Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazanga ukuqeda ukungena ngemvume. Zama futhi.
Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazanga ukuvula isiphequluli ukuze ungene ngemvume.

Uhlelo lokusebenza luthola ifolda yalo ngaphakathi kwe-OneDrive yakho futhi alukwazi ukubona okunye. Ungayithola ifolda ngaphansi kwezinhlelo zokusebenza (Apps). Ukuze uhoxise le mvume, vula uhlu lwezinhlelo zokusebenza ku-akhawunti yakho yakwa-Microsoft.

Lokhu kusekelayo kuqukethe amagama owathayiphile, noma umbhalo owukopishe, futhi ayikho iphasiwedi evikelayo. Uhlelo lokusebenza lulubhala kufolda yakho ngesikhathi esibekiwe. Vula iphasiwedi, noma uvale isichazamazwi kanye nebhodi lokunamathisela ngenhla.
Le ndawo yokugcina ayiyona i-https. Uhlelo lokusebenza lusayina isicelo ngasinye ngokhiye wakho oyimfihlo, futhi ekhelini le-http elivamile noma ubani kunethiwekhi angafunda lokho okuthunyelwayo.
Shiya lokhu kungenalutho ku-Amazon S3. Kwezinye izinsiza, faka ikheli lazo lapha, isibonelo https://your-account.r2.cloudflarestorage.com noma ikheli leseva yakho ye-MinIO.
Vula lokhu nge-MinIO, nanoma yiliphi ikheli eliyikheli le-IP. Likushiye livaliwe nge-Amazon S3 ne-Cloudflare R2.
Shiya lokhu kungenalutho ukuze ubeke izipele phezulu kwebhakede.
Sebenzisa i-us-east-1 uma isevisi yakho ingenazo izifunda.
Akukho okufanele kwenziwe isipele. Khetha okungenani ingxenye eyodwa ngenhla.

Isipele singaba ama-megabyte ambalwa, futhi siphuma njalo uma isikhathi sifika. Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, uhlelo lokusebenza lulinda i-Wi-Fi, noma okunye ukuxhumana i-Android engakubali njengokulinganiselwe. Uma kucishiwe, isipele siphuma ngedatha yeselula ngokushesha nje lapho sesifanele. Lesi silungiselelo asenzi lutho uma wenza isipele kufolda, ngoba ifolda iyisitoreji kudivayisi yakho futhi ayidingi ukuxhumana nhlobo. Lesi silungiselelo sivuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.

Leli kheli akusilo i-https. Uhlelo lokusebenza luthumela igama lakho lomsebenzisi nephasiwedi yakho ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho ulayisha, kanti ekhelini elinjenge-http nje, noma ubani kunethiwekhi angakwazi ukuzifunda, ngakho-ke uhlelo lokusebenza alulusebenzisi.
Uma iseva yakho ikwazi ukwenza amaphasiwedi ohlelo lokusebenza, sebenzisa elilodwa lapha esikhundleni sephasiwedi ye-akhawunti yakho.
Ikheli eliphelele lefolda ozobhalela kuyo, isibonelo https://cloud.example.com/remote.php/dav/files/me/backups
Wonke amagama asohlwini lwabavinjelwe ayasuswa futhi angaphinde aphakanyiswe. Amagama owafundise ikhibhodi awathinteki.
Awekho amagama kulolu hlu okwamanje. Engeza igama ngenhla.
Ikhibhodi ayiphakamisi la magama futhi ayiwacacisi kuwo. Usengakwazi ukuwathayipha futhi uwathumele. Ahlala ngaphandle komugqa wokusikisela. Ukufana akubheki izinhlamvu ezinkulu.
Leli gama aliphakanyiswa neze, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ufake luphi ulimi.
Igama aliphakanyiswa neze olimini obulubhala. Ezinye izilimi zisaliphakamisa.

Ukucindezela nokubamba isiphakamiso bese ukhetha Ungaphakamisi kuvimba igama. Lokhu kunquma ukuthi liyavinjwa yini kuzo zonke izilimi noma kulimi obulubhala kuphela. Amagama owengeza kulesi sikrini azobuzwa njalo.
Lapho igama olivimbayo elithi Ungaphakamisi lisebenza khona
Akukho lutho lapha okwamanje. Amagama avela njengoba uthayipha, uma \"Funda ekuthayipheni\" kuvuliwe ku-Privacy. Ungaphinda ungeze igama ngenhla.
Ikhibhodi ifunda amagama embhalweni owuthayiphayo. Ungakwazi futhi ukwengeza amagama ngokwakho. Ikhibhodi iphakamisa lawa magama futhi ayiwacishi. Wonke ahlala kudivayisi yakho.

Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazanga ukubhala lelo fayela.
Ifayela linokhiye be-API. Bathatha indawo yokhiye obasethile lapha.
Uhlelo lokusebenza luhlanganisa izilungiselelo nezilungiselelo zakho zamanje. Isichazamazwi, ibhodi lokunamathisela kanye neziqephu zithatha indawo yalezo ezikudivayisi yakho.

Ukungenisa izilungiselelo kushintsha kuphela izilungiselelo ezishiwo yifayela. Ezinye izilungiselelo zihlala njengoba zinjalo. Isichazamazwi, ibhodi lokunamathisela kanye neziqephu ezisefayelini zithatha indawo yezinto ezikudivayisi yakho.
Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazanga ukufunda lelo fayela.

Izithombe zakho eziphiniwe kanye nemibhalo yakho yakamuva. Ifayela lishiya ngaphandle izithombe namafayela, ngoba ahlala kudivayisi yakho futhi awavuleki kwenye idivayisi.

Abaphathi bamaphasiwedi abaningi badala kunesimaki esibucayi se-Android, futhi ikhodi oyikopisha ngesandla emyalezweni ayinaso nhlobo isimaki. Ikhibhodi ibheka lezi ziqephu kudivayisi yakho, futhi ukuhlolwa kuncane ngenhloso. Iziqephu ziyafana kuphela uma yonke iqeshi iyithokheni elilodwa: ukulandelana okufushane kwezinhlamvu ezinkulu nezinombolo, noma inhlanganisela ende yezinhlamvu ezinkulu, izinhlamvu ezincane, izinombolo nezimpawu. Imisho, izixhumanisi namakheli e-imeyili akufani neze.
Phatha futhi isiqeshana esibukeka njengephasiwedi noma ikhodi yokuqinisekisa njengento ebucayi, hhayi nje iziqeshana ezimakwe uhlelo lokusebenza lokukopisha

Ama-chip ahlala ngaphezu komlando ngemigqa edwetshiwe, ngakho afundwa njengezingxenye zento ekopishiwe hhayi njengezinto ezikopishiwe ngokwazo. Cindezela ubambe i-chip ukuze ubone ukuthi imakwe ngaphakathi kwento ekopishiwe evela kuyo. Ukucindezela kunamathisela leyo ngxenye kuphela, futhi into ekopishiwe ihlala emlandweni. Ikhibhodi ithola lezi zingxenye kudivayisi yakho.
Khipha amakhodi esikhathi esisodwa, izinombolo zocingo nezixhumanisi eziqeshini zakho. Ngasinye siba yichips yaso
Susa iziqeshana ezingaphiniwe ngemva kwalesi sikhathi

Iphaneli yebhodi lokunamathisela ithatha ikhibhodi yonke. Ibha yamathuluzi, umugqa we-emoji kanye nomugqa wezimpawu kuyasuka, bese ikhanda elincane lithatha indawo yazo. Umlando ube usubonisa iziqeshana eziningi ngesikhathi esisodwa. Ngenkathi usesha umlando, iphaneli ibuyela esimweni sayo esincane ukuze okhiye bangene ngaphansi kwayo. Lesi silungiselelo sivuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Fihla ibha yamathuluzi ngemuva kwenkinobho yokubuyela emuva ukuze umlando uthole ikhibhodi yonke
Londoloza umbhalo okopishiwe ukuze ukwazi ukuwunamathisela ngokushesha
Thola isihloko sekhasi lesixhumanisi esikopishiwe bese usibonisa kuphaneli. Lokhu kuxhumana nesayithi elixhunyiwe

Lona umkhawulo wesibili emlandweni. Ukuphelelwa yisikhathi kwebhodi lokunamathisela okungenhla yikho kokuqala. Usuku olumatasa lokukopisha lungenza amakhulu eziqeshana ngaphakathi kwesikhathi sokuphelelwa yisikhathi. Lapho iphaneli igcwele, ikhophi ngayinye entsha isusa isiqeshana esidala kakhulu esingaphiniwe. Iziqeshana eziphiniwe azibalwa kulo mkhawulo, futhi ikhibhodi ayizisusi neze.

Isiqeshana ngasinye sigcina inombolo yaso ngenkathi usesha. Imiphumela ikhombisa izinombolo ebezinezisiqeshana, futhi ukubala akuqali kabusha kusuka ku-1. Izinombolo zilandela ukulandelana kwepaneli, kusuka phezulu. Lesi silungiselelo sivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Bonisa inombolo eceleni kwesiqeshana ngasinye, ukuze uthephe leyo oyishoyo

Yonke i-app kudivayisi yakho ingafunda ibhodi lokunamathisela lesistimu. Ngaphandle kwalesi silungiselelo, iphasiwedi evela kumphathi wephasiwedi ihlala ifundeka lapho ize iphelelwe yisikhathi. Lokhu kusebenza ekunamathiseleni okwenzayo ngekhibhodi enkundleni yephasiwedi: iphaneli yebhodi lokunamathisela, i-paste chip, bamba u-V no-Ctrl+V. Lesi silungiselelo sivuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Susa isiqeshana emlandweni nasebhodi lokunamathisela lesistimu ngokushesha nje lapho usinamathisela enkundleni yephasiwedi
Gcina kuphela izinombolo ezibukeka njengezo ozikopishayo. Yonke inombolo iba yi-chip manje
Bhala iziqeshana eziphiniwe ekugcineni kwepaneli esikhundleni sokuqala
Bonisa izithombe-skrini zakho ebhodini lokunamathisela eduze kombhalo nezithombe ezikopishiwe
Bonisa ibha yokusesha phezulu kuphaneli yebhodi lokunamathisela. Ihlunga umlando njengoba uthayipha
Lesi sikhathi sehlukile ekupheleni komlando okungenhla

I-Android ivumela uhlelo lokusebenza ukuthi lumake lokho elikubeka kubhodi lokunamathisela njengokubucayi. Umphathi wephasiwedi wenza lokhu uma ukopisha ukungena ngemvume. Ayikho enye into kudivayisi yakho esebenza ngaleyo maki, ngakho ikhibhodi isebenza ngayo lapha. Isiqeshana esifihliwe sibonakala njengamachashazi kuphaneli. Ikhibhodi ayikaze inikeze njenge-chip yokunamathisela futhi ayikaze iyibeke kusipele sezilungiselelo. Iyazisusa kusibali-sikhathi esifushane esingezansi hhayi ekupheleni komlando. Uma uphina isiqeshana, akukho kulokho okusebenzayo, ngoba iphini lisho \"gcina lokhu\".
Okufanele ukwenze ngephasiwedi ekopishiwe noma ikhodi yesikhathi esisodwa
Vula izilungiselelo zesistimu ukuze unikeze imvume
Kunoma yimuphi umkhakha, njengeminye imibhalo ekopishiwe

Ikhodi ekopishiwe ithathwa njengemfihlo, ngakho ngokuvamile igcinwa ingekho emgqeni weziphakamiso: i-chip ihlala ibonakala ngenkathi uthayipha, futhi ikhodi engaphezu kokhiye bomlayezo iyikhodi eboniswayo. Ibhokisi lekhodi liyisinqumo, ngoba ikhodi ukuphela kwento okhona ukuze uyithayiphe. Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, ikhodi ekopishwe emizuzwini embalwa edlule inikezwa njenge-chip ezinkundleni ezicela izinombolo, hhayi kwenye indawo.
Ikhodi ekopishiwe ihlala kuphela kuphaneli yebhodi lokunamathisela
Ikhodi yesikhathi esisodwa ekopishiwe iyanikezwa uma inkundla icela amadijithi
Bonisa umbhalo okopishwe muva nje njenge-chip emgqeni weziphakamiso. Ukucindezela okukodwa kuyawunamathisela

Lokhu kusebenzela izenzo zokukopisha zekhibhodi: izinqamuleli zebhodi lokunamathisela ze-A/C/V/X kanye nenkinobho yokukopisha yepaneli yokuhlela umbhalo. Kusebenza kuphela ezinkundleni ezinganikezi impendulo yokukopisha yazo. Lesi silungiselelo sivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Bonisa i-pop-up emfushane ethi \"Kopishiwe\" uma ukopisha noma usika umbhalo kukhibhodi

Ikhibhodi ifunda uhlelo lokusebenza olungaphambili ngesikhathi ukopisha, ngokusebenzisa Ukufinyelela Kokusebenzisa. Amanye amakhophi awanawo umthombo wohlelo lokusebenza, isibonelo ikhophi evela ekuvumelaniseni okungemuva. Akukho okumayelana nokusetshenziswa kohlelo lwakho lokusebenza okushiya idivayisi yakho.
Rekhoda ukuthi yiluphi uhlelo lokusebenza oluvela kulo isiqeshana. Cindezela ubambe isiqeshana ukuze usibone. Lokhu kudinga imvume Yokufinyelela Ukusetshenziswa
Ngaphandle kwayo, ikhibhodi ilondoloza iziqeshana ngaphandle kohlelo lokusebenza lomthombo
Uhlelo lokusebenza ludinga imvume yokufinyelela ekusebenziseni

Igridi ihlanganisa amakholomu amabili amakhadi, afanele izithombe. Uhlu lunikeza i-clip ngayinye umugqa wonke, ofanele umbhalo omude. Inkinobho eseceleni kwebha yokusesha yephaneli ishintsha ukulungiselelwa okufanayo. Igridi iyona ebekiwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Amakhadi ezikholamu ezimbili, noma isiqeshana esisodwa emgqeni ngamunye

plurals.item: Usuvele unephekhi yezitikha engu-%1$d. Susa yona kuqala.
Usuvele unamaphekhi ezitikha angu-%1$d. Susa elilodwa kuqala.

plurals.name: import_stickers_unreadable
plurals.item: Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazi ukufunda ifayela elingu-%1$d njengesithombe.
Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazi ukufunda amafayela angu-%1$d njengesithombe.

resources.string: Ikhibhodi ayinayo indlela yokusebenzisa i-%1$s. Akuyona ingqikithi, isakhiwo, iphakethe leziqeshana, iphakethe lezitika, iphakethe lezithonjana, i-plugin noma isipele. Usengakwazi ukuyifunda futhi uyihlele lapha.
Uhlelo lokusebenza lungeza ingqikithi kuzingqikithi zakho futhi luyisebenzise kukhibhodi.
Ifayela alitholakali. Kukhona okulisusile noma okuyisusile, noma uhlelo lokusebenza olwabelane ngalo luyekile ukufinyelela kulo.
Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazi ukuvula lelo fayela
Ikhibhodi ayikwazi ukufunda lelo fayela. Akuyona itimu, isakhiwo, iphakethe leziqeshana, iphakethe lezitikha, iphakethe lezithonjana, i-plugin noma isipele.
“%1$s” yengeziwe emaphaketheni akho esilulumagama. Amagama ayo athola amakhadi, izikhumbuzo, namakhadi okufunda.
Igama lempahla elikubakaki abacashuniwe lihamba lapha.
Iphaneli kuphela engabamba iseli lengxenye. Ukusebenzisa kususa lo khiye.
Ukusebenzisa kusebenzisa okuzenzakalelayo kwe-%1$s esikhundleni se-null.
Ikhibhodi izibekela u-%1$s ngokwayo, ngakho asikho isidingo sokuyibhala.
Susa lokhu kukhefana. Akukho okuzayo ngemva kwakho.
Sebenzisa ukuziba umbhalo ngemuva kokuphela kwe-JSON.
Le nguqulo ayinayo isenzo %1$s. Faka okususiwe ukhiye.
Ayikho isithonjana %1$s. Ukhiye udweba ilebula yawo.
%1$s akuyona indlela. Sebenzisa kwesobunxele, phezulu, kwesokudla noma phansi.
Ayikho impahla %1$s lapha, ngakho i-Apply iyayiziba.
Awunayo isakhiwo sesibili esine-id %1$s, ngakho ukhiye awenzi lutho.
Le divayisi ayinayo itimu %1$s. Isakhiwo sigcina i-id ukuze itimu ifike.
I-%2$s ayinalo inani elingu-%1$s, ngakho i-Apply isebenzisa okuzenzakalelayo.
I-%2$s ayinalo inani elingu-%1$s, futhi i-Apply ayikwazi ukufunda isakhiwo ngaphandle kwalokho ekwaziyo.
Faka u-%1$s kubakaki, noma ubhale true, false noma null.
Xhuma kabusha kumakhompyutha abhangqiwe uma etholakele
Vula ifoni kanye ngemuva kokuqalisa kabusha ukuze usebenzise lokhu
Ivaliwe. Akukho okuthunyelwayo noma okuzwayo kunethiwekhi yakho
Umbhalo okopishwe lapho usukulungele ukunamathiselwa lapha

Amaphasiwedi namakhodi awathunyelwa ngokwawo. Akukho okuthunyelwa kusuka enkundleni yephasiwedi, noma ngenkathi i-incognito imisa ibhodi lokunamathisela. Ithebhu ethi Thumela isengathumela ibhodi lokunamathisela uma ucela.
Umbhalo okopishwe lapha usulungele ukunamathiselwa lapho
Vula i-KDE Connect ukuze ufune amakhompyutha
Funa amakhompyutha abhangqiwe futhi uwavumele athole le foni

Ibhanyisa le khibhodi nekhompyutha esebenzisa i-KDE Connect, GSConnect noma i-Valent, ngenethiwekhi yakho yendawo. Ikhibhodi ivela lapho njengedivayisi yayo, ngakho uhlelo lokusebenza lwe-KDE Connect aludingeki ocingweni.
Ezinkundleni ezivimba ukutholakala. Le foni izimemezela kuleli naleli kheli ngokuqondile, futhi ikhompyutha iyaphendula.
Noma nini lapho le ikhibhodi esebenzayo, ebonisiwe noma cha. Isebenzisa ibhethri eliningi.
Ayikho isevisi engemuva. Isixhumanisi sihlala ngaphakathi kwekhibhodi, ngakho ngisho i-Always iyaphela uma i-Android ivala ikhibhodi, futhi ukonga ibhethri kungayimisa okwesikhashana.
Ngenkathi ikhibhodi isesikrinini, nangomzuzu owodwa ngemva kwalokho.
Ngesikhathi iphaneli ye-KDE Connect ivuliwe kuphela. Ikhompyutha ayikwazi ukuthayipha noma ukuthumela ibhodi lokunamathisela ngezinye izikhathi.
Kunikeziwe. Kudingeka ukuze ubone ukuthi yini edlalwayo
Kudingeka ukuze ubone ukuthi yini edlalayo. Thepha ukuze unikeze imvume
Ikhompyutha ingamisa futhi yeqe okudlalayo lapha
Okungenalutho kusebenzisa imodeli yefoni. Izinhlamvu ezingama-32, akukho zimpawu zokuloba
Isicelo sokubhangqa, ifayela noma i-ping efike ngenkathi ikhibhodi ifihliwe
Ukuhamba kancane kunembile, ukuhamba ngokushesha kuya kude
U-%1$s ufuna ukubhangqa. Yamukela kuphela uma kukhombisa le khodi
Ilinde u-%1$s. Yamukela kukhompyutha uma ikhombisa le khodi
Valiwe: lokho ikhompyutha ekuthumelayo kuthayipheka ngqo. Kuvuliwe: ikhibhodi yesiLatini edeskini ibhala isiBengali nge-Avro, futhi iziphakamiso nokulungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo kuyasebenza.
Sebenzisa okhiye bayo ngesakhiwo sale khibhodi, njengekhibhodi yehadiwe
Ilondolozwe ku-Downloads, ku-WM Keyboard, futhi yengezwe emlandweni webhodi lokunamathisela
Ikhibhodi yayo ithayipha enkundleni, ngenkathi le ikhibhodi ibonakala futhi ifoni ivuliwe
Ezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza zingabelana nekhompyutha. Kuboniswa kuphela uma ikhompyutha isibhangqiwe
Iminwe emibili yokuchofoza kwesokudla, emithathu kwesiphakathi
Gcwalisa i-popup yohlamvu ngalunye ngesethi yalo ephelele yezimpawu zokugcizelela

Ibeka ngokuzenzakalelayo izindlela eziningi ezishintshanayo emgqeni njengoba zilingana esikrinini, ukuze ukuma kwe-popup kulandele ububanzi bezinhlamvu. Inombolo esuka ku-3 kuye ku-11 inika wonke umugqa lezo zikholamu zobubanzi obufanayo. Ukhiye onezindlela eziningi ezishintshanayo ufundeka njengebhulokhi, futhi indlela ngayinye eshintshanayo isendaweni efanayo njalo uma uyivula.
Mangaki amanye amagama ahamba emgqeni owodwa
Bamba, slayidela kokunye okufunayo, bese uyadedela
Gcwalisa i-popup kusuka kokhiye kuya ngaphandle

Lokhu kuphindaphinda usayizi wezinhlamvu ku-popup evulekayo uma ucindezela futhi ubambe ukhiye. Ifinyelela kude kunosayizi wefonti ye-popup ngenhla, ngoba i-popup yezinye izindlela ikhula ukuze ilingane nanoma yini oyibeka kuyo. I-bubble yokubuka kuqala igcina usayizi wayo, ngakho-ke inani elikhulu lapha aliyiphusheli uhlamvu ngaphandle kwe-bubble.

Ukucindezela okubili kwe-shift ngaphakathi kwalesi sikhathi kuvula i-caps lock. Isikhathi esifushane senza i-caps lock isheshe, kodwa iqala ngephutha kalula. Isikhathi eside samukela ukucindezela kabili okuhamba kancane. Okuzenzakalelayo kungu-350 ms.
Ukuthi ukucindezela okwesibili kwe-shift kuvula kanjani i-caps lock ngokushesha kangakanani

Ukhiye we-Ctrl kusakhiwo sangokwezifiso uvame ukusebenzisa u-A, C, V no-X ngezinto ze-clipboard ze-Android. Lokho kusebenza yonke indawo, kuhlanganise namakhasi ewebhu nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezakhiwe nge-Compose. Itheminali idinga umcimbi wokhiye oluhlaza esikhundleni salokho. Lapho i-Ctrl+C isho ukuphazamisa, hhayi ukukopisha. Ikhibhodi ayikwazi ukuhlukanisa lezi ezimbili, ngakho lokhu kuyisilungiselelo hhayi ukuqagela.
Okweziteshi. Okuthi \'Off\' kusho ukuthi u-Ctrl+A, C, V kanye no-X basebenzisa ibhodi lokunamathisela

Lawa angabalingiswa abaku-popup yokucindezela nokubamba okhiye be-$, ngokulandelana. Beka uhlobo lwakho lwemali kuqala. Hlukanisa abalingiswa ngezikhala. Gcina okuzenzakalelayo (৳ € £ ¥ ₹ ₿), noma usule inkambu ukuze ubuyisele isethi eyakhelwe ngaphakathi.

Le yisivinini sezikhiye ovule ukuphinda uma ubambe kuso kumhleli wesakhiwo sesikhiye, njengomugqa wezikhiye zomcibisholo. Ukususa nesikhala kugcina isivinini saso esingenhla. Amanani aphansi aphinda ngokushesha.
Ukuthi ukhiye owubekele ukuphindaphinda ushesha kangakanani ngenkathi uwubambile
Ngenkathi ubambe ukususa, kuphindaphindeka kulesi sikhathi. Amanani aphansi asusa ngokushesha.
Ukuthi ukususa kuphindaphinda ngokushesha kangakanani ngenkathi ukubambile

Ngokuzenzakalelayo ikhibhodi iyaqhubeka nokudlidliza uma i-Do Not Disturb ivuliwe. I-Do Not Disturb isebenza kuzaziso, hhayi ekuthinteni. Vula lokhu ukuze wenze ikhibhodi ithule ngokuphelele ngenkathi i-Do Not Disturb ivuliwe. Lesi silungiselelo sivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Misa konke ukudlidliza kwekhibhodi ngenkathi i-Do Not Disturb ivuliwe
Thulisa ukudlidliza kumodi ye-Do Not Disturb

Lokhu kubeka ukuthi ikhibhodi iyishayela kanzima kangakanani imoto yokudlidliza, kusuka ku-1 kuye ku-255. Okwe-Sharp ikala i-primitive yokuchofoza kwehadiwe. Ubude buhlala buqinile futhi amandla kuphela ashintshayo. Okwe-Custom kusebenza kuphela kumadivayisi lapho imoto yokudlidliza isekela ukulawulwa kwe-amplitude. Kwamanye amadivayisi ubude obungenhla kuphela obunomphumela. Ukulungiselelwa kokudlidliza kohlelo \"Touch feedback\" nakho kukala amandla okugcina.
Amandla okudlidliza kukho konke ukucindezela okhiye
Lobu ubude besigqi sokudlidliza ngama-millisecond. Imivimbo emide izwakala inamandla kumadivayisi amaningi.
Ubude bokudlidliza kukho konke ukucindezela ukhiye

I-Tap ne-Key yizitayela ezinconyiwe. Zinikeza ukudlidliza ku-haptic yokhiye wepulatifomu, ucingo olufanayo olusetshenziswa amakhibhodi ajwayelekile. Kumadivayisi alungisiwe uthola ukudlidliza komthengisi, futhi kulandela ukusethwa kokushuba kwe-haptic yesistimu. I-Tap icela umuzwa \"wokuthepha kwekhibhodi\". Abathengisi abaningi balungisa ukudlidliza okuhlukile kwamakhibhodi, futhi lokhu yikho okudlalwa ikhibhodi yabo, ngakho i-Tap iyisinqumo esizenzakalelayo. I-Key icela umuzwa \"wokhiye obonakalayo\", okuwukucindezela inkinobho okujwayelekile kwedivayisi. Sebenzisa i-Key uma i-Tap izwakala ingalungile kudivayisi yakho. I-Click ne-Heavy click zisebenzisa imiphumela ye-haptic yehadiwe yedivayisi yakho (Android 10 nangaphezulu). I-Sharp idlala i-primitive yokuchofoza yehadiwe (Android 11 nangaphezulu). Ukushaya okufushane, okunzima. Amandla ayo alandela isilayidi sokuqina. I-Custom ishayela imoto yokudlidliza ngokuqondile ngesilayidi sobude besikhathi namandla. Ayisebenzisi i-overdrive nokubopha kwehadiwe, ngakho izwakala ithambile. Uma isitayela singatholakali, ikhibhodi isebenzisa i-Click yehadiwe, bese kuba i-Custom.
Ukudlidliza okufushane kuqinisekisa ukucindezelwa kwenkinobho ngayinye. Lokhu kufaka phakathi isinyathelo ngasinye sokunyakaza kwekhesa kubha yesikhala. Ungashintsha isitayela namandla ngezansi.

Isenzo ngokuvamile sihlala ekupheleni kwe-popup, ngakho ukucindezela nokubamba okujwayelekile kukunika i-accent yokuqala. Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, isenzo sithuthela phambili, futhi ukucindezela nokubamba okukodwa kwezinkinobho zokunqamulela kwenza isenzo ngokushesha. Ama-accent asakhona: gcina umunwe wakho phansi bese uslayida uye kulowo owufunayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi \'Bamba ukuze ukhethe\', ngaphansi kwezinkinobho ezishintshanayo.
Ukucindezela nokubamba kwenza isenzo esikhundleni sokubonisa ama-accents

Isenzo ngasinye osikhethayo singena ku-popup yokucindezela nokubamba kokhiye waso, ngemva kwama-accent okhiye asevele enawo. Ukukopisha nokusika kuthatha okukhethiwe, noma wonke umbhalo uma ungakhethi lutho. Ukuhlehlisa nokwenza futhi kuthumela izinqamuleli ezifanayo namathuluzi ebha yamathuluzi. Khetha okhiye ngaphansi kokhiye bezinqamuleli. Ukuze usebenzise isenzo ngokucindezela nokubamba okujwayelekile esikhundleni salokho, vula Isenzo kuqala.
Hlela izenzo ku-popup yokucindezela nokubamba yokhiye wezinhlamvu
Izinqamuleli zokubamba zihlala ku-A, C, V, X, Z no-Y ngokuzenzakalelayo, okusebenza kuphela kusakhiwo esinalezinhlamvu. Zibeke okhiye abadwetshwa yisakhiwo sakho.
Yimuphi ukhiye okuhlala kuwo isinqamuleli sokubamba
Ukhiye wokususa obanjwe phansi uthatha amagama aphelele, hhayi izinhlamvu

Lokhu isikhathi osibamba ngaso inkinobho ngaphambi kokuba izinhlamvu zayo ezinye zivele. Ezinye izinhlamvu zingama-accent, izinombolo nezimpawu. Inani eliphansi liyashesha, kodwa i-popup ivuleka ngephutha kalula.
Isikhathi esingakanani obamba ngaso ukhiye ngaphambi kokuba izinhlamvu ezingezinye zivele

Ilebo elincane ekhoneni eliphezulu kwesokudla kukhiye ngamunye libonisa uhlamvu lokuqala lokucindezela nokubamba. Lona idijithi, uphawu noma i-accent ekuqaleni kwe-popup. Okhiye abasebenzisa isinqamuleli sebhodi lokunamathisela ngezansi ababonisi lutho.
Bonisa uhlamvu oluhlukile lwekihi ngayinye ekhoneni layo

Ikhibhodi idlidliza futhi uma uphakamisa umunwe wakho ekupheleni kokucindezela nokubamba. Lokhu kuqedela umjikelezo wokucindezela, ukubamba nokukhulula. Ivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo. Abanye abasebenzisi bathola ukuthi ukudlidliza kwesithathu kusezingeni eliphezulu kakhulu.
Dlidliza lapho ukhulula ngemva kokucindezela nokubamba

Ngokuzenzakalelayo ibhamuza lithatha umbala walo kusuka kutimu yekhibhodi. Khetha umbala lapha futhi ibhamuza lisebenzisa wona esikhundleni salokho. Setha kabusha umugqa ukuze ulandele itimu futhi. Leli ibhamuza lokubuka kuqala kuphela. Okhiye abashintshanayo, uhlu lwezilimi kanye namamenyu emaphanelini agcina umbala wetimu.
Lokhu kuphindaphinda usayizi wombhalo ngaphakathi kwebhamuza lohlamvu elivela ngenkathi ucindezela ukhiye, naku-popup yezinkinobho ezinye. Usayizi wamalebula okhiye awushintshi.
Usayizi wombhalo kubhamuza lokubuka kuqala kanye nezinkinobho ezinye

Lokhu ukuphakama kwebhamuza lohlamvu. Uma \"I-popup kukhiye\" ivuliwe, ikhibhodi ikukala kusukela phansi kokhiye ocindezelayo. Ibhamuza elide kunokhiye lidlulela ngaphezu kwawo futhi lihlale libonakala ngaphezu komunwe wakho. Izitayela ezimbili zebhamuza ngalinye zigcina ukuphakama kwazo, ngoba ibhamuza elintantayo liqala ngaphezu kokhiye futhi lidinga okuncane kulo. Vula noma uvale \"I-popup kukhiye\", futhi lesi silayidi sibonisa ukuphakama kwaleso sitayela.
Ngenkathi ubambe ukhiye, uhlamvu lwawo luntanta kubhamuza ngaphezu komunwe wakho. Lokhu kukuvumela ukuthi ubone ukhiye ocindezelwe.

I-bubble ngokuvamile iyanyamalala uma uphakamisa umunwe wakho. Uma ikhibhodi ihamba kancane, ikakhulukazi uma ifaka umugqa omusha, ingaphuthelwa ukukhishwa futhi i-bubble ihlale esikrinini. Leli umkhawulo onzima empilweni ye-bubble, olinganiselwa kusukela ekucindezeleni. Ngemuva kwalesi sikhathi i-bubble ihlale ifihla. Ngokungafani nobuncane, lokhu akukhona mayelana nokuzizwa. Ikhona kuphela ukuze ilulame ekukhishweni okulahlekile, ngakho yigcine iphezulu ngaphandle uma usabona i-bubble ehlala.
Umkhawulo ofihla ibhamuza elishiywe esikrinini ngenxa yokubambezeleka

Ekucindezeleni okusheshayo ikhibhodi ikhipha ukhiye cishe ngaso leso sikhathi, ngakho-ke ibhamuza lingaba ukukhanya okungabonakali. Ibhamuza lihlala ngemva kokukhululwa kuze kube yilapho selibonakale ngalesi sikhathi. Inani elingu-0 liyilifihla ngesikhathi uphakamisa umunwe wakho.
Ukuthi ibhamuza lihlala isikhathi esingakanani libonakala ngemva kokucindezela okusheshayo
Futhi bonisa ibhamuza ezinkambini zezinombolo, zocingo, nezinsuku
Hambisa ibhamuza elintantayo kwesobunxele noma kwesokudla sokhiye

Ibubhu elintantayo lihlala ngaphezu kokhiye ocindezelayo. Uma umunwe wakho uwumboza, khulisa leli banga uze ukwazi ukulifunda. Lokhu kusebenza kuphela ngenkathi \"I-popup kukhiye\" icishiwe. Ibubhu elikukhiye likhula liphuma kukhiye uqobo, ngakho alinalo ibanga lokusetha. Sebenzisa \"Ukuphakama kwe-popup\" kuleso sitayela.
Ukuthi ibhamuza elintantayo lihlala kude kangakanani ngaphezu kokhiye
Khulisa ibhamuza liye phezulu lisuka okhiyeleni ocindezelwe

Lokhu kuwububanzi bekhona bazo zonke izigelekeqe. Inani elingu-0 linikeza amakhona ayisikwele. Inani eliphezulu lenza amakhona abe yindilinga ngokuphelele. Izimo zezigelekeqe eziyindilinga nezinqunyiwe kuphela ezisebenzisa leli nani. Indikimba ingaphetha ububanzi bayo, futhi inqoba phezu kwalolu hlelo.
Uhlaka lwayo yonke i-popup, kusuka esikweleni kuya kumbuthano
Bonisa ibhamuza lohlamvu ngaphezu kokhiye ocindezelwe

Ukubamba i-backspace noma isikhala kuqala ukuphinda ngemva kwalesi sikhathi eside. Kwakujwayele ukwabelana ngokubambezeleka kokucindezela isikhathi eside, okusho ukuthi ukwehlisa ijubane le-accent popups nakho kwehlisa ijubane le-backspace. Manje sezehlukene. Lesi silungiselelo singu-300 ms ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Isikhathi eside kangakanani obamba ngaso ukhiye wokubuyisela emuva noma isikhala ngaphambi kokuba uqale ukuphindaphinda

Lokhu kwengeza uhlamvu ngalunye ukhiye othayipha ngaphansi kwe-shift, okuyinhlamvu enkulu ezinhlelweni zesiLatini, ekupheleni kokucindezela nokubamba kwayo. Ukhiye osevele uwufakile ushiywa unjalo. Kuyasiza kakhulu ngokwayipha kusuka kokhiye be-?123 ne-ABC: leso senzo sithayipha ukhiye owodwa kusuka kolunye ungqimba, futhi ukhiye we-shift usungqimbeni umunwe wakho owushiyile. Lesi silungiselelo sicishiwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Engeza uhlamvu olukhulu luhlamvu ngalunye ku-popup yalo

Uma ubambe i-backspace noma isikhala, ukhiye uyaphindaphinda. Ngokuzenzakalelayo ukuphindaphinda ngakunye kudlala umsindo wokhiye, ongazwakala njengesibhamu somshini ngenkathi ususa umugqa. Cisha lokhu ukuze uzwe ukucindezela kokuqala kuphela. Ukudlidliza kwehlukile, ngenhla. Lesi silungiselelo sivuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo futhi asenzi lutho ngaphandle uma umsindo wokhiye uvuliwe.
Dlala umsindo wokhiye ekuphindaphindeni ngakunye ngenkathi ubambe ukhiye

Ngenkathi ubambe ibha yesikhala, iphindaphinda kulesi sikhathi. Isikhala sinenani laso ngoba ukulandelana kwezikhala kunzima ukukulungisa kunokulandelana kokususwa. Sebenzisa inani eliphakeme lapha ukuze wenze kube kancane.
Ukuthi isikhala siphindaphindeka ngokushesha kangakanani ngenkathi usibambile

Ngokuvamile ukhiye u-?123 ushintsha kuphela uye kungqimba lwezimpawu. Ngalolu hlelo luvuliwe, lubambe ukuze uvule iphaneli yephedi yezinombolo phezu kwanoma iyiphi inkundla. Uthola iphedi yezinombolo egcwele ngaphandle kokushiya ibhokisi lombhalo lamanje. Ukucindezela okusheshayo kusashintsha ungqimba.
Cindezela ubambe ukhiye wezimpawu ukuze uvule iphedi yezinombolo
Cindezela ubambe u-?123 ukuze uthole iphedi yezinombolo

Ngokuzenzakalelayo ikhibhodi iyaqhubeka nokudlidliza ngisho noma uvala impendulo yokuthinta kuzilungiselelo zomsindo ze-Android, ngoba ikhibhodi inokushintsha kwayo kwayo. Vula lokhu uma ulindele ukuthi ukulungiselelwa kwesistimu kuhlanganise nekhibhodi futhi. Lokhu kulungiselelwa kuvaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Vumela ukudlidliza kokuthinta kwe-Android kuthulise nekhibhodi

Uma uswayiphela kwesobunxele kukhiye we-backspace, ikhibhodi isusa igama negama futhi idlidlizele igama ngalinye. Vala lokhu ukuze ususe umusho ngokuhudula okukodwa okushelelayo ngaphandle kokudlidliza. Ukucindezela okujwayelekile ku-backspace akushintshi. Lesi silungiselelo sivuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Dlidliza ngezwi ngalinye elisuswa ngokuswayipha ukususa

Uma ubambe i-backspace noma isikhala, ukhiye uyaphinda. Ngokuzenzakalelayo ukuphinda ngakunye kuyadlidliza. Vala lokhu ukuze udlidlize ekucindezeleni kokuqala kuphela futhi ugcine ukuphinda kuthule. Umsindo wokhiye wawo usadlalwa uma uvuliwe. Lesi silungiselelo sivuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Dlidliza ekubuyaphindeni ngakunye ngenkathi ubambe ukhiye

Vala lokhu ukuze umise ukudlidliza kwebha yesikhala kuphela. Zonke ezinye izinkinobho zizoqhubeka nokudlidliza. Lokhu kuyasiza uma ibha yesikhala ende izwakala isinda ngaphansi kwesithupha sakho. Umsindo wokucindezela inkinobho usazwakala uma uvuliwe. Lesi silungiselelo sivuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.

Ngenkathi ubambe ukususa futhi kusula amagama, kuthatha igama elilodwa kulesi sikhathi. Kuhamba kancane kunesikhathi sezinhlamvu esingenhla ngenhloso, ngoba igama elilodwa liyisinyathelo esikhulu kakhulu. Amanani aphansi asula ngokushesha.
Ukuthi ukhiye wokususa obanjwe phansi ususa amagama ngokushesha kangakanani

Cindezela bese ubamba i-emoji kuphaneli ye-emoji ukuze ubone inguqulo enyakazayo, kanye nesilawuli esiyithumela njengesithombe. Lezi zithombe ziyizi-Noto Animated Emoji zakwa-Google, ngaphansi kwelayisensi ye-CC BY 4.0. Ikhibhodi ilanda ngayinye ku-Google uma uyicela, cishe ngama-800 KB. Cishe ama-emoji angu-880 anayo, kanti isilawuli asiveli kweminye, noma kuhlelo lokusebenza olungamukeli zithombe.
Thumela inguqulo ehambayo ye-emoji kusuka ku-popup yayo yokucindezela nokubamba
Umugqa uhlala phakathi kwebha yamathuluzi nokhiye
Inkinobho ekugcineni kwesokudla kwebha yamathuluzi ivula umugqa

Umugqa uhlukanisa ububanzi bawo ube yizikhala eziningi futhi wenza i-emoji ibe ncane ngokwanele ukuba ilingane nazo. Inombolo ephezulu inikeza ama-emoji amancane aseduze kakhulu. Uma ukuphequla kuvaliwe, umugqa ufihla ama-emoji ngemuva kwesikhala sokugcina. Uma ukuphequla kuvuliwe, ukuswayipha kuyawabonisa.
Mangaki alingana kulo lonke. Inombolo ephezulu iwapakisha kakhulu

\"Umugqa uqobo\" ugcina umugqa we-emoji phakathi kwebha yamathuluzi nezinkinobho ngaso sonke isikhathi. \"Inkinobho\" yengeza inkinobho ekugcineni kwesokudla kwebha yamathuluzi. Inkinobho ishintsha umugqa wokusikisela ibe umugqa we-emoji. \"Valiwe\" ifihla kokubili.
Awukho umugqa we-emoji futhi ayikho inkinobho yawo

Uma lokhu kucishiwe, okuyinto ezenzakalelayo, umugqa awunyakazi. Ubonisa kuphela ama-emoji alinganayo, ngakho ukuswayiphela eceleni akukwazi ukuwuhambisa ngaphansi komunwe wakho. Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, ungaskrola uye kwamanye ama-emoji.
Swayiphela eceleni ukuze uthole ama-emoji ngemva kwalawo abonakalayo

Iphaneli ye-emoji ithumela izigaba zayo ngokulandelana kwe-Unicode, okungelona neze uhlelo ozisebenzisa ngalo. Hudula isigaba ukuze uhambise ithebhu yaso, bese ucindezela iso ukuze ufihle ithebhu ongayivuli neze. Cindezela isigaba ukuze uhlele ama-emoji akuso: cindezela ubambe elilodwa, bese ulihudulela lapho ufuna libe khona. Ithebhu yakamuva, kanye namathebhu e-Kaomoji nama-Emoticon, awabhalwanga lapha — Okwakamuva kuzihlela ngokusebenziseka, kanti amanye amabili avulwa futhi avalwe ngenhla.

Isigaba ngasinye sibuyela ekulandelaneni kwe-Unicode, ithebhu ngayinye efihliwe iyabuya, futhi ama-emoji angaphakathi kwesigaba ngasinye abuyela ekulandelaneni kwawo kwikhathalogi. Okusanda kusetshenziswa, okuthandayo kanye nemibala yesikhumba akuthintwa.
Buyisela amathebhu, afihliwe kanye ne-emoji esigabeni ngasinye ngendlela ababephume ngayo
Hlela kabusha amathebhu, fihla lawo ongawavuli neze, futhi uhlele ama-emoji ngaphakathi kwalinye nalalinye

Ithebhu yomlando iyathululwa, izintandokazi zakho ziyakhishwa, futhi ithoni yesikhumba ekhethelwe i-emoji ngayinye ibuyela kokuzenzakalelayo. Ama-emoji ngokwawo awathinteki. Lokhu akukwazi ukuhlehliswa.
Khohlwa okusanda kusetshenziswa, izibalo zokusetshenziswa, izintandokazi nokukhethwa kwethoni yesikhumba
Lokhu kwengeza inkinobho ethi \"Sula okusanda kusetshenziswa\" kuthebhu ethi Okusanda kusetshenziswa yephaneli ye-emoji. Ivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo, ukuze ithebhu ihlale ihlanzekile.
Inkinobho kuthebhu yakamuva esusa uhlu lwezinto zakamuva

Ngokuzenzakalelayo, iphaneli yama-emoji nephaneli yebhodi lokunamathisela zihlala zivuliwe, ukuze ukwazi ukukhetha izinto eziningi. Vula lokhu ukuze ubuyele ezinkinobho ngokushesha ngemva kwe-emoji eyodwa noma ukunamathisela okukodwa kwebhodi lokunamathisela.
Vala iphaneli uma ufaka i-emoji eyodwa noma unamathisela isiqeshana esisodwa
Ifayela lefonti ye-emoji elilodwa olingenisa ngezansi

\"Isistimu\" isebenzisa iphakethe le-emoji ledivayisi yakho. Kumadivayisi akwa-Samsung lokho kuyisethi yakwa-Samsung. \"I-Google\" ilanda i-Noto Color Emoji, ukubukeka okujwayelekile kwe-Android, kanye ngomunye umthombo wefonti yesistimu, futhi ikugcina kudivayisi yakho. \"Okufakiwe\" kusebenzisa ifonti ye-emoji evela kuma-Addon, njenge-Twemoji noma i-OpenMoji. \"Okungokwezifiso\" kusebenzisa ifayela lefonti ye-emoji elilodwa olilayishayo ngezansi. Umbhalo owuthumelayo uhlale uyi-Unicode elula. Ezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza namanye amadivayisi ayidweba ngefonti yabo ye-emoji.
Ifonti ye-emoji evela kuma-Addon, njenge-Twemoji noma i-OpenMoji
Ilanda i-Noto Color Emoji yamanje, enama-emoji amasha kuyo. Cishe u-%1$s. Inketho ethi \"Google\" ngenhla ingasebenzisa kuphela inguqulo idivayisi yakho eseyinayo.
Awuzange ungenise ifonti ye-emoji. Ikhibhodi isebenzisa ifonti yohlelo kuze kube yilapho ungenisa eyodwa.
I-Noto Color Emoji, ukubukeka okujwayelekile kwe-Android
Ukuthi ama-emoji abukeka kanjani kukhibhodi uqobo
Inguqulo %1$s ye-Noto Color Emoji isiphume, enama-emoji ikhophi yakho engenayo. Mayelana ne-%2$s.
Ayikho imithombo yezinhlamvu ye-emoji efakiwe. Faka eyodwa kusuka kuma-Addon, njenge-Twemoji noma i-OpenMoji. Ungaphinda ungenise ifayela elilodwa ngesilungiselelo esithi \"Custom\".

Iphaneli ye-emoji igcwalisa ikhibhodi yonke. Ibha yamathuluzi, umugqa we-emoji kanye nomugqa wezimpawu kuyanyamalala. Amathebhu esigaba athuthela emugqeni abawushiyayo, eduze kwenkinobho yokubuyela emuva. Cisha lokhu ukuze ugcine ibha yamathuluzi iseduze ngenkathi ukhetha i-emoji.
Fihla ibha yamathuluzi bese uhambisa amathebhu esigaba phezulu, eduze kwenkinobho yokubuyela emuva

Iphaneli ye-emoji ilingana nezinsika eziningi njengoba ububanzi bayo buvumela, futhi iseli ngalinye libanzi okungenani ngalokhu. Usayizi omncane ufaka ama-emoji amaningi esikrinini esisodwa. Usayizi omkhulu uwahlakaza, futhi ngalinye kulula ukulishaya. Lapho usayizi we-emoji ngezansi udinga indawo engaphezu kwalokhu, amaseli ayakhula ukuze alingane nawo.
Ububanzi beseli ngayinye yegridi ye-emoji, okungenani. Usayizi omncane uvumela amakholomu amaningi

Amadivayisi amadala, nemikhiqizo ethile, anefonti ye-emoji endala kune-emoji entsha. Lezo emoji bese zibonakala njengebhokisi elingenalutho \"tofu\". Lesi silungiselelo sifihla yonke i-emoji ifonti ye-emoji yedivayisi yakho engakwazi ukuyidweba. Ukuze uzibone zonke, setha ifonti ye-emoji ngenhla ibe \"Google\" (Noto Color Emoji). Ungaphinda ufake ifonti ye-emoji ephelele kusuka kuma-Addon, njenge-Twemoji noma i-OpenMoji. I-WM Keyboard ayinayo ifonti yayo ye-emoji. Isebenzisa ifonti oyikhetha lapha.

Ifonti oyikhethile ngenhla ihlanganisa kuphela ama-emoji eyakhelwe kuwo. Ngokuvamile ukukhishwa okusha kuphela okunamathikithi ama-emoji amasha. Ikhibhodi ayiwafihli lawo ma-emoji. Iyadweba ngamunye kufonti ye-emoji yedivayisi yakho, ngakho usawubona, kodwa ngesinye isitayela.
Yeqa ama-emoji abonakala njengebhokisi elingenalutho kuphaneli, ekusesheni naseziphakamisweni
Fihla ama-emoji idivayisi yakho engakwazi ukuwabonisa
Thayipha usuku lokuzalwa, cindezela u-🎂, bese uthola usuku lokuzalwa 🎂

\"Replace word\" ishintsha igama olibhalile libe yi-emoji. Uma ubhala usuku lokuzalwa bese ucindezela u-🎂, u-🎂 kuphela osalayo, njengaku-Gboard. \"Keep word\" yengeza i-emoji ngemva kwegama: usuku lokuzalwa 🎂.
Thayipha usuku lokuzalwa, cindezela 🎂, bese 🎂 kuphela okusalayo

Lokhu kungeza ithebhu ye-Kaomoji kanye nethebhu yezithonjana ekupheleni kwamathebhu wephaneli ye-emoji. Ama-Kaomoji ubuso besitayela saseJapane, njenge (╯°□°）╯︵ ┻━┻. Izithonjana yilezo ze-ASCII zaseNtshonalanga, njenge :-D kanye ne <3. Zombili izithebhu zizihlela ngokwemizwa. Uma ucindezela eyodwa, ikhibhodi iyayithayipha njengombhalo ovamile. Ayiyi emlandweni wakho we-emoji.
Landa noma ngenisa amagama angukhiye ukuze useshe ama-emoji ngolunye ulimi

Cindezela ubambe i-emoji ukuze ubonise igama layo le-Unicode, njenge-\"skull and crossbones\". Igama livela ngenhla kwesilawuli sezintandokazi nezilawuli zokuhlukahluka. Lokhu kukusiza ukubona umehluko phakathi kwama-emoji abukeka ecishe afane.
Bonisa igama le-emoji phezulu kokuvela kwayo uma ucindezela ubambe
Cindezela ubambe i-emoji, bese uyihudulela lapho ufuna ibe khona.
Usayizi wegridi, izigaba, izintandokazi kanye nezisanda kusetshenziswa
Ama-Emoji afanayo avela ekupheleni komugqa wesiphakamiso ngenkathi uthayipha. Lokhu kusebenza ngesiNgisi nanoma yiluphi ulimi onamagama angukhiye alo. I-%1$s iphinde iphakamise u-🎂.
Bonisa i-emoji ngenkathi uthayipha. Igama elithi birthday liphakamisa 🎂 🎉 🥳

Ithebhu yomlando ibala izintandokazi zakho kuqala bese kuba ama-emoji owasebenzise muva nje. Amashumi amathathu nambili cishe umugqa owodwa ocingweni oluncane kanye nemine kuthebhulethi, ngakho-ke yikhuphule uma umlando uzwakala umfushane kakhulu. Ukuyehlisa kususa uhlu ngokushesha. Lesi silungiselelo singu-32 ngokuzenzakalelayo.

Usayizi we-emoji kugridi yepaneli ye-emoji, kuthebhu ngayinye naseziphumeni zokusesha. Amaseli ahlala enendawo eyanele ezungeze i-emoji ngayinye, ngakho usayizi omkhulu kakhulu ungasho nezinsika ezimbalwa. I-popup yokucindezela nokubamba igcina usayizi wayo.
Ukuthi iphaneli ye-emoji idweba i-emoji ngayinye ngobukhulu obungakanani

Ikhibhodi ikhombisa ama-emoji anethoni (👍, 🙏, 🧑…) ngale thoni ye-Fitzpatrick kugridi yephaneli ye-emoji, umugqa weziphakamiso kanye nemiphumela yokusesha i-emoji. Iphinde iwafake ngaleyo thoni. I-emoji okhethele yona ithoni igcina ithoni yakho ngenkathi \"Override with last used\" ivuliwe. Inketho yokuqala (✋) igcina isisekelo esiphuzi esingathathi hlangothi.
Okwe-emoji enethoni kuphaneli, iziphakamiso kanye nokusesha

Cindezela ubambe i-emoji kuphaneli ye-emoji ukuze uthole isilawuli esiyithumela njengesithombe, ngefonti ye-emoji oyikhethile. Lokhu kuwusizo uma omunye umuntu enedivayisi edweba i-emoji ngendlela ehlukile, noma engakwazi ukuyidweba nhlobo. Ikhibhodi idweba isithombe kudivayisi yakho futhi ayilandi lutho, ngaphandle kokukodwa kwefonti ye-emoji yakwa-Google. Isithombe siphuma ngendlela efanayo nezitika zethuluzi lezitika. Ukuze ushintshe lokho, vula Amathuluzi, bese Izitika, bese \"Thumela izitika njenge\". Isilawuli asiveli kuhlelo lokusebenza olungamukeli zithombe.
Engeza isilawuli esithumela i-emoji uqobo njengesithombe

I-“Recent” ibala ama-emoji ngokulandelana owasebenzise ngakho okokugcina. I-“Most used” ibeka ama-emoji owasebenzisa kakhulu kuqala. Ikhibhodi ihlale igcina ama-emoji owathandayo ekuqaleni kwazo zombili izinhlu.
Ithiphu: cindezela ubambe noma iyiphi i-emoji kuphaneli ukuze uyenze ibe intandokazi noma ukukhetha amathoni esikhumba. Nge-emoji enabantu ababili, njenge-🤝, ungasetha ithoni yomuntu ngamunye.

Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, futhi kuvuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo, i-emoji osuvele ukhethe ithoni yayo igcina leyo thoni kuyo yonke indawo: kuphaneli, eziphakamisweni nasekusesheni. Ukhetha leyo thoni kusuka kokuvela uma ucindezela ubambe i-emoji kuphaneli. I-emoji ayisebenzisi okuzenzakalelayo okungenhla. Uma lokhu kuvaliwe, ithoni yesikhumba ezenzakalelayo ihlale inqoba.
Sebenzisa ithoni oyikhethe okokugcina nge-emoji, hhayi eyenzakalelayo

Inkinobho ye-emoji ihlala ibonakala kubha engenhla, ngenkathi iziphakamiso zibonisa. Iphaneli ye-emoji inethebhu yesigaba ngasinye. Ungasesha ngesiNgisi nangesi-Bengali, nanoma yiluphi ulimi ongeza iphakethe lamagama angukhiye kulo. Cindezela ubambe i-emoji ukuze uthole izinhlobo zethoni yesikhumba.
Vula ama-emoji ngokucindezela kanye kusuka kubha engaphezulu

Lokhu kubeka igama lohlelo lokusebenza phambi kolimi kulebula yesishintshi. I-Android inquma ukuthi ilibeka kanjani ilebula negama lohlelo lokusebenza, njengokuthi yikuphi okugqamile noma okumpunga. Lesi silungiselelo sishintsha kuphela umbhalo welebula, hhayi lokho kusetha.

Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, ikhibhodi ilanda amafayela amancane ulimi oluwadingayo, uma uluveza futhi uma olusha lushicilelwe: amagama angukhiye we-emoji, ukuze izimpendulo zosesho lwe-emoji zibe ngolimi lwakho, nedatha yokubhangqa amagama, okwenza izibikezelo zibe ngcono. Izinhlu zamagama azilande nhlobo ngokuzenzakalelayo. Uma lokhu kuvaliwe, akukho lutho olulandwayo kuze kube yilapho ulucela esikrinini solimi.
Thola amagama angukhiye we-emoji nedatha yokubikezela ngezilimi ozisebenzisayo

Ukungeza ulimi olubhalwe ngesi-Roman njenge-Banglish kuluxhumanisa nezinye izilimi ezabelana ngombhalo walo, ngakho iziphakamiso zivela kuzo zombili. Ukuxhumanisa kwenzeka njalo uma ungeza ulimi, okusho ukuthi isixhumanisi osisuse ngesandla sizobuya. Vala lokhu ukuze ugcine izinqumo zakho. Lesi silungiselelo sivuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Bhangqa ulimi olubhalwe ngezinhlamvu zesi-Roman nezilimi olubhalwa nazo

Yonke uhlelo lokusebenza lubuyela ekulandeni ulimi lwakho lokugcina olusetshenzisiwe. Isilungiselelo esibakhumbulayo sihlala sivuliwe, ngakho-ke izinhlelo zokusebenza zizoqala ukukhunjulwa futhi njengoba ushintsha ulimi ngaphakathi kwazo.

plurals.item: Uhlelo lokusebenza olulodwa lunolimi olubhalwe kulo

resources.string: Yonke imiklamo oyivulayo inemodi yayo yokufaka. Sebenzisa ukhiye we-🌐 noma uswayiphe ibha yesikhala ukuze ushintshe phakathi kwayo.
Zenzela eyakho igridi yezinkinobho, noma uqale ngaleyo eyakhelwe ngaphakathi
Qinisekisa ukulandwa kolimi uma ungekho ku-Wi-Fi
Engeza ulimi ngalunye kusishintshi sendlela yokufaka sohlelo

Uma ushintsha ulimi ngenkathi uthayipha kuhlelo lokusebenza, ikhibhodi iyakhumbula ukukhetha kwakho kwalolo hlelo. Ikhibhodi isebenzisa lolo limi futhi ngesikhathi esilandelayo lapho uthayipha khona. Ungashintsha ulimi ngokusebenzisa ukhiye we-🌐, ukuswayipha ibha yesikhala (spacebar), noma isikhethi. Izinhlelo zokusebenza lapho ungakhethanga ulimi zisebenzisa ulimi lwakho lokugcina. Inkambu edinga izinhlamvu zesiLatini, njengebhokisi lephasiwedi, isaqhubeka nokukwenza lokhu. Inkambu enikeza ulimi lwayo nayo iyakuqeda lokhu.
Vula uhlelo lokusebenza ngalunye ngesakhiwo osisebenzise lapho okokugcina
I-Android 13 nezindala: khetha ulimi ngalunye lapha, kungenjalo isishintshi sibonisa olulodwa kuphela
Uhlu lwe-Android. Lusebenzise kuphela uma isishintshi sibukeka singalungile
I-%1$s ne-%2$s manje ziphakamisana amagama. Ungakushintsha lokhu ekhasini lolimi ngalunye.
I-Double Pinyin: thayipha isilabhili ngasinye ngezinkinobho ezimbili ncamashi. Idinga isichazamazwi se-Pinyin esingenhla.
Landa isichazamazwi sokuguqula esikhulu. Siphethe izinhlamvu nemisho eminingi kunesethi eyakhelwe ngaphakathi. Isebenza ungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi ngemuva kokulanda.
Uhlelo lokusebenza lufunde %1$s lwengeza izinhlamvu ezingu-%2$d.
Lelo fayela liyingqikithi ye-FlorisBoard noma isandiso sekhibhodi, hhayi iphakethe lolimi. Ukuze ungenise ingqikithi, iya ku-Themes.
Funda iphakethe lolimi lwe-FlorisBoard (.flex). Lingagcwalisa amatafula e-Cangjie nawemivimbo ngenhla.
Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazi ukufunda lelo fayela njengephakethe lolimi lwe-FlorisBoard.
Leli phakethe liqukethe %1$s. Le khibhodi ithayipha i-Cangjie ne-stroke, ngakho-ke akukho lutho kulo olungasetshenziswa.

Khetha imisindo ofuna ifaniswe. Yonke ivuliwe ekuqaleni. Ukucisha okubhangqiwe kwenza isipelingi sakho sibe yiqiniso futhi, okukunika ukunemba okuthile: okubhangqiwe kokugcina kuwukugcizelela kwesifunda futhi akukubizi kakhulu, kuyilapho u-n↔l ethinta wonke ama-syllable aqala nganoma yikuphi.
Qhathanisa imisindo edidayo: zh↔z, ch↔c, sh↔s, n↔l, an↔ang, in↔ing…
Qondanisa imisindo ehlanganisiwe: n↔l, ng↔∅, gw→g ngaphambi kuka -o, -ng↔-n, -k↔-t…

Ezinhlelweni ze-Flick ne-Kana JIS, i-kana encane, i-゛ noma i-゜ iyisihluthulelo esengeziwe. Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, i-kana elula nayo ihambisana nalezo zinhlobo: か ithola が, つ ithola っ ne-づ, は ithola ば ne-ぱ, や ithola ゃ. Lapho amagama amabili evame kakhulu ngokulinganayo, lelo olithayiphe ngqo liza kuqala. I-kana oyithayiphe ngophawu ayishintshi, futhi ukuthayipha kwe-Romaji akushintshi.
I-かつこう iphinde ithole i-学校 (がっこう)
Amagama esifunda. I-Taiwan ne-Hong Kong ngokuvamile zisebenzisa amagama ahlukene entweni efanayo, hhayi izinhlamvu ezihlukene kuphela.

Ikhibhodi iguqula umuntu ngamunye kusuka kokulula (简体) kuya kokudala (繁體) ngaphambi kokuba ikubonise. Ukuguqulwa kufunda uhlamvu olulodwa ngesikhathi. Izinhlamvu ezimbalwa ezilula zinohlobo olungaphezu kolulodwa lwendabuko, futhi ikhibhodi ihlale ibhala leyo evame kakhulu. 发 iba ngu-發, okuyiqiniso ku-發展 kodwa okungalungile ku-頭髮. Lungisa lawo magama ngesandla.
Ikhibhodi iguqula izinhlamvu zibe isiShayina sendabuko (繁體). Iguqula uhlamvu olulodwa ngesikhathi, ngakho ezinye izinhlobo ezincike kumongo azilungile (发 → 發 / 髮).

I-Backspace ngokuvamile isusa ikhodi eyodwa ngesikhathi. Lokhu kwesinye isikhathi kushiya amaqoqo angaphelele esikrinini. Ngalolu hlelo oluvuliwe, ukucindezela okukodwa kususa iqoqo lonke ngenkathi uthayipha %1$s. Ezinye izilimi zigcina izilungiselelo zazo.
Susa iqoqo lonke elinjenge-%1$s njengeyunithi eyodwa
I-%1$s inohlu lwamagama olulandiwe noma amagama angukhiye we-emoji. Uyafuna ukuzisusa futhi uthole cishe i-%2$s yesikhala sokugcina?

Ikhibhodi ingalanda idatha %1$s edingayo ukuze ibikezele futhi ilungise kahle: uhlu lwamagama, amagama angukhiye we-emoji nedatha yamagama amabili, noma yikuphi kwalokho okukhona. Lokhu kusebenzisa cishe %2$s yedatha. Ungaphinda uzilande kamuva kusuka esikrinini solimi.
Into ngayinye isebenza ungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi ngemva kokulanda. Ibhokisi lokuhlola licisha into futhi ligcine ifayela. Susa isusa ifayela kudivayisi.
Izinhlamvu ezibhalwa ikhibhodi yemfashini. Futhi zingashintshwa kusuka emgqeni ongaphezu kwezikhiye.

Ukubamba ukhiye Wokukhetha kuvula imodi yokukhetha inqobo nje uma uwubambile. Uma unika lo khiye ezinye izinketho, ukucindezela isikhathi eside kuvula zona esikhundleni salokho futhi ukubamba ukuze ukhethe kuyayeka ukusebenza kuwo. Ngenkathi lesi sakhiwo sisikrinini, ikhibhodi isebenzisa le timu. Ithatha indawo yetimu oyibeke kwenye indawo, kanye nambili ezenzakalelayo ezikhanyayo nezimnyama, inqobo nje uma isakhiwo sibonisa. Ungqimba olunetimu yalo lusebenzisa leyo esikhundleni salokho. Ukukhetha kwakho akushintshi.

Isibambo sokushintsha usayizi kuphaneli entantayo sishintsha lokhu ngokuhudula. Isilayidi silapha ukuze ukwazi ukusetha ukuphakama okuqondile, futhi uhlehlise ukuhudula okudlulele. Lesi silungiselelo siseku-100% ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Ukuthi iphaneli entantayo inde kangakanani, njengesabelo sobude bokhiye obujwayelekile

Ikhibhodi iba yiphaneli encane entantayo ngaphezu kwezinhlelo zokusebenza, futhi ayinamatheli phansi kwesikrini. Hudula iphilisi eliphezulu lephaneli ukuze uyihambise. Hudula isibambo sekhona ukuze ushintshe usayizi. Cindezela inkinobho yokunamathela ukuze ubuyele kukhibhodi evamile. Izinhlelo zokusebenza azishintshi usayizi ngenkathi iphaneli intanta, futhi ukuthinta ngaphandle kwephaneli kuya kuhlelo lokusebenza.
Lobu ububanzi bephaneli entantayo. Ukuphakama kokhiye kusalandela izilayidi ezingenhla.

Ukhiye u-🌐 emgqeni ongezansi uvula iphaneli ye-emoji futhi awushintshi ulimi. Usengakwazi ukushintsha ulimi kusuka kubha yesikhala. Setha ukuswayipha ku-\"Ulimi\" ngaphansi kokuthi Ukuthayipha → Ukuthinta. Ukuswayipha okufushane kwenza lokhu ngokuzenzakalelayo. Valela lokhu ukuze ubuyisele ukhiye u-🌐.

Ayikho imiphumela ngenkathi ukhiye we-🌐 ufihliwe
Okhiye abade kulula ukubacindezela, kodwa ikhibhodi imboza ingxenye enkulu yesikrini. Amaphaneli e-emoji, ibhodi lokunamathisela kanye neziqephu nawo ashintsha usayizi ngaleli nani.
Ukuphakama komugqa ngamunye wokhiye, okubeka ukuphakama okuphelele kwekhibhodi

Lokhu kushintsha isikhala esizungeze ukhiye ngamunye. Inani elikhulu lihambisa izikhiye zihlukane futhi lenze ikhibhodi ibe phezulu kancane, ngoba igebe liyingxenye yomugqa ngamunye. Inani elincane lihambisa izikhiye zisondele ndawonye. Okuzenzakalelayo amaphesenti ayi-100.
Lapho ikhibhodi emincane ihlala khona: emaphethelweni angakwesobunxele, phakathi, noma emaphethelweni angakwesokudla.
Yenza ikhibhodi yonke ibe ncane noma ibe nkulu kulesi sikrini

Ngaphansi kwamaphesenti ayi-100 ikhibhodi ayigcwalisi isikrini sonke. Khetha onqenqemeni elihlala kulo ngezansi. Lokhu kuyasiza ezikrinini ezibanzi kakhulu. Imodi yesandla esisodwa ngezansi isethi elungiselelwe ngokushesha, futhi ithatha indawo yaleli nani ngenkathi ivuliwe.
Ulayini omfushane wezinombolo wenza ukufinyelela kuzinombolo kusheshe. Wengeza ukuphakama okuncane kukhibhodi kunomugqa ogcwele.
Ukuphakama komugqa wedijithi, okuhlukile kokhiye bezinhlamvu

Ulayini wezinombolo uhlala endaweni yawo uma ushintshela kusendlalelo sezimpawu. Lokhu kuyisilungiselelo esizenzakalelayo. Sivala ukuze ususe ulayini wezinombolo kusendlalelo se-?123 futhi uwugcine ezinhlamvwini. Isendlalelo sezimpawu sesivele sinomugqa waso ongaphezulu. Uma lokhu kuvaliwe, ikhibhodi iba mfushane ngomugqa owodwa kusendlalelo sezimpawu.

Ikhibhodi yengeza umugqa wezinombolo kusuka ku-1 kuye ku-0 ngaphezu kokhiye bezinhlamvu, ukuze ungacindezeli ubambe idijithi. Izinombolo ezikucindezelweni nokubamba komugqa wezinhlamvu ophezulu azitholakali ngenkathi lokhu kuvuliwe. Ikhibhodi iba umugqa owodwa mude.

Ngenkathi ubambe ushift kusakhiwo sezinhlamvu, umugqa wezinombolo ubonisa umugqa ogcwele wesendlalelo sezimpawu (= \ < > [ ] { } | ~) esikhundleni samadijithi. Ufinyelela lezo zimpawu ngoshift owodwa, futhi awushintsheli kusendlalelo sezimpawu. Kusendlalelo sesibili sezimpawu, umugqa wezinombolo usuvele ubonisa izimpawu eziningi zomcibisholo neziqhathaniso.
Cindezela ubambe u-shift ukuze ushintshe umugqa wezinombolo ube yizimpawu
Okhiye bakhombisa ama-glyph, kodwa bahlala bethayipha u-0-9

Ukhetha ama-glyph edijithi yolimi ngalunye ngaphansi kwezilimi → ulimi → Izinombolo. Lesi silungiselelo silawula lapho ikhibhodi ithayipha khona lawo ma-glyph. \"Izinkambu zombhalo\" yisilungiselelo esizenzakalelayo. Ithayipha u-0-9 ezinkambini zezinombolo, zocingo, zedethi nesikhathi, okuzigcina zifundeka ngomshini. Kuzo zonke ezinye izinkambu ithayipha amadijithi omdabu. \"Yonke indawo\" ithayipha amadijithi omdabu kulezo zinkambu futhi. \"Bonisa kuphela\" kubonisa ama-glyph okhiye kodwa kuhlale kuthayipha u-0-9.

Usetha amadijithi olimi ngalunye ngaphansi kwezilimi. Amadijithi angama-Latin 0-9, Arabic ٠-٩, Persian ۰-۹, Bengali ০-৯ kanye ne-Devanagari ०-९.
Ungasetha imodi yesandla esisodwa ekujwayeleni ngakunye. Ekhibhodi, umcibisholo osemzileni ushintsha uhlangothi futhi uwulondoloze lapha kulokho kujwayela.
Lokhu kushintsha ukuphakama kokhiye ngenkathi imodi yesandla esisodwa ivuliwe, futhi kwehlisa imigqa engaphezulu ukuze ifinyeleleke ngesithupha. Amaphesenti ayi-100 agcina ukuphakama okujwayelekile.
