Lena yingxenye yobubanzi besikrini ikhibhodi eyisebenzisayo ngenkathi imodi yesandla esisodwa ivuliwe. Ujantshi nesikhala esingenalutho kugcwalisa okunye, kueleke phakathi.

Osayizi abangenhla yibona osayizi besikrini esime mpo (esigoqiwe). Isikrini esivundlile noma esingagoqiwe singangena esikhundleni sanoma yisiphi sazo, noma sikale ikhibhodi yonke ngesikhathi esisodwa. Lokhu kusiza kudivayisi egoqekayo, lapho isikrini esikhulu sangaphakathi sivame ukudinga ikhibhodi encane kunesikrini esingaphandle. Inani ngalinye ongalishintshi lilandela isikrini esime mpo.

Ngemva kokuba ikhibhodi ivulekile, ihlala esikrinini lapho inkambu yombhalo ivaleka, nangaphezulu kwezinhlelo zokusebenza ezingenayo inkambu yombhalo. Lokhu kukuvumela ukuthi uthumele okhiye nezinqamuleli zekhibhodi kuhlelo lokusebenza, isibonelo ukusetha ukhiye oshisayo kuhlelo lokusebenza lwamanothi. Ukuze uvale ikhibhodi, cindezela ukhiye wokufihla, swayiphela phansi kubha yamathuluzi, noma cindezela emuva. Ivuleka futhi ngokuzayo uma uthinta inkambu yombhalo. Ikhibhodi ayihlali esikrinini sokukhiya. Isebenza idokhiwe noma intanta.
Hlala uvulekile uma kungekho nsimu yombhalo egxilile

Ukuphakama kokhiye, ukuphakama komugqa wezinombolo, ukuphakama komugqa ongezansi, ukugcwalisa, ububanzi, indawo, isikhala kanye ne-radius yekona konke kubuyela kokuzenzakalelayo. Izilungiselelo zokuma kwesikrini azithinteki.

Lesi silungiselelo sisebenza phezu kobubanzi bekhibhodi obungaphezulu.
Hambisa umphetho wesobunxele wekhibhodi ubheke phakathi

Ikhibhodi igcina lokhu okungakanani kobubanzi besikrini kucacile ngakwesokudla. Ikubeke enanini elifanayo ne-padding yesobunxele ukuze uthole umkhawulo olinganayo, noma kwelinye elihlukile ukuze ushukumisele izinkinobho ngesandla osithayipha ngaso. Okuzenzakalelayo kungamaphesenti angu-0.
Hambisa umphetho ongakwesokudla wekhibhodi ubheke phakathi

Leli yigebe eliphakathi nendawo, njengephesenti lobubanzi bekhibhodi. Igebe elikhulu lihambisa izingxenye ezimbili kancane emaphethelweni, kodwa ukhiye ngamunye uba mncane.

Ikhibhodi ihlukanisa umugqa ngamunye phakathi nendawo futhi ibeka igebe phakathi kwezingxenye, ukuze izithupha zakho zihambe kancane ezikrinini ezibanzi. Ukuhlukanisa kuyisilungiselelo esisodwa sawo wonke umumo wesikrini, ngakho-ke ukusivula kumodi ye-landscape kushiya ikhibhodi ihlukene ngemva kokuba ujikeleze emuva, lapho ukuhlelwa okuhlukanisiwe kunzima ukukusebenzisa. Vula lokhu ukuze uhlukanise kuphela kumodi ye-landscape noma esikrinini esivuliwe. Lesi silungiselelo sicishiwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.

Izindlela zivuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo. Uma zivuliwe, ikhibhodi ishintsha umugqa wayo we-emoji, amathuluzi aphiniwe kanye namasethi ayo ezimpawu ukuze afane nohlelo lokusebenza noma inkambu oyithayiphayo. Cisha lokhu ukuze usebenzise ukumisa okukodwa yonke indawo. Izindlela zakho ziyagcinwa, ngakho ukuyivula futhi kubuyisela zonke.
Vumela izinhlelo zokusebenza nezinhlobo zezinkambu ukuthi zishintshe ukusethwa kwekhibhodi
Umbhalo wendawo ompunga wenkambu kumele ube nelinye lala magama. Izinhlelo zokusebenza zibhala lo mbhalo ngolimi lwazo, ngakho isinkomba oyengeza ngolimi olulodwa ayihambisani nolunye.
Ithuluzi le-Modes libonisa lesi sithonjana eceleni kwegama
Igcina izilungiselelo ezisebenza ngaphandle kwale modi

Imodi iqoqo lokushintsha: umugqa we-emoji, amathuluzi aphiniwe namasethi ezimpawu. Imodi ivuleka ngokuzenzakalelayo ezinhlelweni zokusebenza noma ezinhlobo zenkambu ozikhethayo, isibonelo amabhokisi ephasiwedi namabhokisi e-imeyili. Ungaphinda uvule imodi ngesandla kusuka kuthuluzi le-Modes kukhibhodi.

Imodi igqoka lesi sakhiwo ngenkathi ivuliwe, noma yisiphi isakhiwo obusisebenzisa ngaphambili. Isakhiwo sakho sibuya uma imodi iphela, futhi ukuhleleka kokuswayipha kwebha yesikhala akushintshi. Izakhiwo kuphela ozivulile ezinikezwayo lapha; uma kamuva uvala eyodwa, imodi eyayiyisebenzisa ibuyela ekudlaleni ifa.
Kuze kube yilapho ushintsha uhlelo lokusebenza
Ihlala ivuliwe uze ukhethe enye imodi noma uyicime

Lokhu kumayelana nokuzikhethela imodi wena ngokwakho kusuka kuthuluzi le-Modes, hhayi imodi evuleka yona ngokwayo yohlelo lokusebenza. Kuze kube ushintsha uhlelo lokusebenza kuyindlela yakudala yekhibhodi futhi kufanele imodi oyifinyelela kanye. Kuze kube ushintsha yona kufanele imodi obuhlose ukuhlala kuyo, futhi ihlala ivuliwe kuze kube ukhetha enye imodi noma uyicime.
Isikhathi esihlala sivuliwe ngemva kokuba usikhethile

Uma usetha izinhlelo zokusebenza nezinhlobo zezinkambu ndawonye, zombili kufanele zihambisane. Isibonelo, bopha imodi ezinhlelweni zakho zokuxoxa nakuhlobo lwenkambu yombhalo. Imodi bese ihlala ivaliwe emabhokisini okusesha alolo hlelo lokusebenza. Uma usetha eyodwa kuphela kwezimbili, imodi ihambisana naleyo kuphela. Uma ungasethi neyodwa, ungavula imodi ngesandla kuphela. Uma imodi engaphezu kweyodwa ihambisana, imodi eqamba izinhlobo zezinkambu inqoba imodi eqamba izinhlelo zokusebenza kuphela. Ibhokisi lephasiwedi kumhleli wekhodi lisathola imodi yephasiwedi. Imodi oyikhetha ngesandla kusuka kuthuluzi le-Modes inqoba kuze kube yilapho ushintsha izinhlelo zokusebenza.

Imodi ibuyela kumathuluzi aphiniwe, ukuhleleka kwebhokisi lamathuluzi, umugqa wezimpawu, izinhlelo zokusebenza nezinhlobo zezinkambu eza nayo. Uhlelo lokusebenza lususa izinguquko zakho kule modi.
Ulayini wezimpawu ubonisa kuphela amasethi ale modi ngenkathi isebenza

Ngenkathi le modi isebenza, ikhibhodi isebenzisa le timu. Ithatha indawo yetimu oyibeke kwenye indawo, futhi ithatha indawo yamapheya akhanyayo namnyama azenzakalelayo ngesikhathi modi isebenza. Imodi ayishintshi ukukhetha kwakho. Itimu yakho iyabuya uma imodi iphela.
Ukulandelana kwamathuluzi kungahluka kuhlelo lokusebenza ngalunye. Imodi ehambisana nohlelo lokusebenza inquma ukulandelana okubonayo lapho.
Amathuluzi owakhethayo eza kuqala ebhokisini lamathuluzi. Amanye amathuluzi agcina indawo yawo evamile ngemva kwawo.

Vala lokhu ukuze umise imodi ngaphandle kokuyisusa. Izinhlelo zayo zokusebenza, izinhlobo zezinkambu, amacebo kanye nokushintshwa kugcinwa, futhi imodi ibuyela njengoba yayinjalo uma uyivula futhi.
Valiwe, imodi ayikaze ivuleke futhi ithuluzi le-Modes aliyikhombisi

Ukudlalwa okuvela kulolu hlelo lokusebenza kubeka ithuluzi lemidiya kubha yamathuluzi. Konke okunye okudlala umsindo kuyazitshwa, ngakho ividiyo, umdlalo noma ithebhu yesiphequluli ayithathi indawo kubha yamathuluzi.
Lawa makhaza awenzi lutho kuze kube ithuluzi lemidiya livuliwe futhi lisethwe ukuziphina ngenkathi umculo udlala.

Izingxenye ezintathu ze-Google zohlelo lokusebenza zenza izicelo zazo, ngaphandle kwekhodi egcwalisa le logi. I-ML Kit (ukubhala ngesandla, ukuskena umbhalo, ukuskena i-QR, ukusika izitika nokuhumusha kudivayisi, uhlelo oluphelele kuphela) ibika ukusetshenziswa ku-Google. Ungaphinda ulande amafonti e-emoji engeziwe kamuva. Iya kokuthi Izilungiselelo, bese uthi Emoji, bese ucindezela \"Landa okwengeziwe\" ngaphansi kwefonti ye-Emoji. Ama-add-on avela ezindaweni zokugcina ozingeza wena, futhi akukho okufakwayo kuze kube yilapho ucindezela okuthi Faka.

Ukuze ubone wonke ama-emoji, sebenzisa ifonti ephelele ye-emoji. Khetha u-\"Google\" (Noto Color Emoji), noma ngenisa ifayela lefonti ye-emoji njenge-Twemoji noma i-OpenMoji. Zombili ziku-Emoji, bese kuba ifonti ye-Emoji. Ikhibhodi ye-WM isebenzisa ifonti ye-emoji yedivayisi yakho futhi ayifaki ifonti yayo. Ungashintsha konke lokhu kamuva kokuthi Izilungiselelo, bese kuba i-Emoji.

Le sevisi igcina ukuthinta kwekhibhodi kutholakala ngenkathi isifundi sesikrini sisebenza. Ukuthinta okuyisikhala sokuslayida isikhombisi, ukuswayipha kwegama lokususa, ukuthayipha okushelelayo nokubhala ngesandla. Le sevisi ayifundi lutho. Ayitholi imicimbi yokufinyeleleka. Ayikwazi ukubona okuqukethwe kwesikrini. Isenzo sayo kuphela ukumaka iwindi lekhibhodi ukuze kudlule ukuthinta ngqo. Konke ukuthinta ngaphandle kwekhibhodi kusaqhubeka kuye kusifundi sesikrini sakho njengenjwayelo.

Thayipha inombolo yocingo oyikopisha njalo. Ikhibhodi yenza ifomethi kuyo. Ungakwazi futhi ukuzibhalela ifomethi ngokwakho: u-X yinoma iyiphi idijithi, futhi idijithi oyithayiphayo kumele ifane.

Lesi silungiselelo sicishiwe ekuqaleni. Ikhibhodi ayikopishi lutho e-Google Drive noma kudivayisi entsha. Yivule, futhi isipele se-Android sizoyiphatha ikhibhodi njenganoma yiluphi olunye uhlelo lokusebenza. Izilungiselelo zakho, izingqikithi, izakhiwo, ama-snippet, amagama afundiwe, amaphakethe ezitika, amaphakethe ezithonjana namapulagi abuya kudivayisi entsha, noma ngemva kokuba ufake uhlelo lokusebenza futhi. Isipele asiwafaki amamodeli ezwi, amamodeli we-AI, uhlu lwamagama alandiwe namaphakethe wegama elingukhiye le-emoji. Ikhibhodi ingalanda lezi futhi ngokwayo, futhi isipele kumele sihlale ngaphakathi komkhawulo wosayizi we-Android. Isipele sifaka okhiye bakho be-API abagciniwe. I-Android yenza isipele sefu kuphela kudivayisi engasibethela ngokukhiya kwesikrini sakho. Isipele nokubuyisela kuzilungiselelo kuyenye indlela, futhi akusebenzisi i-Google neze. Igcina idatha efanayo efayeleni ozihambisela lona ngokwakho.
Faka ikhibhodi kusipele se-Android nasekudlulisweni kwedivayisi-kuya-kudivayisi

Lokhu kususa wonke amagama ikhibhodi ewafundile kuwe, umlando wakho we-emoji, ukulungiswa okuhlehlisile, kanye nokukhethiwe kwakho kwesiShayina, isiJapane nesiCantonese. Isichazamazwi sakho somuntu siqu, iziqeshana zakho kanye nohlu lwakho lwamagama olungenisiwe kuyahlala. Lokhu akukwazi ukuhlehliswa.

Konke okufakiwe kusichazamazwi somuntu siqu se-Android kungaba nesinqamuleli. Uhlu olufanayo lusezilungiselelweni zesistimu → Izilimi nokufaka → Isichazamazwi. Ngalolu hlelo luvuliwe, uthayipha isinqamuleli, isibonelo \"omw\", bese umusho ogcwele, \"on my way\", uba yisiphakamiso esiphezulu. Lesi silungiselelo sivaliwe ekuqaleni. Ikhibhodi ifunda uhlu futhi uma ivuleka ngokulandelayo, ngakho isinqamuleli osisanda kungeza sizovela ngemva kokushintshela kuhlelo lokusebenza oluhlukile. Lesi silungiselelo akusizo iziqeshana zekhibhodi. Isiqeshana singeka-Snippets tool, sinelasi lalo siqu esikrinini samathuluzi, futhi sisebenza kungakhathaliseki ukuthi lesi silungiselelo sivuliwe noma sivaliwe.
Thayipha isinqamuleli kusichazamazwi somuntu siqu se-Android ukuze uthole umusho waso ogcwele njengesiphakamiso

Ikhibhodi igcina amagama namabhangqa amagama owathayiphayo ohlwini lwamagama oluyimfihlo kule divayisi. Lokhu kwenza iziphakamiso nokuthayipha ngokuslayida kube ngcono. Ikhibhodi icela umunwe wakho ngaphambi kokuba ivule izikrini ozimaka ngezansi, nangaphambi kokuba isebenzise izinkinobho zokususa ozimaka. Iphinde ibuze ngaphambi kokuba ucime lesi silungiselelo, ngakho othile ophethe ifoni yakho evuliwe akakwazi ukuyicisha nje. Lokhu ukukhiya ezikrinini, hhayi ukubethela. Ukuthayipha kusebenza ngokugcwele kule divayisi. Uhlu lwamagama, ukubikezela, ukulungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo, ukuhumusha izinhlamvu kanye nokusesha ama-emoji kuyingxenye yohlelo lokusebenza, futhi akukho okudinga uxhumano lwenethiwekhi. Uhlelo lokusebenza alunawo ama-telemetry futhi alunawo ama-analytics. Ithuluzi kuphela elisebenzisa inethiwekhi, futhi kuphela ngesikhathi ulicindezela: ukuhumusha, isimo sezulu, ukusesha kuwebhu, ukusesha izithombe, ama-GIF, izitika, ukubheka kusichazamazwi kanye namathuluzi e-AI. Londoloza izithombe kusuka kukhibhodi uye kugalari yakho
Bona ukuthi ikhibhodi ingafinyelela ini, futhi unikeze noma uhoxise imvume
Bonisa ukuthi yiluphi uhlelo lokusebenza okukopishwe kulo okukubhodi lokunamathisela

Ikhibhodi iphinde ilondoloze amagama owathayiphayo kusichazamazwi somuntu siqu se-Android. Ezinye izikhibhodi kanye nesihloli sokupela samagama sohlelo luyawazi nawo lawa magama. Uhlu olufanayo olungahlela kuzilungiselelo Zohlelo → Izilimi nokufaka → Isichazamazwi. Lesi silungiselelo sivaliwe ekuqaleni: ikhibhodi inokufunda kwayo, futhi lesi silungiselelo sibhala ngaphandle kohlelo lokusebenza. Silalela \"Funda ekuthayipheni\" kanye nemodi ye-incognito. Uma usivala, amagama asevele esohlwini ahlala lapho.
Yabelana ngamagama afundiwe nesichazamazwi somuntu siqu se-Android

Ikhibhodi ifunda isichazamazwi somuntu siqu se-Android. Uhlu olufanayo lusezilungiselelweni Zesistimu → Izilimi nokufaka → Isichazamazwi. Igama ngalinye kulolo hlu yigama elaziwayo: ikhibhodi iyasiphakamisa, ukulungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo akukushintshi, futhi ikhibhodi ayikuceli ukuthi usifake futhi uma uthayipha noma uslayida. Lesi silungiselelo sivuliwe ekuqaleni. Ikhibhodi ifunda uhlu futhi njalo uma ulushintsha, ngakho igama olifaka kuzilungiselelo Zesistimu lisebenza ngokushesha. Lesi silungiselelo sifunda uhlu kuphela. \"Engeza amagama kusichazamazwi sesistimu\" yisilungiselelo esibhala kuso.
Phatha amagama akusichazamazwi somuntu siqu se-Android njengamagama aziwayo
Ungakwazi futhi ukuthayipha izixhumanisi ngokwakho. Sebenzisa amadesimali degrees. Eningizimu nasentshonalanga kunegethivu.
Ukusesha akusebenzanga. Hlola uxhumano lwakho lwenethiwekhi.

Ibha ibala isichazamazwi ngasinye kudivayisi: uhlu lwamagama olimi ngalunye, amagama angukhiye we-emoji, nohlu lwamagama ngalinye olungenisile. I-chip enemibala ivuliwe; thepha ukuze uvale leso sichazamazwi, bese uthepha futhi ukuze usivule futhi. I-chip esemaphethelweni angakwesobunxele ebha ihlunga umugqa olimini olulodwa, noma ibonise wonke. Izishintshi ezifanayo zihlala esikrinini sezilungiselelo zolimi ngalunye.
Ulayini wama-chip ngaphezu kwezikhiye ovula noma uvale isichazamazwi ngasinye

Lokhu kushintshela ikhibhodi esakhiweni sombhalo we-Fancy bese kubuyela emuva, okufana nethuluzi lombhalo we-Fancy kubha yamathuluzi. Ngenkathi ivuliwe, umugqa wezitayela uhlala ngaphezu kokhiye; isitayela esijwayelekile ekuqaleni kwaso sithayipha izinhlamvu ezijwayelekile futhi. Ukuyicisha kubuyela olimini obuthayipha kulo futhi kususwe umbhalo we-Fancy ohlwini lwezilimi, ngaphandle uma inketho yethuluzi ethi Gcina ulimi ngemva kokuyicisha ivuliwe.
Thayipha ngokugqamile, ngomthambeka, ngesitayela se-Fraktur nezinye izitayela ze-Unicode, ezikhethwe emgqeni ongaphezu kwezinkinobho
Okwenziwa ngesandla kuphela, kusuka kuthuluzi le-Modes
Hudula izibambo ukuze ushintshe ukulandelana. Into esenhla yohlu iza kuqala.
Khetha izinto ezimbili noma ngaphezulu ngenhla ukuze ubeke ukulandelana
Imigqa inqwabelana kusukela phezulu kuye phansi ngalolu hlelo. Umugqa ofihliwe ugcina isikhala sawo.
Ikhibhodi ibonisa isicashuneli kubha yeziphakamiso futhi isibhala kuphela uma uyithinta. Amagama akho ahlala njengoba uwathayiphile uma ungakwenzi lokho.
Ukuthayipha isiqeshana sokuqalisa kulezi ziqeshana kunikeza lezi ziqeshana futhi. Yisebenzise ukubeka wonke amazwekazi ngaphansi kwe-\"continent\", noma wonke amakheli ngaphansi kwe-\"address\".
Isiqeshana sandiswa lapho amagama angaphambi kwekhesa ehambisana nephethini oyibhalayo
Isiqeshana siyanda uma uthayipha elinye lamagama aso okubangela
Iphethini ifana namagama angaphambi kwesikhombisi. Bhala (.+) lapho umbhalo ushintsha khona, bese ufaka u-$1 embhalweni ongenhla ukuze usebenzise lokho okufanayo.
Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazi ukufunda leli phetheni.
Le phathini ayiqali ngegama elilula, ngakho ikhibhodi iyizama ngemva kwawo wonke amagama owathayiphayo. Yiqale ngegama ukuze uyenze isheshe.
Le phathini ithatha isikhathi eside kakhulu. Ikhibhodi iyayimisa. Yenze ibe lula.
Ukuthayipha okubangela izinhlamvu ezinkulu kwandisa kube izinhlamvu ezinkulu. Kuwusizo eziqeshaneni ezilungisa amagama ajwayelekile kunamakhodi.
Thayipha ithegi bese ucindezela u-enter ukuze uyengeze. Amathegi akusiza ukuthi uthole isiqeshana ohlwini olude.
Thayipha lokho obungakuthayipha kukhibhodi. Umphumela uvela lapha.

Thayipha isiqalisi bese ucindezela u-enter ukuze usengeze. Ikhibhodi inweba isiqephu uma uthayipha noma yikuphi kukho ngokwakho. Isiqalisi singaqala ngezimpawu zokuloba, njengaku-:shrug, futhi singabamba izikhala, njengaku-gr db. Kumele siphele ngegama.

resources.string: Inani elikhulu lamagama ngaphambi kwesikhombisi elingathathelwa indawo yileli phetheni.

Ulayini wezinombolo unesilungiselelo sawo sokuphakama ngaphansi kwe-Layout & size. Lokhu kuwukusetha okufanayo komugqa wezimpawu, ngakho ungenza imigqa emibili ifane, noma wenze lo ube mfushane ukuze unikeze okhiye abangezansi indawo eyengeziwe.

Ulayini ubonisa isethi eyodwa yezimpawu ngesikhathi. Kungaba @gmail.com nokunye okufanayo nge-imeyili, https:// kwiwebhu, noma obakaki bokubhala amakhodi. I-chip esemaphethelweni esinxeleni somugqa ishintsha isethi. Imodi yekhibhodi ingakhetha isethi yohlelo lokusebenza ngalunye ngokuzenzakalelayo.

Umugqa ngamunye unokuphakama komugqa wophawu olulodwa futhi ubonisa okufakiwe okulandelayo kwesethi, ngakho okuningi kwesethi kusesikrinini ngaphandle kokuskrola. Umugqa ugcina isikhethi sawo onqenqemeni lwesobunxele kungakhathaliseki ukuthi zingaki.
Umugqa ngamunye uskrola ngokwawo, ngakho umugqa owodwa ungaba ekuqaleni kwawo kuyilapho omunye usekupheleni kwawo.
Indlela imigqa enyakaza ngayo uma uskrola eceleni
Imigqa ihamba njengegridi eyodwa. Ukuskrola kunoma yimuphi umugqa kuhambisa yonke imigqa.
Umugqa wezinhlamvu ezikhethekile neziqephu ngaphezu kwezikhiye
Leli isethi eyakhelwe ngaphakathi. Izinguquko zakho ziyayishintsha. Konke okusebenzisa i-%1$s kuthola izinguquko zakho. Cindezela ukusetha kabusha ukuze ubuyisele isethi yasekuqaleni.
Faka isikhala phakathi kokufakiwe. Okufakiwe kunguhlamvu olulodwa (© § →) noma isiqeshana esiphelele (@gmail.com https://).
Faka isikhala phakathi kokufakiwe. Ukuthepha kokufakiwe uqobo kukuthayipha. Okokuqala lapha yilokho okuthayiphiwa ngokucindezela nokukhulula.
Khetha okufakiwe, bese uthayipha izinhlamvu neziqeshana ezikunikezayo uma ucindezela futhi ubambe. Okufakiwe okune-popup kubonisa inani.
Engeza okufakiwe ngenhla ukuze ubanikeze i-popup.

Isethi ehloliwe ivela kusikhethi somugqa wophawu. Uma uhlela isethi eyakhelwe ngaphakathi, izindlela ezisebenzisa yona zigcina igama layo. Setha kabusha isethi ukuze ubuyise izinhlamvu ezakhelwe ngaphakathi.

Bamba umbhalo ukuze uwukopishe. Izinhlobo nemigqa yedivayisi ikopishwe nayo. Gcina leyo migqa uma unamathisela ukuphahlazeka endaweni ethile: asho ukuthi yikuphi ukwakhiwa okuvele kukho, futhi ngaphandle kwawo ukuphahlazeka akukwazi ukufundwa emuva.

Lokhu kwakhiwa kubonisa umbiko wokuphahlazeka esikrinini. Akubonisi ibhokisi lezingxoxo elithi \"uhlelo lokusebenza lumile\" le-Android. Ungakwazi-ke ukukopisha umkhondo wokuphahlazeka kusuka kudivayisi engenayo ikhompyutha.

Le logi ikhombisa lokho ikhibhodi ekurekhodile ngayo selokhu uhlelo luqale okokugcina. Iphinde ikhombise ukuphazamiseka kohlelo (crash) olungakwazanga ukusinda kulo. Ikhibhodi ayilokothi irekhode okubhala.

Lokhu kususa zonke izilungiselelo, kanye nezindikimba, izakhiwo, izindlela zekhibhodi, amasethi ezimpawu kanye nezenzo ze-AI ozenzile. Ikhibhodi ibuyela endleleni eyayiyiyo lapho uyifaka. Awukwazi ukubuyisela lokhu.
Idivayisi yakho ayikwazi ukubika osayizi abaqondile, ngakho lezi yizilinganiso eziseduze.
Yiluphi ulimi olusebenzisayo kuhlelo lokusebenza ngalunye
Lapho umunwe wakho uthinta khona okhiye
Izilungiselelo ikhibhodi ezifunda ngaphambi kokuba uyivule
Amagama owashintshe phakathi kwesiNgisi nesi-Bengali noma isi-Hindi
Lapho umunwe wakho uthinta khona lapho ucindezela
Isusa ama-cache kuphela. Uhlelo lokusebenza lulanda lokho elikudingayo futhi.
Ilogi yokuphahlazeka, igcinwe kudivayisi yakho kuphela
Amaseva ikhibhodi exhumane nawo, hhayi lokho ekuthumelele khona
Idivayisi yakho ikhulula lesi sikhala uma uvala ikhibhodi ngokulandelayo.
Uhlelo lokusebenza lwakha lokhu futhi uma lukudinga.
Gcina inqolobane yezibalo zedivayisi yakho uhlelo lokusebenza olungazibizi
Amafayela idivayisi yakho ewabala uhlelo lokusebenza olungawasho
Ikhodi ye-plugin, idatha elondolozwa yilowo nalowo, kanye nelogi yayo
%1$s isiyonke: %2$s yohlelo lokusebenza, %3$s yedatha kanye %4$s yenqolobane
Zonke izilungiselelo, kanye nezindikimba, izakhiwo nezindlela ozidalile
Umhleli wezitikha usebenzisa lokhu ukususa ingemuva. Uhlelo lokusebenza lungalilanda futhi.
Uhlelo lokusebenza luvula lezi uma uhlela isitika futhi. Aluzibeki ekuthekeliseni.
Izibalo zakho zokuthayipha zansuku zonke, zigcinwe kudivayisi yakho kuphela
Inguqulo entsha elinde ukufakwa. Ukuyisusa kubiza kuphela ukulanda
Amaphakethe alandiwe, uhlu lwakho kanye nenqubekelaphambili yakho yokufunda
Lokhu kufaka umbala kokhiye wokushintsha uma uvuliwe, amathuluzi asebenzayo, nezinkinobho kumaphaneli.
Ishintsha imibala ye-gradient, noma umbala oqinile webhodi
I-Flow ihambisa i-gradient yebhodi kancane. Umjikelezo we-Hue ushintsha imibala ye-gradient, noma umbala webhodi oqinile. I-animation isebenza kuphela ngenkathi ikhibhodi ibonakala.
Ikhibhodi ishintsha phakathi kwetimu ekhanyayo netimu emnyama ngokwayo. Ngenkathi lokhu kuvuliwe, ithuluzi letimu kukhibhodi libonisa ukubuka kuqala kuphela. Ishejuli ikhetha itimu esebenzayo.
Khetha izindikimba ozifunayo. Ikhibhodi izobonisa eyodwa yazo ngesikhathi.
Sebenzisa itimu ekhanyayo emini kanye netimu emnyama ebusuku
Itimu ekhanyayo ibonakala phakathi kokuphuma kwelanga nokushona kwelanga ngo-%1$s. Idivayisi yakho ibala izikhathi ngaphandle kokuxhumeka kwenethiwekhi.
Iyashintsha ngokuphuma nokushona kwelanga lapho ukhona. Lokhu kudinga indawo elondoloziwe
Ayikho indawo elondoloziwe okwamanje. Setha eyodwa kuzilungiselelo zethuluzi lesimo sezulu. Kuze kube yileso sikhathi ikhibhodi isebenzisa ukulungiselelwa kokukhanya nokumnyama kwedivayisi yakho.
Ikhibhodi ilandela ukulungiselelwa kokukhanya nokumnyama kwedivayisi yakho. Lokhu kufaka noma yiluphi uhlelo olusebenzayo lwe-Android.
Ishintsha ngokulungiselelwa kokukhanya nobumnyama kwedivayisi yakho
Idlala isizinda se-GIF noma se-WebP esinyakazayo. Ivala ukufiphala. Ayidlali ngokunciphisa ukunyakaza noma ukonga amandla.
Umbala webhodi ube sobala lapho ukhetha lesi sithombe. Isithombe sibonisa ngamandla agcwele. Khulisa ukungabonakali kombala wangemuva ukuze ufake umbala esithombeni noma ukuze usenze sibe mnyama.
Okukhethwayo: ikhibhodi ikhombisa lesi sithombe ngenkathi isesimweni esibanzi (landscape), noma isithombe esingenhla uma lesi singenalutho
Ikhibhodi ipenda lokhu esikhundleni sombala wangemuva oqinile
Ama-chip ayizinkinobho ezincane kumapaneli wamathuluzi: izikhethi zesitayela, iziguquli, izinkinobho zama-plugin. Umbala wazo wangemuva umbala wekhadi ongaphezulu.
Isondo lemibala. Hudula ukuze usethe umbala nokugcwala kwawo.
Kopisha u-%1$s kuphela, noma iqembu lonke lokubukeka?
Phina ukuze usondeze, hudula ukuze uhambise isithombe
Valiwe: indikimba ilandela izilayidi ekubukekeni nasezakhiweni
Valiwe: itimu ilandela izilayidi kokuthi Ukubukeka
Izithombe ezibekwe phezu kwezinkinobho, zokuhlobisa kuphela. Ukuthayipha kudlula kuzo. Izithombe ze-PNG ezisobala zisebenza kangcono.
Imigqa emincane phakathi kwezingxenye zephaneli, naphakathi kweziphakamiso.
Umbala oyisisekelo wenza iphalethi emnyama noma iphalethi ekhanyayo
Umbala owodwa oyisicaba, i-accent yale timu
Okungokwemvelo kugcina i-emoji ngayinye noma isithombe ngemibala yaso. Noma yikuphi okunye okukhethiwe kupenda izinhlayiya ngombala owodwa oyisicaba, ngakho i-glyph iba isithunzi.
Umbala owodwa oyisicaba, ofana namalebula okhiye
Yonke i-emoji noma isithombe sigcina imibala yaso
Umbala owodwa oyisicaba, ofana nomkhondo wokuhambisa
Ukuthi izinhlayiya ziwa ngokushesha kangakanani. Uziro uzishiya zintanta, futhi ngaphansi kuka-ziro zintanta ziye phezulu.
Izithombe zakho zozinhlayiya, kufika kweziyisithupha. Ukucindezela ngakunye kuphonsa ingxube engahleliwe yazo. Izithombe ze-PNG ezisobala zisebenza kangcono.
Ukuqhuma okuncane kwezinhlayiya ngaphansi kokucindezelwa kwakho konke ukhiye. Akudlali uma wehlisiwe ukunyakaza noma ukonga amandla.

Itimu ingaletha ifonti yayo yokhiye nomsindo wokhiye. Uma idivayisi ingenawo, ikhibhodi isebenzisa izinketho zakho zomhlaba wonke. Amafonti nemisindo kufakwa njengezengezo, ngakho ungakwazi futhi ukuyisebenzisa nezinye izingqikithi.
Itimu ezenzakalelayo ivuliwe, ngakho lokhu kukhetha akwenzi lutho. Yicime ngenhla ukuze uzikhethele itimu eyodwa.
Konke ukubukeka kwayo yonke itimu kuboniswa njengekhadi layo
Itimu enokubukeka okungaphezu kokukodwa iboniswa njengekhadi elilodwa. Cindezela ichashazi ekhadini ukuze usebenzise lokho kubukeka
Indlela itimu enokubukeka okungaphezu kokukodwa ebonisa ngayo
Imibala ihamba emgqeni oqondile, ekhoneni elingezansi
Imibala ijikeleza phakathi nendawo njengomcibisholo wewashi
Lelo fayela akuyona indikimba yekhibhodi ye-WM.
Ukuthi okhiye baphakanyiswe kangakanani ebhodini. Ezinye izimo zokhiye azikwazi ukudweba umthunzi futhi zihlale ziyisicaba, kanjalo nokhiye umbala wakho ongawubona ngaphakathi.
Ikhibhodi ipenda lokhu kukhanya phezu kwezinkinobho zezinhlamvu
Thayipha uhlamvu, noma ukhethe okhiye abakhethekile.
Nikeza ukhiye owodwa imibala yawo: ubuso bawo, ilebula yawo, umngcele wawo, kanye ne-popup yawo. Uhlamvu lugcina isitayela salo kunoma yisiphi isakhiwo esinaso.
Ayikho isithombe, thepha ukuze ukhethe esisodwa
Itimu ingasetha osayizi bayo kanye nesikhala, ngakho ukungenisa okukodwa kushintsha ukubukeka konke. Osayizi abaqondene nesikrini abasuka kuzilungiselelo zokwakheka basanqoba phezu kwetimu.
Itimu ezenzakalelayo ithatha imibala yayo kusuka kusithombe sangemuva sakho
Mnyama, enesizinda esimnyama ngokuphelele. Lokhu konga ibhethri esikrinini se-OLED
Kukhanya noma kumnyama, kohlelo lokusebenza lwezilungiselelo kanye netimu ezenzakalelayo
Mnyama njalo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi idivayisi yakho isethwe kanjani
Njalo kukhanya, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi idivayisi yakho isethwe kanjani
Ilandela ukulungiselelwa kokukhanya nokumnyama kwedivayisi yakho

Umbala webhendi engaphansi kwezikhiye, lapho ibha yokuzulazula yesistimu ikhona. Kokuthi Okuzenzakalelayo, ibhendi ikhombisa umbala webhodi, noma isithombe sebhodi noma i-gradient. Amafoni anezinkinobho ze-hardware awanayo ibhendi.
Umugqa oseceleni kwekhibhodi kumodi yesandla esisodwa. Ku-Auto ihlala icacile, ngakho ibhodi libonakala kuyo.
Iphini ekhadini ngalinye inquma ukuthi itimu iyavela yini kuthuluzi lezindikimba zekhibhodi. Izindikimba zakho zihlala zivela lapho.
I-bubble intanta ngaphezu kokhiye, ihlukene nawo
Umbala ongemuva kohlamvu umunwe wakho okulo uma ubambe ukhiye, nangemuva komugqa okhethiwe wohlu lwezilimi.
Ifonti yokhiye engenhla isetshenziselwa isiLatini, isiCyrillic nesiGreki. Eminye imibhalo igcina ifonti yayo ngaphandle uma indikimba iyinika eyodwa.
Yonke imibhalo isivele inefonti kule timu.
Umbhalo othule eceleni kombhalo oyinhloko: igama lesibili lesiphakamiso, kanye nohlobo nesikhathi sokufakiwe kwebhodi lokunamathisela.
Uhlelo lokusebenza lwenza yonke imibala kusuka kumbala owodwa oyinhloko. Ungashintsha umbala ngamunye ngezansi.
Ukuthi ingxenye engahleliwe ikhetha kanjani itimu entsha kangaki
Khetha itimu entsha kusuka kumasethi akho

Umbala ongemuva kwemigoqo engenhla nangaphansi kwezikhiye. Le yimigqa yeziphakamiso, umugqa wamathuluzi, umugqa we-emoji, umugqa wezimpawu, umugqa wesichazamazwi, umugqa wombhalo omuhle kanye nama-macro okukhetha. Uma kukuthi \'Auto\', imigoqo ikhombisa umbala webhodi, noma isithombe sebhodi noma i-gradient. Amagama akulo mugqa agcina umbala wawo ovela ebhodini. Uma wenza lo mbala uhluke kakhulu kwebhodi, setha futhi nombhalo weziphakamiso eqenjini le-Panels and suggestions.
Igcwalisa ukhiye bese inquma lokho okungalingani
Igcwalisa ukhiye futhi ishintsha ukuma kwesithombe

Isithombe esidwetshwe ezinkinobheni, esinqunywe ngokwesimo senkinobho, phezu kombala wenkinobho. Isithombe esisodwa sezinkinobho zezinhlamvu sanele. Ezinye izinkinobho ziyasisebenzisa futhi ngaphandle uma uzinika esazo.
Lokhu kususa ukubukeka %1$s kule ndikimba. Okunye ukubukeka kuyahlala.
Ukufaka esikhundleni kungeza umphumela ngemva kombhalo wakho esikhundleni sokuthatha indawo yawo
Ikhibhodi ikubuza ukuthi yini ofuna ukuyibhala esikhundleni sokusebenzisa elondoloziwe
Isenzo sifunda kuphela umbhalo ophambi kwekhesari, hhayi yonke inkundla. Umbhalo okhethiwe uhlale unqoba.
Lesi senzo siza nekhibhodi. Izinguquko zakho zigcinwa ngokuhlukile, ngakho ukusetha kabusha kubuyisa %1$s.
Ngaphandle kombhalo enkundleni, isenzo sibhala umbhalo omusha esikhundleni sokushintsha umbhalo
Imodeli inikeza umphumela futhi akukho okunye. Cisha lokhu esenzweni esichaza okuthile.
Ibhokisi lemiyalo livuleka ngalo mbhalo. Ungawushintsha ngaphambi kokusebenza ngakunye. Bhala %1$s lapho ufuna khona ulimi okuhlosiwe.
Ibhokisi livuleka nokuphuthumayo okungezansi kakade kulo, ngakho uyakushintsha esikhundleni sokukuthayipha futhi

Uhlelo lokusebenza luthumela umbhalo wakho njengoba unjalo. Umbhalo wokuphepha uvimbela imodeli ekufundeni umbhalo wenkambu njengemiyalo, ngakho-ke vula lokhu kuphela uma ubhala leyo ngxenye ngokwakho.
Nikeza imodeli umsebenzi kuphela. Uhlelo lokusebenza lungeza umbhalo wokuphepha nemithetho yokuphumayo. Bhala %1$s lapho ufuna khona ulimi okuhlosiwe.
Uhlelo lokusebenza luthumela lo mbhalo njengoba unjalo. Wena ubhala umbhalo wokuphepha ngokwakho.

Lezi yizinkinobho ezisephaneli ye-AI. Ungaqamba kabusha isenzo esiza nekhibhodi, ushintshe umyalo waso, noma usivale. Ukuvala isenzo kusigcina lapha, ukuze ukwazi ukusivula futhi. Cindezela okuthi Setha kabusha esenzweni ukuze ubuyisele leso esiza nekhibhodi.
Engeza izenzo zakho, shintsha okusheshayo, futhi uvale lezo ongazisebenzisi
Thola ukhiye ku-console.anthropic.com ekhasini lezikhiye ze-API
Iba nengxoxo nemodeli oyidawunilode noma oyimisele
Uhlelo lokusebenza luthumela umbhalo owenza isenzo kuwo kumhlinzeki okhethiwe. Lokhu kwenzeka kuphela uma ucindezela isenzo. Uhlelo lokusebenza lugcina okhiye bakho kudivayisi yakho.

Sebenzisa lokhu kusevisi enesimo sesicelo esifanayo ne-OpenAI, isibonelo i-OpenRouter, i-Groq, i-Together noma i-Mistral. Ikheli le-HTTP elijwayelekile lihlala kunethiwekhi yakho, ngakho gcina iseva kunethiwekhi oyithemba.
Shiya lokhu kungenalutho uma isevisi ingayidingi inkinobho
Isibonelo https://openrouter.ai/api/v1. Uhlelo lokusebenza lungeza /chat/completions ekugcineni.
Thola ukhiye ku-platform.deepseek.com ekhasini lezikhiye ze-API
Iphaneli iqala ngezinguquko esikhundleni somphumela ocacile
Iphaneli ithola inkinobho yezinguquko ekhombisa lokho imodeli ekungezile nalokho ekususe

plurals.item: Lokhu kususa irekhodi elingu-%1$d. Awukwazi ukuhlehlisa lokhu.
Lokhu kususa amarekhodi angu-%1$d. Awukwazi ukuhlehlisa lokhu.

resources.string: Umlando awunalutho. Qalisa isenzo se-AI bese sivela lapha.
Irekhodi elidala kakhulu liyasuswa uma umlando ugcwele
Funda, kopisha futhi ususe lokho okwenziwe ithuluzi le-AI
Umlando uvaliwe. Wuvule ukuze ugcine irekhodi lalokho okuthumela kuthuluzi le-AI nalokho elikuphendulayo. Amarekhodi ahlala kudivayisi yakho, futhi ungawasusa nganoma yisiphi isikhathi.
Ikhibhodi igcina lokho okuthumelayo nalokho imodeli ekuphendula ngakho. Amarekhodi ahlala kudivayisi yakho. Akukho okugcinwayo enkundleni yephasiwedi noma kumodi engaziwa.
Shiya lokhu kungenalutho ukuze usebenzise imodeli iseva elayishe yona
Isibonelo http://192.168.0.10:1234. Vula iseva yendawo ku-LM Studio.

Umbhalo ongakanani owubanjwa imodeli esedivayisini ngesikhathi esisodwa, ngamathokheni. Lokhu kuhlanganisa umbhalo wakho nempendulo ndawonye. Usayizi omkhulu usebenzisa inkumbulo eningi futhi ulayisha imodeli futhi.
Qala i-Ollama nge-OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0 ukuze idivayisi yakho ikwazi ukuyifinyelela. Ku-LM Studio, vula \"serve on local network\". Ithrafikhi ye-HTTP elula ihlala kunethiwekhi yakho.

Umkhawulo wamathokheni. Ithokheni elilodwa lingamaphesenti angama-75 egama. Imodeli yokucabanga ithola izikhathi ezine zalo mkhawulo, ngoba ukucabanga kwayo kusebenzisa isabelomali esifanayo. Khetha umkhawulo womhlinzeki wombhalo omude.
Shintsha phakathi kwabahlinzeki obasethile namamodeli owalandayo, kukhibhodi
Isibonelo http://192.168.0.10:11434. Sebenzisa ikheli lenethiwekhi lekhompyutha yakho.
Amamodeli akudivayisi asebenza kudivayisi yakho. Umbhalo owenza isenzo kuwo uhlala kudivayisi yakho. Iwindi lomongo wemodeli linciphisa ubude bempendulo.
Thola ukhiye ku-platform.openai.com ekhasini lezikhiye ze-API
Iphaneli ikhombisa umbhalo we-<think> wamamodeli okucabanga esikhundleni sebha yokuqhubeka
Thola ukhiye ku-console.x.ai ekhasini lezikhiye ze-API
Leli nsimu alinalutho. Uhlelo lokusebenza lusebenzisa ukhiye owakhelwe ngaphakathi kulolu hlelo.
Engxoxweni ekhibhodi, ukhiye u-Enter uyathumela. Uma lokhu kuvaliwe, u-Enter uqala umugqa omusha futhi inkinobho ethi Thumela iyathumela.

Izenzo eziqhubeka kulokho okubhalile zithumela umbhalo ngaphambi kwesikhombisi sakho. Izinhlamvu eziningi zinika imodeli okuningi kokubhala kwakho okufanele ikulandele, okusiza esiqeshini eside. Kubiza futhi amathokheni akho amaningi futhi kuthatha isikhathi eside njalo uma kusebenza. Lokhu kusebenza kuphela uma ungakakhethi lutho: ukukhetha kuthunyelwa njengoba kunjalo.
Izinhlamvu ngaphambi kwekhesa ezithunyelwe ngesenzo sokuqhubeka
Yonke ingxoxo elondoloziwe isuswa kule divayisi. Lokhu akukwazi ukuhlehliswa.
Susa yonke ingxoxo elondoloziwe kule divayisi

Ingxoxo iwukubuyisana, ngakho-ke iphethe okuningi kwalokho okubhalile kunesenzo esisodwa se-AI. Cisha lokhu futhi izingxoxo zakho zizohlala kuze kube yilapho uvala uhlelo lokusebenza, futhi lokho osekuvele kulondoloziwe kuyasuswa. Akukho okuthunyelwa noma kuphi ngendlela ongayithumelanga ngokuxoxa.
Gcina izingxoxo kule divayisi ukuze ukwazi ukubuyela kuzo

Uma icishiwe, igama eliyisihluthulelo lifana nendlela olithayipha ngayo, ngakho i-wiki, i-Wiki ne-WIKI konke kunikeza ithuluzi. Uma ivuliwe, kuphela isipelingi esingenhla esifanayo. Sebenzisa lokhu egameni elifushane eliphinde libe umbhalo ovamile, njenge-AI, ukuze i-chip ivelele izinhlamvu ezinkulu hhayi izinhlamvu ezingaphakathi komusho.
Igama kufanele lithayiphwe ngezinhlamvu ezinkulu ezifanayo
Leli thuluzi alinawo amagama okucushwa. Aliziphakamisi neze.
Thayipha elinye lala magama uwedwa. Umugqa wesiphakamiso bese unikeza ukuvula %1$s futhi ususe igama. Sebenzisa okukhomba ukuze uhlukanise igama elingaphezu kwelilodwa.
Amagama angukhiye wethuluzi avaliwe. Ukuze uwavule, hamba kokuthi Ukuthayipha, bese uthi Ama-Smart chips.
Ikhibhodi ithola ulimi lomthombo. Ungakwazi futhi ukushintsha lokhu kuphaneli.
Qedela isicaphuna esisebenzisa zonke izinhlamvu zamagama
Azikho izinhlamvu ezingalungile, ezengeziwe noma eziphuthelwe ekusebenzeni okugcwele
Qedela ukugijima ngamagama ayi-100 ngomzuzu noma ngokushesha
Isusa wonke amaphuzu aphambili, umlando wokugijima kanye namabheji
Swayipha amagama phakathi novivinyo, ukuze ubone ukuthi ukuthinta kwenza usheshe kangakanani

Ukuhlolwa kuqhutshwa kukhibhodi. Kukala isakhiwo, osayizi bezinkinobho kanye nokunyakaza okuthayiphayo. Umbhalo owuthayiphayo ngesikhathi sokuhlolwa awuyi enkundleni yombhalo. Izikolo zihlala kudivayisi yakho.

Ukuhlolwa kuqhutshwa nganoma yiluphi ulimi ikhibhodi ekulo. Shintsha izilimi kusuka kuphaneli noma kubha yesikhala. IsiNgisi nesiBangla zinohlu lwazo lwamagama; noma yiluphi olunye ulimi lusebenzisa isichazamazwi salo esilandiwe noma esingenisiwe.
Izinhlamvu ezinkulu, okomashumi, nezikhathi ezigcwele embhalweni wokuhlola
Izivivinyo zokucaphuna ziqhubeka kuze kube sekupheleni kwesicaphuno.
Bonisa umugqa weziphakamiso phakathi novivinyo, emgqeni wawo ojwayelekile ongaphezu kwezinkinobho. Ukuthepha igama kuliphetha
Izinhlamvu zokuqala zosuku lweviki ezifakwa umbala kugridi yenyanga
Khetha ukuthi ikhibhodi idweba i-emoji ngasiphi isethi
Faka futhi ukhethe izithonjana okhiye namathuluzi
Ithuluzi lisebenzisa lesi sishintshi esifanayo. Ungasithola futhi ngaphansi kokuthi Ukuthayipha
Imisebenzi ye-Trigonometry isebenzisa amadigri. Okucishiwe kusebenzisa ama-radians
1 2 3 emugqeni ongaphezulu, njengedayala kanye nephedi yezinombolo. Okucishiwe kubeka u-7 8 9 phezulu, njengesibali-manani sedeski
Inani eliphezulu lezindawo zamadesimali. Isiguquli samayunithi sisisebenzisa naso

Cindezela usuku ukuze ubone imicimbi yalo ekhalendeni ledivayisi yakho. Ikhibhodi icela ukufinyelela ekhalendeni okokuqala ngqa lapho uvula ithuluzi. Ifunda imicimbi kuphela futhi ayikaze iyishintshe.
Inombolo yosuku lwayo ibuye ikhombise ngaphakathi kweseli losuku ngalunye

Ithuluzi lisebenzisa ikhalenda le-Hijri lezibalo (tabular). Izinyanga zamaSulumane zangempela ziqala ngokubonwa kwenyanga entsha. Lokho kungahluka kumathebula ngezinsuku ezimbili noma ezintathu. Setha i-offset efana negunya lakho lendawo.
Hambisa idethi ye-Hijri ebaliwe ukuze ifane nokubonwa kwenyanga kwasendaweni

Khetha noma yimaphi amakhalenda amabili ozowabona eduze nekhalenda likaGregorian. Ikhibhodi ibala izinsuku zesiShayina kusuka ekufundweni kwezinkanyezi. Amakhalenda amaHebheru, amaPheresiya, amaHindu (Saka), amaBuddha kanye nawaseJapane ayizibalo eziqondile. I-Hijri ikhalenda lethebula, ngakho-ke inesinxephezelo sosuku ngenhla. Zonke ezintathu ziqala esifundeni sedivayisi yakho: ikhalenda lesiBengali e-Bangladesh, iminyaka yezinkathi e-Japan, impelasonto yangoLwesihlanu nangoMgqibelo ezingxenyeni eziningi zaseMpumalanga Ephakathi. Lokho kuwukuqagela nje kwalokho okufunayo. Ungashintsha konke lokho lapha.
Ikhibhodi ikubonisa esihlokweni nangaphansi kosuku olukhethiwe
Vula ithuluzi kukhamera yangaphambili esikhundleni seyangemuva

Isibukeli sibanzi njengekhibhodi, ngakho phezulu nangaphansi kwesithombe kuphuma esikrinini. Ikhibhodi ivamise ukusika lezo zingxenye, futhi uthumela lokho okubonile. Vuliwe: uthumela isithombe esigcwele se-4:3, esibamba okungaphezu kwalokho okuboniswe isibukeli. Ukubuka kuqala akushintshi.
Gcina isithombe esigcwele se-4:3 esikhundleni sengxenye esesibukweni

Lesi silungiselelo sivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo, ngoba izithombe ozithatha lapha ngokuvamile zithunyelwa kanye kuphela hhayi izithombe okufanele zigcinwe. Vuliwe: ikhibhodi ikopisha zonke izithombe kugalari futhi iyazithumela.
Lokhu kusebenzisa isitayela namandla okuthinta kwekhibhodi, ngaphansi kwe-Ukuthayipha → Impendulo. Uma ukuthinta kwekhibhodi kucishiwe, ithuluzi lekhamera nalo liyathula.
Dlidliza ku-shutter, izilawuli kanye nokubala kwesikhathi

Ikhibhodi inquma izithombe zibe yilokho okuboniswa isitholi-mibono, izigcine kusitoreji esiyimfihlo sohlelo lokusebenza bese izithumela engxoxweni. Akukho okungena kugalari yakho, futhi ikhamera isebenza kuphela ngenkathi ithuluzi livuliwe. Vula okuthi \"Thumela isithombe sonke\" uma ufuna isithombe esigcwele esingu-4:3 hhayi ingxenye esesitholi-mibono kuphela.

Izinzwa zekhamera zirekhoda ama-selfie ngaphandle kwesibuko. Umbhalo ube usufundeka kahle, kodwa isithombe sibukeka siphendukile eduze kokubuka kuqala. Kuvuliwe: isithombe esilondoloziwe sifana nalokho okubonile ngenkathi usilungisa. Kucishiwe: ikhibhodi igcina ukuma kwangempela kwenzwa.
Londoloza izithombe zekhamera yangaphambili ngendlela ezibukeka ngayo ekubukezweni

Izithombe ezinkulu zibamba imininingwane eminingi, okubalulekile esithombeni sedokhumenti okufanele umuntu ayifunde. Futhi zithatha isikhathi eside ukuthathwa nokuthunyelwa, futhi zisebenzisa idatha eningi. Ikhamera ikhetha usayizi oseduze kakhulu onikezwa inzwa yayo.
Ifayela elincane kakhulu, nelishesha kakhulu ukuthunyelwa
Dlala umsindo wekhamera uma uthatha isithombe

Iphaneli yekhamera inenkinobho yesibali-sikhathi eshintsha phakathi kokuvala, imizuzwana emi-3 nemizuzwana eyi-10. Yilapho iqala khona njalo uma uvula iphaneli, ngakho uma njalo usebenzisa efanayo awudingi ukuyisetha futhi.
Nikeza impendulo yaleli thuluzi kumugqa wesiphakamiso. Setha ngaphansi kokuthayipha
Umlando, iphaneli, i-paste chip, kanye nokwenzeka kuphasiwedi ekopishiwe
Bonisa isiqondiso ngezinombolo ngaphansi kwewashi lekhampasi
Ayikho indawo elondoloziwe okwamanje. Setha eyodwa ngaphansi kwe-Amathuluzi → Isimo sezulu.

Ikhibhodi ibala ukuqondiswa kwe-qibla kusuka endaweni oyilondolozayo kuthuluzi lesimo sezulu. Lawa mathuluzi amabili abelana ngaleyo ndawo. Ikhibhodi ibala konke kudivayisi yakho, futhi ikhampasi ayilokothi isebenzise inethiwekhi.
Noma yimuphi umkhondo (ticker) umthombo wakho wemali owucaphunayo uyasebenza. Umkhondo umthombo ongawuthwali awuguquki neze.

Okuzenzakalelayo kugcina izidijithi ezinhlanu ezinengqondo, ezilingana nohlamvu lwemali lonke kanye nengxenye yalo

\"1 btc\", \"0.5 ETH\", \"2 bitcoin\" kanye \"100000 sats\" zibeka inani emalini yakho kumugqa weziphakamiso. Ama-ticker angamagama ajwayelekile, njenge-DOT, LINK ne-NEAR, abalwa kuphela uma uwathayipha ngosonhlamvukazi. Izintengo zezinhlamvu zemali zitholakala kuphela uma uthayipha inani lemali noma ukhetha uhlamvu lwemali kuphaneli.
Funda izamba ezifana no-\"1 btc\" futhi ubonise izinhlamvu zemali kusiguquli

Izintengo zezinhlamvu zemali zivela ku-Coinbase, ne-jsDelivr currency-api njengendlela yokusekela; i-CoinGecko yinketho yesibili. Zontathu zimahhala futhi azidingi ukhiye we-API. Izintengo ziyinkomba futhi akusona iseluleko sokuthenga noma ukuthengisa noma yini.
Izintengo zezinhlamvu zemali zishintsha ngokushesha okukhulu kunezintengo zemali zansuku zonke
Vuselela amanani ezinhlamvu zemali njalo nge
Lapho amanani ezinhlamvu zemali ethathwa khona

Lesi silungiselelo silawula kuphela i-chip esesiphakamisweni. Iphaneli ilanda amanani uma uyivula, futhi amanani ikhibhodi esenawo aguquka ngaphandle kokulanda. Uhlelo lwe-F-Droid luqala ngalesi silungiselelo sivaliwe.
Cishiwe, ithokheni yemali ilinda ukuthepha kwakho ngaphambi kokuba iye ku-inthanethi
Ukuzungeza kwenani eliguquliwe. Izinhlamvu zemali zinezilungiselelo zazo

Amanani avela ku-open.er-api.com, enezimali ezingaba ngu-160 futhi abuyekezwa nsuku zonke. I-frankfurter.app (European Central Bank) iyindlela yokusekela. Zombili zimahhala futhi azidingi ukhiye we-API. Ikhibhodi ikhumbula ipheya esuka kuyo neya kuyo oyikhethayo kuphaneli.

Igama libhala \"96.04 Rupee\", Uphawu lubhala \"₹96.04\" kanti Ikhodi ibhala \"96.04 INR\". Imali engenalo uphawu lwayo ibuyela kukhodi yayo. Izinhlamvu zemali zigcina ithikha yazo, njenge-BTC, ngakho konke okukhethayo.
Indlela i-chip yemali ebizwa ngayo imali eguqulelwe kuyo
Amanani angaphezulu abuyekezwa cishe kanye ngosuku. Inani elingaphansi kwamahora angama-24 lishintsha kakhulu ukuthi ikhibhodi izama nini ukulanda okwehlulekile futhi.
Isikhathi esithathwa yizinga lokushintshanisa imali ukuze lihlale lisha
Lapho amanani okushintshanisa imali ethembekile ethathwa khona
Bamba ithuluzi ebhokisini lamathuluzi ukuze uvule leli khasi nganoma iyiphi indlela, bese ulihudula usuka kubha yamathuluzi ukuze ulihambise njengokujwayelekile.
Phumula phakathi kokunyakaza ngenkathi ubambe ithuluzi. Inani eliphansi liyashesha. Kwabelwana ngalo nethuluzi lokuhlela umbhalo
Ukubamba leli thuluzi kubha yamathuluzi kuqhubeka nokuhambisa isikhombisi. Uma kucishiwe, ukulibamba kuvula leli khasi esikhundleni salokho

Ukubamba ebhokisini lamathuluzi yindlela ovula ngayo ikhasi lethuluzi kusuka kukhibhodi, ngakho leli thuluzi liyayiyeka leyo misebenzi ngenkathi lokhu kuvuliwe. Ikhasi lalo lihlala ngaphansi kwamathuluzi. Kulivule kuphela ngenkathi wenza ukunyakaza okubambayo.
Yenza okufanayo kugridi yethuluzi. Leli thuluzi kuphela, futhi licishiwe ngokuzenzakalelayo
Isakhiwo sesibili iyigridi yakho, njengekhasi lezimpawu noma iphedi ye-macro. Akulona ulimi. Igcina isichazamazwi sesakhiwo osibhala ngaso.
Ithuluzi libonisa lesi sakhiwo phezu kwezinhlamvu, futhi lisikhiphe futhi ekucindezeleni okulandelayo. Ukhiye kunoma yisiphi isakhiwo ungavula ezinye izakhiwo zesibili.
Ithuluzi lisesha igama elikhethiwe noma igama lamanje uma livuleka
Futhi gcina amakhasi askeniwe ku-Pictures/WM Keyboard

Lokhu kuvula isithwebuli sedokhumenti se-Google, esiyingxenye yezinsizakalo ze-Google Play, ngokutholwa kwemiphetho, ukunqampuna nokuhlanza izithunzi. Amakhasi askeniwe abuya njengezithombe. Ikhibhodi iwafaka engxoxweni njengesithombe sekhamera uma ivuleka futhi. Ukucubungula kuqhutshwa kudivayisi yakho.
Iziphakamiso, ithebhu yomlando, umugqa we-emoji, amathoni esikhumba nezintandokazi
Idinga isikhungo se-SearXNG. Engeza ikheli layo ngaphansi kwezilungiselelo zokusesha.
Engeza ukhiye we-API ngezansi ukuze uvule leli thuluzi
Yenza isakhiwo sesibili ngaphansi kwezakhiwo zokhiye ngezansi ukuze uvule leli thuluzi

Umbhalo omuhle uvame ukuba yigama elilodwa noma umyalezo owodwa. Lesi silungiselelo sibuyisela ikhibhodi olimini obukulo ngokushesha nje lapho ushiya inkambu. Sisebenza kuphela uma ithuluzi livule umbhalo omuhle.
Ngesikhathi esilandelayo uma uthayipha, ikhibhodi ibuyela olimini lwakho

Ithuluzi lithayipha ngezinhlamvu ze-Unicode, hhayi ngefonti. Izinhlamvu zihlala zinhle kuzo zonke izinhlelo zokusebenza, kodwa isifundi sesikrini asikwazi ukuzifunda futhi ukusesha akukwazi ukuzithola.
Ithuluzi lengeza umbhalo omuhle ezilimini zakho uma uliqalisa. Ngalolu hlelo luvaliwe, ithuluzi liyawususa futhi uma uli-vala, ukuze ukhiye we-🌐 ujikelezise kuphela izilimi ozifundayo.
Umbhalo omuhle uhlala kumjikelezo wolimi wokhiye we-🌐
Khetha isitayela futhi ithuluzi lihlala liqala lapho. Umugqa ongaphezu kokhiye ushintsha isitayela kuso sonke isikhathi seseshini, futhi ukukhetha kwakho lapha kuhlala kunjalo.
Isitayela ithuluzi elivula ngaso. Umugqa ongaphezu kokhiye usayishintsha

Vuliwe: isibani siyacima uma ikhibhodi ivaleka noma uma ushintsha izinhlelo zokusebenza, ngakho asisoze sashiywa sivuliwe ephaketheni lakho. Cishiwe: isibani sihlala sivuliwe uze usicime futhi, kusuka kuthuluzi noma kusuka kuthayela lezilungiselelo ezisheshayo zesistimu.
Bonisa noma fihla lolu hlobo lwenkinga kuphaneli yohlelo lolimi
Ukubhala okulungile kodwa okunzima ukufundeka kunalokho okudingekayo: imisho emide, igama eliphindwayo, umusho osho into efanayo kabili.

Amaphutha alula: ukubhala kabi, isenzo esingahambisani nento esenziwayo, ukukhohlwa kukakoma, igama elishintshwe nelinye elizwakala lifana nalo. Shiya lokhu kuvuliwe ngaphandle uma kukhona okukuhluphayo endleleni obhala ngayo.
Misa kancane ngemva kokuyeka ukuthayipha ngaphambi kokuba izinkinga zivuseleleke. Inani eliphansi lizwakala lishesha, inani eliphezulu lenza umsebenzi omncane
Indlela ukubhala okufundeka ngayo kubalaleli bayo: ukuhlukanisa nokufometha, ifomu elijwayelekile esifundeni esisodwa kodwa hhayi kwesinye, indlela engakahleleki yokukhuluma.
Imithetho yokupela kanye nesitayela okufanele ihlolwe ngayo

Imodeli eyodwa yolimi ngalunye othayipha ngalo. Ukubona kusebenza ngokugcwele kudivayisi yakho nge-Google ML Kit. Ulimi ngalunye ludinga ukulanda kwesikhathi esisodwa okungaba ngu-20 MB. Ngemva kwalokho, ukubhala ngesandla kusebenza ungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi.

Ikhefu elifushane lizwakala lishesha, kodwa lingasika izinhlamvu ezinezinhlangothi eziningi kanye nezinhlanganisela zesi-Bengali phakathi. Ikhefu elide likunika isikhathi esengeziwe phakathi kwemivimbo. I-Gboard isebenzisa cishe isigamu sesekhondi.
Isikhathi esingakanani ngemuva komzila wokugcina ikhibhodi ilinda ngaphambi kokuba ibone igama

Lokhu kusiza ukwenqaba isundu ngenkathi ubhala nge-stylus. Ngisho nalapho lesi silungiselelo sivaliwe, ikhibhodi ayinaki ukuthintwa kweminwe isikhashana ngemva kokushaywa kwe-stylus, ngakho isundu esiphumule asidwebi.
I-S Pen kuphela noma esinye isitayela esidweba. Ikhibhodi ayinaki ukuthinta ngomunwe

Izinsika ezimbalwa zisho ukubuka kuqala okukhulu, okulula ukukwahlulela ngaphambi kokuthumela okukodwa. Izinsika eziningi zilingana nemiphumela eminingi ngaphandle kokuskrola. Imiphumela ye-GIF ayithinteki: ibekwe emigqeni elungisiwe ukuze ngayinye igcine ukuma kwayo. Lesi silungiselelo singu-3 ngokuzenzakalelayo.

resources.string: Azikho izinhlelo zokusebenza ezifihliwe. Fihla uhlelo lokusebenza ekhasini lalo kudeshibhodi.
Njengasefonini, ikhombisa isithonjana ngasinye ngesimo esinikezwa isikrini sasekhaya. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezindala ezingenaso isithonjana esivumelanayo zigcina uhlaka lwazo.

Ngezinhlelo zokusebenza emgqeni ngamunye ku-Auto, izithonjana ezinkulu nazo zenza iseli ngalinye libe banzi, ngakho izinhlelo zokusebenza ezimbalwa zingena emgqeni. Umugqa ophiniwe nowakamuva ugcina usayizi wawo.
Ukuthi isithonjana sohlelo lokusebenza ngalunye sikhulu kangakanani kugridi
Bonisa igama lohlelo lokusebenza ngalunye ngaphansi kwesithonjana salo

Futhi bhala izikrini uhlelo lokusebenza uqobo lwalo kuphela olungazivula

Amaphaneli e-GIF nezitikha athatha ikhibhodi yonke. Ibha yamathuluzi, umugqa we-emoji kanye nomugqa wezimpawu kuyasuka, futhi ibhokisi lokusesha lingena emugqeni abawushiyayo. Igridi bese ithola yonke iphikseli. Lokhu kusebenza kumathuluzi womabili.
Fihla ibha yamathuluzi bese uhambisa usesho phezulu eduze kwenkinobho yokubuyela emuva
Njalo isithombe esivamile, esigqwayizwa yizo zonke izinhlelo zokusebenza

Imodi yesitikha isebenza kuphela kuma-GIF umthombo owunikeza ngesimo se-WebP. I-Android ayinayo i-encoder yama-WebP opopayi, ngakho ikhibhodi ayikwazi ukuguqula i-GIF opopayi wangempela ube isitikha. Lawo ma-GIF ahlala ephuma njengezithombe.

Amathuluzi e-GIF nezitika abelana ngakho konke lokhu, kanye nesihlungi sokuqukethwe esingezansi. Noma yimuphi ukhiye owodwa wanele. Yonke imithombo enokhiye iyavela kuphaneli.

Phakathi kwamagama, isibonelo - noma . Yishiye ingenalutho uma ungekho

Ikhibhodi ikhiqiza yonke into kudivayisi yakho ngokusebenzisa umthombo ongahleliwe we-cryptographic. Ayikaze iyigcine futhi ayikaze iyifake emlandweni. Amagama e-passphrase avela ohlwini lwamagama esiNgisi oluhlanganiswe nekhibhodi.
Shiya kungenalutho ukuze uthole isethi evamile

Ezinye izingosi zamukela izimpawu zokubhala ezimbalwa kuphela. Thayipha lezo leyo ngosi evumela zona futhi umkhiqizi adonse kulokho, ukuze ungadingi ukukhiqiza kaninginingi kuze kube yilapho iphasiwedi iphuma ihlanzekile. Shiya kungenalutho ukuze usebenzise isethi ephelele.

Ivula futhi ivale amagama esiNgisi esakhiweni se-phonetic osibhala kuso (Avro, Hindi phonetic). Ukulungiselelwa ngokwako kusesikrinini solimi ngalunye, eduze kwe-Also suggest from, futhi kudinga isiNgisi esikhethiwe lapho.
Thayipha amagama esiNgisi njengesiNgisi, bese ushintsha kumugqa weziphakamiso
Vula ama-plugin, bona ukuthi yimaphi afakiwe, futhi ubone ukuthi ngalinye lingenzani
Ukonga amandla kuqala kuleli zinga noma ngaphansi kwalo
Akukho okufanele kulondolozwe ngenkathi ibhethri ligcwala, ngakho iziqalisi ezizenzakalelayo ziyama. Lokhu akushintshi inkinobho engenhla. Uma uvula ukulondoloza amandla ngesandla, kuhlala kuvuliwe.
Ziba izicushi ezizenzakalelayo ngenkathi ishaja ifakiwe
Misa izinguquko nokunyakaza, njengoba ukunyakaza okuncishisiwe kwenza
Yeka ukufanisa izibalo, ukuguqulwa kanye namagama angukhiye wamathuluzi njengoba uthayipha
Yeka ukufunda lokho okuthayiphayo ukuze i-emoji ikwazi ukuvela

Ukuhumusha ukuswayipha kuyinto ebiza kakhulu ikhibhodi eyenzayo. Futhi yingakho abantu abaningi besebenzisa ikhibhodi, ngakho lesi silungiselelo sivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo futhi umzila kuphela owayo.
Yeka ukubeka ithuluzi lemidiya kubha yamathuluzi ngenkathi umculo udlala

Ukuthayipha ngezwi okungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi nokubhala ngesandla kokubili kusebenzisa imodeli ye-neural kuprosesa, okuwumsebenzi obiza kakhulu owenziwa yikhibhodi. Ukuthayipha ngezwi kubuyela kusistimu yokuqaphela, futhi ukuswayipha kwezinhlamvu kubuyela ekuthayipheni okushelelayo.
Sebenzisa isitholi sesistimu sokuthayipha ngezwi, bese uslayida igama esikhundleni sokulibhala

Lokhu kumisa izicelo ezenzeka ngaphandle kokuba ucele: ukubuka kuqala kwezixhumanisi ezikopishiwe kanye namakhodi e-QR askeniwe, kanye nokubheka isichazamazwi uma ukhetha igama. Amathuluzi owavula wena ngokwakho asasebenza, njengokuhumusha, ukusesha kanye nama-GIF.
Akukho ukubuka kuqala kwezixhumanisi futhi akukho ukusesha okuzenzakalelayo
Misa ibhamuza lohlamvu phezu kwesikhiye ngasinye
Yeka ukubheka izithombe-skrini ezintsha ongazinikela ebhodini lokunamathisela
Yeka ukubala ukuthayipha kwakho. Izinsuku ezichithwe ukulondoloza amandla azirekhodi lutho
Lokhu kwehlisa umzila kuphela. Ukuthayipha ngokuslayida kusebenza njalo. Ikhibhodi idweba umzila kuhlaka ngalunye lokunyakaza, ngakho kubiza kakhulu kunokuhumusha ekuhlobisayo.
Yeka ukudweba umkhondo ngemuva kwegama eliswayiphiwe
Ukonga amandla kuwumbono wezilungiselelo zakho hhayi ukuzibhala kabusha. Konke okucimayo lapha kubuya njengoba bekunjalo ngesikhathi ukonga amandla kuphela.
Isishintshi esifanayo esisetshenziswa yithuluzi lebha yamathuluzi

\"Isilondolozi sebhethri se-Android\" silandela ukushintsha kwesistimu, ngakho ikhibhodi yonga amandla ngqo uma usuvele ucele idivayisi yakho ukuthi yenze njalo. \"Ibhethri liphansi\" lisebenzisa iphesenti lakho elingezansi esikhundleni salokho.
Ukhiye ongenhla kuphela ovula ukonga amandla
Ilandela iswishi yesistimu, ngakho ikhibhodi yonga amandla uma ucele idivayisi yakho ukuthi yenze njalo
Ilungisa cishe u-30%. Iphethe umbhalo omncane
Amazinga aphezulu asinda ekungcoleni nasekulimaleni okuningi kodwa abamba umbhalo omncane. Ikhibhodi ikhiqiza ikhodi kudivayisi yakho futhi ilandela lokho okuqukethwe yinkambu yombhalo.
