Ezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza zengxoxo zidweba isithombe esingenayo esicacile ngaphandle kwebhamuza. Lokho kungabukeka njengesitikha, nakuba kuthunyelwe njengesithombe. Imodi yesitikha inikeza uhlobo lwesitikha se-WhatsApp esikhundleni salokho, lapho uhlelo lokusebenza luyisekela khona.
Inikeza uhlobo lwesitika se-WhatsApp, lapho uhlelo lokusebenza lulusekela khona

Ikhodi ye-QR iphethe umbhalo owengeziwe ezingeni eliphansi lokulungisa amaphutha, futhi incane kweliphezulu. Yikhuphule lokhu ukuze ufake isixhumanisi eside noma inothi; uma ikhodi yenqaba ukwakheka, yehlisa ukulungiswa kwephutha ngenhla, noma ufushanise umbhalo.
Thayipha umbhalo wekhodi ngokushesha nje lapho ikhibhodi ithola eyodwa, ngaphandle kokucindezela ukuqinisekisa
Ukudlidliza okufushane lapho ikhibhodi ithola ikhodi

Ukuhumusha kusebenza kudivayisi yakho nge-ML Kit. Kusebenza ungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi futhi akulayishi lutho. Kufunda amakhodi e-QR namafomethi ajwayelekile ebhakhodi yomkhiqizo, njenge-EAN, UPC ne-Code 128. Faka uthayipha umbhalo wekhodi kusikhombisi. Isixhumanisi siphinde sithole inkinobho ethi Vula.
Uma ikhodi iyisixhumanisi sewebhu, thola isihloko sekhasi nencazelo bese ubonisa ngenhla kwayo. Lokhu kudinga uxhumano lwe-inthanethi
Buyela emithonjeni esele lapho eyokuqala yehluleka
Zombili izinqamuleli zijwayelekile ukwenza kabusha. Okusebenzayo kuncike kuhlelo lokusebenza othayipha kulo. Uma ukwenza kabusha kungenzi lutho, zama enye.
Ukusesha ngakunye kusebenzisa isicelo esisodwa se-API ngendlela eyodwa

Ukusesha kwewebhu nokusesha izithombe kwabelana ngakho konke lapha. Basesha yonke iwebhu. Uhlelo lwe-Brave luhlanganisa isikweletu samahhala sanyanga zonke sokusesha okuyinkulungwane. I-Brave icela ukubalulwa, ngakho iphaneli ibonisa \"via Brave\".
Kusuka ku-api-dashboard.search.brave.com, ngenkokhelo yamahhala yanyanga zonke

Lokhu kusebenzisa ukucindezela nokubamba kubha yamathuluzi, ngakho leli khasi yilapho ushintsha khona ithuluzi, noma ukubamba ebhokisini lamathuluzi. Ukuze uhambise ithuluzi, licindezele ubambe bese ulihudula, njengakuqala.
Imodi yokukhetha ihlala ivuliwe ngenkathi ubambe ithuluzi. Iyama uma udedela, futhi umbhalo okhethiwe uhlala ukhethiwe

Ngenkathi imodi yokukhetha ivuliwe, konke ukunyakaza kwekhesari kukhetha umbhalo: amathuluzi ekhesari, iphaneli yokuhlela umbhalo, ukuswayipha kwekhesari ngebha yesikhala kanye nezinkinobho zevolumu. Kuyicime ukuze ugcine lokho okukhethile futhi uyeke ukukhetha okwengeziwe.

Ukucindezela kokuqala kwababili kusavula noma kuvala imodi yokukhetha, ngendlela efanayo ukhiye wokushintsha ukunika ukukhiya okukhulu. Vala lokhu uma ucindezela ithuluzi kabili ngokulandelana okusheshayo futhi ungafuni ukuthi elinye igama likhethwe.
Ukucindezela okusheshayo okubili kukhetha igama elisesikhombisini. Okuthathu kukhetha umugqa wonke
Lapho ibha ivela khona, iziphi izenzo ezinikezayo, nokuhleleka kwazo
Ithuluzi lisebenzisa le switch efanayo. Ungayithola futhi ngaphansi kwe-Advanced
Iziqeshana zakho, iziqalisi, amaphethini kanye neziguquguquki zethemplethi
Dala, hlela, ngenisa futhi uthumele amaphakethe akho
Amaqhezu, izimpawu zezibalo, izinhlamvu zesiGreki, imicibisholo, izimpawu zemali, ama-superscript, ama-subscript nezimpawu zokubhala. Konke kuthayipha kudivayisi yakho, njengenkinobho evamile.
Phumula phakathi kokuphindaphinda ngenkathi ubambe umcibisholo noma isikhala sokususa. Inani eliphansi liyashesha
Dala, hlela, ngenisa futhi uthumele izingqikithi zekhibhodi
Ukumaka okufushane kulo lonke uhlamvu noma umugqa isikhombisi esihamba kuwo

Lokhu kusebenzisa ukucindezela nokubamba kubha yamathuluzi, ngakho leli khasi yilapho ushintsha khona ithuluzi, noma ukubamba ebhokisini lamathuluzi. Ukuze uhambise ithuluzi, licindezele ulibambe bese ulihudula, njengakuqala.
I-trackpad ihlala ivulekile ngenkathi ubambe ithuluzi futhi ivaleka uma ulikhulula. Ukuthepha kuyivula kuze kube sekuthepheni okulandelayo
Umunwe owodwa uhambisa isikhombisi. Bamba, bese uhudula ukuze ukhethe. Imunwe emibili ihambisa igama elilodwa ngesikhathi, futhi ukuthepha ngeminwe emibili kuthayipha isikhala.
Ukuthi umunwe wakho uhamba ibanga elingakanani kuhlamvu ngalunye. Inani eliphansi lihambisa isikhombisi ngokushesha
Ukuthi umunwe wakho uhamba ibanga elingakanani kulayini ngamunye. Inani eliphansi lihambisa isikhombisi ngokushesha
Ukuthepha okubili okusheshayo kutrackpad kukhetha igama elikusalisi. Okuthathu kukhetha umugqa ogcwele
Dweba indlela yomunwe wakho kanye nesiphambano ku-trackpad ngenkathi uhudula

Okuxhumeke kwi-inthanethi kuthumela umbhalo kusevisi yokuhumusha futhi kwazi izilimi eziningi. Okwedivayisi kusebenzisa amamodeli we-Google ML Kit owalandayo, acishe abe ngu-30 MB ulimi ngalunye: umbhalo uhlala ocingweni futhi usebenza ngaphandle kokuxhumeka. Okuzenzakalelayo kusebenzisa idivayisi uma izilimi zilandiwe kanye nesevisi ekuxhumekeni kwi-inthanethi kukho konke okunye. Ukuhumusha okudivayisini kuhle emilayezweni nasembhalweni omfushane, futhi kunembayo kancane kunesevisi ekuxhumekeni kwi-inthanethi embhalweni omude noma wobuchwepheshe.
Lapho ukuhumusha kuvela khona. Ungakwazi futhi ukushintsha lokhu kudeshibhodi.

Ikhibhodi ithumela umbhalo owuhumushelayo ku-Google noma kunjalo, futhi kuphela ngenkathi iphaneli yokuhumusha ivuliwe. I-endpoint yamahhala ayikho emthethweni futhi inemikhawulo. Ukhiye we-Cloud Translation uwenza ube semthethweni futhi uthembeke.
Ngaphandle kokhiye, ukuhumusha kusebenzisa indawo yokugcina yamahhala yomphakathi ye-Google
Imodeli yokuhumusha engu-%1$s icishe ibe ngu-%2$s.

Ulimi ngalunye lulanda kanye. Ukuhumusha kudinga amamodeli ezilimi ezimbili, futhi kudlula ngesiNgisi uma kungekho noyedwa wabo ongesiNgisi. Uhlu luqala ngolimi ohumusha ngalo nezilimi othayipha ngazo.
I-Google Play ayizange ilethe ukulanda. Hlola uxhumano nokuthi i-Play Store iyasebenza yini, bese uzama futhi.
I-Google Play ilanda ingxenye yokuhumusha esocingweni…
I-Google Play ilanda ingxenye yokuhumusha esedivayisini: %1$s kwangu-%2$s
Ingxenye yokuhumusha esecingweni ivela ku-Google Play.
Ukuhumusha okusekudivayisi kuyingxenye eyengeziwe yekhibhodi evela ku-Google Play. Yilande, bese ukhetha izilimi.
Iziphakamiso, ukulungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo, izinhlamvu ezinkulu nokunye

Imitha elingu-1 lifundeka njengo-\"3 ft 3.37 in\" esikhundleni sika-\"3.2808399 ft\". I-chip ibhala amayunithi ngendlela owenze ngayo: \"1m\" iphendula ngo-\"3 ft 3.37 in\" kanti \"1 meter\" iphendula ngo-\"3 feet 3.37 inches\". Lapho kungekho sikhala sanoma yikuphi, ibuyela ku-\"3\'3\"\". Vala lokhu ukuze uthole idesimali elula.
Bonisa ubude ngezinyawo njengezinyawo namayintshi, hhayi njengedesimali

Kunezigaba eziyi-14: ubude, isisindo, izinga lokushisa, indawo, ivolumu, isivinini, isikhathi, idatha, amandla, amandla kagesi, ingcindezi, i-angle, imvamisa kanye nokonga uphethiloli. Konke ukuguqulwa kusebenza kudivayisi yakho. Ukunemba komphumela kulandela ukulungiselelwa kwesibali. Iphaneli ivuleka futhi esigabeni nasemayunithi owasebenzise okokugcina.
Okuqoshiwe kwe-Wiktionary kulandwa ngenethiwekhi; kudatha yeselula kulandela ukulondoloza idatha. Ukuhlanganiswa kwenkulumo kusebenza ungaxhumekile ku-inthanethi futhi kuyindlela yokusekela.
Lapho ingxenye ngayinye yekhadi lamagama iboniswa khona: kuphaneli yekhibhodi nakuhlelo lokusebenza, kuhlelo lokusebenza kuphela, noma ndawo.
Buyekeza kuphaneli yekhibhodi noma esikrinini sokubuyekeza. Zombili zisebenzisa uhlelo olufanayo.
Kungezwe eseshini yokubuyekeza ngaphezu kwalokho okufanele
Ukuthi igama elithayiphwe kufanele libe lula kangakanani
Ukuthayipha igama lephakethe kunikeza ikhadi lalo
Uma uthayipha igama elijwayelekile elinokunye okungcono ephaketheni, ithiphu emugqeni weziphakamiso iyalinikeza: “hate → abhor”. Ithinte ukuze ubone ikhadi legama, uyibambe ukuze ushintshe igama.
I-chip lapho igama elilula lingaba elivela emaphaketheni akho
Amakhadi okufunda alokho okufanele kwenziwe namuhla
Amabhokisi amahlanu anezikhala zezinsuku ezi-1, 3, 7, 14 kanye nezingama-30. Impendulo efanele ihambisa ikhadi ebhokisini elilandelayo, kanti engalungile ilibuyisela kwelokuqala.
Umthetho we-SuperMemo owusetshenziswa yi-Anki: ikhadi ngalinye linokulula okukhuliswa yizimpendulo ezinhle, kanye nezikhala ezikhula nakho.
Izinguqulo zivela ku-Wiktionary futhi zilandwa ngephakethe nangolimi esikrinini samaphakethe.
Igama elilodwa ngosuku, elithathwe emaphaketheni akho
Kanye ngosuku, okokuqala lapho ikhibhodi ivuleka
Mangaki amasimu ombhalo angase anikeze igama elifanayo ngaphambi kokuba lime; ukulilahla kulimisa ngaso leso sikhathi
Igama elifanayo kuwo wonke umuntu onamaphakethe akho, ngaleso sikhathi
Injini yokuqaphela, ukubuka kwemakrofoni, izimpawu zokuloba ezikhulunywayo kanye namamodeli angaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi
Lesi silungiselelo silawula kuphela i-chip emugqeni weziphakamiso. Iphaneli ilanda isibikezelo sezulu uma uyivula. Uhlelo lwe-F-Droid luqala ngalesi silungiselelo sivaliwe.
Ivaliwe, i-chip yesimo sezulu ilinda ukuthi uyithinte ngaphambi kokuba iye ku-inthanethi
Bonisa amazinga okushisa ngo-°F esikhundleni sika-°C
Isimo sezulu kanye nokuseshwa kwendawo kokubili kusebenzisa i-Open-Meteo, kuphela uma uzisebenzisa. Ikhibhodi ayenzi ezinye izicelo zenethiwekhi.

Ithuluzi lisebenzisa kabusha ukufundwa kokugcina isikhathi eside esikhundleni sokubuza isevisi futhi, okonga idatha nebhethri. Kusetha kube kufushane uma ubuka isimo sezulu esishintshayo, kube kude uma usibuka nje. Ukuvula ithuluzi ngemva kokuba lesi sikhathi sidlulile kulanda izinombolo ezintsha.
Isikhathi ngaphambi kokuba ithuluzi libuyise isimo sezulu futhi
Ukusesha nombhalo we-athikili kuvela kuma-API wamahhala we-wikipedia.org, kuphela ngenkathi usebenzisa ithuluzi.
Ikhodi yesizinda esincane: en, bn, de, fr, es …
Isihloko eside singaba nezixhumanisi ezingamakhulu. Ithuluzi licela leli nani futhi uhlu olude luyanqunywa. 500 inani eliphezulu i-Wikipedia ezolibuyisa ngesikhathi esisodwa.
Mangaki amakhasi aphumayo uhlu lwezixhumanisi oluwabonisayo
Faka izixhumanisi njenge-[Isihloko](url) esikhundleni sekheli elivamile
Ithuluzi ngalinye lithola umbala walo wokugcizelela lapha nasebhokisini lamathuluzi. Vula ithuluzi ukuze ushintshe umbala waleyo nkinobho eyodwa.

Uma icishiwe, ithuluzi lingumbala owodwa oyisicaba. Uma ivuliwe, ithuluzi ngalinye liba umbala oshintshayo osuka kumbala walo phezulu kwesobunxele uye kumbala wesibili ngezansi kwesokudla. Umbala wesibili ubalwa kusukela kowokuqala, ngakho awudingi ukukhetha owodwa. Ukuze ukhethe womabili, vula ithuluzi bese usetha umbala wokuqala nombala wokugcina.
Penda ithuluzi ngalinye ngemibala emibili, kusukela phezulu kwesobunxele kuya phansi kwesokudla

Amathuluzi akubha yamathuluzi yekhibhodi nasebhokisini lamathuluzi. Inkinobho yegridi kubha yamathuluzi ivula ibhokisi lamathuluzi. Isishintshi sivula ithuluzi. Cindezela umugqa ukuze uvule izilungiselelo zalelo thuluzi. I-⚙ imaka amathuluzi anezinketho zawo.
Idinga ukhiye we-API. Cindezela lo mugqa ukuze ungeze owodwa.
Idinga isakhiwo sesibili. Cindezela lo mgqa, bese Izakhiwo zezikhi, ukuze wenze esisodwa.
Khohlwa lapho ukuthepha kwami kufika khona
Ukuthepha kubuyela ekufundweni ngokumelene nezinkinobho njengoba kudwetshiwe, futhi ukufunda kuqala kabusha kusukela egameni lakho elilandelayo. Amagama afundiwe nokulungiswa akuthinteki.

Akekho othinta phakathi ncam kwayo yonke inkinobho. Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, wonke amagama owathayiphayo futhi owashiyayo aqopha lapho umunwe wakho uthinte khona kuhlamvu ngalunye, futhi ukuthinta kwakamuva kufundwa ngokumelene nezinkinobho ezihanjiswe ukuze zifane. Ukushelela okubheke kunkinobho eseduze bese kulungiswa ngendlela oyenza ngayo ngempela. Ukuswayipha kunenguqulo yako yalokhu ngaphansi kokuthayipha kwe-Glide. Kuyicime ukuze umise lokho okufundiwe, noma sebenzisa okuthi Khohlwa ngezansi ukuze uqale kabusha.
Amagama owagcinayo afundisa ikhibhodi ukuthi uphuthelwa kanjani ukhiye ngamunye lapho uthepha
Funda lapho ompompi bami behlala khona

Amagama ezinhlelo zakho zokusebenza ezifakiwe aqedela ngendlela efanayo namagama asohlwini lwamagama. Isibonelo: \"sign\" inikeza i-Signal. Ukulungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo akushintshi lutho. Asezingeni eliphansi kunamagama oxhumana nabo, ngoba amagama ajwayelekile afana ne-Files ne-Clock nawo angamagama ezinhlelo zokusebenza. Ikhibhodi ifunda amagama enkumbulweni kuphela. Ayilondolozi lutho futhi ayithumeli lutho, futhi ayidingi mvume.
Qedela amagama ezinhlelo zokusebenza ezifakiwe njengoba uthayipha

Uma igama elingekho kusichazamazwi lithayiphiwe, umugqa weziphakamiso ubuza ukuthi ulifake yini. Thepha i-chip ukuze ulondoloze igama, noma u-✕ ukuze ungasaphinde ubuzwe ngalo. Akukho okulondolozwayo ngaphandle uma uthepha. Kuvaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo, ngoba i-chip ngemva kwegama ongasaphinde ucabange ngalo iyaphazamisa.
Nikeza ithiphu esikhundleni sokubala ukuthi ulubhala kangaki igama

Uthayipha isifinyezo ngaphandle kophawu lwaso (arent, isnt, youre, oclock…). Uma ucindezela isikhala, ikhibhodi ibuyisela uphawu lwaso, kanti u-\"i\" oyingodwa uba u-\"I\". Ikhibhodi ayiwathinti amagama asengamagama esiNgisi aqotho ngaphandle kophawu lwaso (its, well, ill, shell…). Lesi silungiselelo sisebenza ngisho noma ukulungisa ngokuzenzakalela kucishiwe.

I-Shift ivuleka ngokwayo ekuqaleni kwenkambu yombhalo, nangemva kophawu lokubhala oluqeda umusho (. ! ? ।). Lokhu kwenzeka kuphela ezinkambini ezicela izinhlamvu ezinkulu emishweni, futhi kuphela ngesiNgisi. Ikhibhodi ayikaze ishintshe i-caps lock ngokwayo.
Faka uhlamvu olukhulu ekuqaleni kwesigwebo ngasinye

Awudingi ukucindezela isikhala ekupheleni kwesigaba: \"hello,\" iba \"hello, \" ngokwayo. Iqembu lezimpawu (\"...\", \"?!\") lihlala ndawonye. Uma uzicindezela isikhala, ikhibhodi ayengezi isikhala sesibili. I-Shift ngokushesha ngemva kwesikhala iyasusa. Ikhibhodi ishiya izinkambu ezihleliwe njengoba zinjalo: amaphasiwedi, amakheli e-imeyili, amakheli ewebhu, amaphedi ezinombolo namaphedi efoni. Isikhala kulezi zinkambu siyiphutha.
Ikhibhodi yengeza isikhala ngemva kokuba uthayiphe . , ? ! ; noma :

Ikhibhodi ilandelela ukuthi ukhipha kangaki ukulungiswa kwayo. Uma ukhipha ukulungiswa kaningi, ikhibhodi ikhuphula ukuzethemba okudingayo ngaphambi kokuba ilungise igama. Uma ungavamile ukukhipha ukulungiswa, ukuzethemba kubuyela kunani le-slider. Ikhibhodi iphinde ikhumbule konke ukulungiswa okukhiphayo. Ukulungiswa okukhipha kabili akusoze kwasebenza futhi.
Lungisa kancane uma uhlehlisa ukulungiswa njalo

Ikhibhodi ilungisa igama kuphela uma umuntu okhethiwe ongcono kakhulu ethola amaphuzu aphezulu kunomuntu wesibili ngalesi sici. Inani eliphansi lilungisa amaphutha amaningi okuthayipha, kodwa liqagela kabi kaningi. Inani eliphezulu lilungisa kuphela uma igama liqinisekile. Ikhibhodi ihlale isebenzisa ukulungiswa okuvunyelwene ngakho yimithombo emibili.
Ukuthi ikhibhodi kufanele iqiniseke kangakanani ngaphambi kokuba ilungise igama

Uma ucindezela isikhala, ikhibhodi iqhathanisa igama olithayiphile nohlu lwamagama. Uma igama libukeka njengephutha legama elivame kakhulu, ikhibhodi iyashintsha. Ikhibhodi ayilokothi ilungise igama olifundisile. Ukulungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo kuhlala kuvaliwe ezinkambini zephasiwedi.

Uma igama olithayiphile lingaziwa, kodwa lihlukana libe amagama amabili ikhibhodi ewaziyo, ikhibhodi ingahlanganisa lawo magama amabili nesikhala phakathi kwawo: \'ofthe\' iba \'of the\'. Uhlamvu oluseduze nebha yesikhala lungaphinde lumele isikhala uqobo, ngakho \'amibtomake\' iba \'ami tomake\'. Ukuhlukaniswa kusebenza kuphela uma lingekho igama elilodwa elichaza umbhalo othayiphwe futhi zombili izingxenye zingamagama acacile. Ukucindezela u-Backspace ngemva nje kokuhlukaniswa kubuyisela umbhalo wakho, njenganoma yikuphi okunye ukulungisa.
Hlukanisa amagama amabili athayiphwe ndawonye uma ucindezela isikhala
Lungisa amaphutha okuthayipha ngokuzenzakalelayo uma ucindezela isikhala
Umugqa omncane umaka indawo lapho i-autopilot ihlola khona ukucindezela kwakho. Yisebenzise ukulungisa Amandla. Umugqa uyisiza sokulungisa, ngakho-ke uwucime futhi uma usuqedile.
Dweba umngcele oqondile uhlamvu ngalunye olulindelekile olufunayo

Ikhibhodi idweba uhlamvu ngalunye olulindelekile phezu kwebhodi ngosayizi owunikezwe yi-autopilot, ukuze ubone ukuthi Amandla enzeni ngenkathi uthayipha. Okhiye ngokwabo abanyakazi, futhi ubacindezela ezindaweni ezifanayo. Izinhlamvu ezinhlanu kuphela ezidwetshwa ngesikhathi esisodwa.
Dweba uhlamvu oluthandwayo ngosayizi wendawo yokuthinta ekhulile

×1.0 idweba indawo ngayinye yokuthinta ngosayizi wayo wangempela. Inani eliphakeme liphindaphinda ukukhula kuphela, ngakho incwadi engazange ifune isikhala esengeziwe ihlala ingusayizi wokhiye wayo futhi umehluko kuphela okhulayo. Lokhu kushintsha ukudweba futhi akukho okunye. Ukucindezela kwakho kuhlala ezindaweni ezifanayo, futhi umugqa ohlala ubonisa umngcele wangempela.
Ukuthi incwadi ethandwayo idwetshwa inkulu kangakanani kunempilo

Ku-1 ikhibhodi ishintsha ukucindezela kuphela emkhawulweni oqondile phakathi kokhiye ababili. Ku-10 uhlamvu olungenzeka luthatha isikhala esiningi phakathi kwalo nohlamvu uhlu lwamagama olungalulindele. Uhlamvu alusoze lwafika kude ngaphezu kobubanzi bokhiye obubodwa, noma yini oyibeka lapha. 5 inani ikhibhodi eyaqala ngalo.
Ukuthi incwadi engase ibe khona ifika kude kangakanani phezu kokhiye oseduze kwayo

Uhlamvu ngalunye lubiza ukudonsa okufanayo, ngaphandle kokusheshisa, ngakho ukubala kuhlala kulula ukulandela. Kukhulise uma izinhlamvu zihamba ngokushesha kakhulu, kunciphise uma ukulungisa okude kuthatha isikhala esiningi. Lesi silungiselelo singu-20 dp ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Ukuthi uswayipha kude kangakanani i-backspace kuhlamvu ngalunye

Ukuswayipha kugqamisa umbhalo osuzosuswa esikhundleni sokususa njengoba uhamba, ukuze ubone ukuthi ufike kude kangakanani. Swayiphela kwesokudla ukuze ubuyisele umbhalo, futhi uphakamise umunwe wakho ukuze ususe okusele kugqanyisiwe. Cisha lokhu ukuze ususe igama ngalinye noma uhlamvu ngesikhathi uswayipha udlula kulo.
Khetha umbhalo njengoba uswayipha, bese uwususa uma uphakamisa umunwe wakho

Amagama alandelayo aphuma ngokushesha kunelokuqala kujika okumisiwe, ngakho leli banga elilodwa lilungisa lonke ukunyakaza. Likhuphule uma amagama enyamalala ngephutha, lehlise uma ukusula umusho kuthatha isikhathi eside kakhulu. Lesi silungiselelo singu-72 dp ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Ukuthi uswayipha kude kangakanani ukhiye we-backspace ukuze ususe igama lokuqala

Cindezela inkinobho yokususa bese uswayiphela kwesobunxele. Isinyathelo ngasinye sisusa igama elilodwa, hhayi uhlamvu olulodwa. Ukucindezela nje, noma ukucindezela ubambe, kusasusa uhlamvu olulodwa ngesikhathi.
Swayiphela eceleni ku-backspace ukuze ususe amagama aphelele
Ibuyela emuva uhlamvu olulodwa ngesikhathi, ukuze ilungise phakathi kwegama

Amagama asusa umusho ngokudonsa okukodwa. Izinhlamvu zibuyela emuva uhlamvu olulodwa ngesikhathi, okuyithuluzi elingcono kakhulu lapho kufanele ulungise phakathi kwegama. Ibanga lesinyathelo esisodwa limiselwe ngezansi, futhi ibanga elihlukile kwelilodwa kwelilodwa.
Isinyathelo esisodwa sokuswayipha kwe-backspace sisusa ini
Amagama okungafanele neze aphakanyiswe noma alungiswe ngokuzenzakalelayo

Ikhibhodi ayinikezi amagama anokhahlo emgqeni weziphakamiso. Ukulungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo akushintshi igama elingathathi hlangothi libe igama elinokhahlo. Usengakwazi ukuthayipha noma yiliphi igama ngokwakho. Lesi silungiselelo simisa kuphela iziphakamiso.
Gcina izilimi ezingcolile nezinhlamba zingekho eziphakamisweni

Izinkambu ze-imeyili ngokuvamile zitshela ikhibhodi ukuthi ifihle umugqa weziphakamiso. Lokhu kungafihla lezi ziphakamiso lapho zisiza kakhulu khona. Ngalolu hlelo luvuliwe, iziphakamiso ze-imeyili yoxhumana nabo zisavela ezinkambini ze-imeyili. Ezinye iziphakamiso zihlala zifihliwe lapho. Kuyicime ukuze ulandele inkambu, futhi uqedele amakheli e-imeyili kuphela embhalweni ovamile.
Zibonise ngisho nalapho uhlelo lokusebenza lufihla iziphakamiso
Ama-imeyili oxhumana nabo ezinkambini ze-imeyili futhi

Thayipha isiqalo sekheli le-imeyili loxhumana naye, isibonelo \"john\". Ikhibhodi inikeza ikheli eligcwele (john.doe@gmail.com) emgqeni weziphakamiso. Ikhibhodi ifunda amakheli enkumbulweni kuphela. Ayigcini lutho futhi ayithumeli lutho, futhi ukulungisa okuzenzakalelayo akukaze kuzishintshe. Lesi silungiselelo sidinga imvume Yoxhumana nabo.
Qedela ikheli le-imeyili loxhumana naye njengoba ulithayipha

Amagama akuzinombolo zakho zocingo agcwaliseka ngendlela efanayo namagama ohlwini lwamagama. Isibonelo: \"was\" inikeza u-Wasi. Amagama nawo ayaxhumana: ngemva kuka-Wasi, ikhibhodi inikeza isibongo. Ikhibhodi ifunda amagama enkumbulweni kuphela. Ayigcini lutho futhi ayithumeli lutho, futhi ukulungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo akulokothi kushintshe igama elikwaziyo. Lesi silungiselelo sidinga imvume Yoxhumana nabo.
Qedela amagama kusuka koxhumana nabo njengoba uthayipha

Ikhibhodi ihlela kabusha iziphakamiso eziphezulu ngamagama owathayiphe ngaphambi kwazo: amabhangqa akho amagama, amabhangqa ajwayelekile esiNgisi, namagama avela engxoxweni yamanje. Ukuhlela kabusha kusebenza kuphela uma kunobufakazi bangempela, ngakho ukuhleleka okuvamile kuhlala ezimweni ezingajwayelekile. Lokhu akushintshi neze ukuthi yiliphi igama elisetshenziswa ukulungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Ngenisa uhlu lwakho lwamagama olimi ngalunye

Ukususa igama emgqeni wokusikisela kulikhohlwa kusichazamazwi sakho somuntu siqu, igumbi lokulinda, izinguquko zakho zokubeka kanye nesichazamazwi se-Android. Ngalokhu kuvuliwe, igama eliphinde libe ohlwini lwamagama olungenisile liyasuswa nasefayeleni lalolo hlu, ngakho linyamalala unomphela; igama elisohlwini olulandiwe, elingakwazi ukuhlelwa, liya ohlwini lwabavinjelwe esikhundleni salokho. Ngalokhu kuvaliwe, izinhlu ezingenisiwe zishiywa njengoba uzingenisile futhi igama liyavinjelwa ngendlela efanayo, ngakho lihlala lifihliwe uze ukhethe ukusikisela futhi.
Ukususwa kwegama kukukhipha ohlwini lwakho lwamagama angenisiwe

Cindezela isikhala kabili ngokushesha ekupheleni kwegama. Isikhathi esigcwele sithatha indawo yesikhala sokuqala ngesikhathi esigcwele, ukuze ukwazi ukuqeda umusho ngaphandle koshintsho kusakhiwo sezimpawu. Ithebhu iyishintsha ngohlamvu lwethebhu, olusiza ngezikhala namafomu. Izikhala ezimbili zishiya zombili izikhala njengoba zinjalo.

Izikhala ezimbili eziseduze kakhulu kunalokhu zibalwa njengesikhala esiphindwe kabili futhi ziba yisikhathi noma ithebhu. Yikhuphule uma uthayipha kancane futhi ungalokothi uthole isikhathi. Yiyehlise uma uthola izikhathi ongazihlosile. Lesi silungiselelo singu-400 ms ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Ukuthi izikhala ezimbili kufanele zilandelane ngokushesha kangakanani

Cindezela ukhiye wokususa phambili bese uslayida uye kwesokudla. Isinyathelo ngasinye sokuslayida sisusa elinye igama, noma olunye uhlamvu, phambi kwekhesa. Kuyafana nokuslayida kokususa emuva okukhomba kolunye uhlangothi, futhi kulandela izilungiselelo ezintathu ezifanayo ngenhla: ukuthi isinyathelo esisodwa sisusa ini, ukuthi uyasibona yini kuqala, nokuthi uhudula kude kangakanani esinyathelweni esisodwa. Ukhiye wokususa phambili awukho kukhibhodi ejwayelekile. Wengeze emgqeni, noma okhiye ocindezela uwubambe, kumhleli wesakhiwo.
Slayida kwesokudla kukhiye wokususa phambili ukuze usule umbhalo ongaphambili

Ngokushesha nje uma ucindezela ukhiye, ukunyakaza okuncane okusuka ekhiyweni kungase kubukeke njengokuslayida. Kule windo ukuslayida kufanele kuhambe ibanga elide ngaphambi kokuba kuqale, kanti ibanga elengeziwe liyancipha kulo lonke iwindi. Ukubhala okusheshayo kuhlala kuhlanzekile, futhi ukuswayipha okuhlosiwe kusaqala. Inani eliphezulu livimbela izingozi eziningi, kodwa ukuslayida ngemva kokubhala kuqala kancane. U-0 uyakucisha lokhu.
Melana nokuqala kokuslayida ngokushesha ngemva kokucindezela
Slayida ngokhiye wokukhefana. Ukucindezela kusathayipha ukukhefana

Izinhlamvu azinawo upostrofi, ngakho ikhibhodi ayikwazi ukuhlukanisa phakathi kwe-\"its\" ne-\"it\'s\" ekuhambeni. Khetha ukhiye lapha futhi lowo khiye usho upostrofi ekuhambeni: swayipha u-i, t, lowo khiye, bese u-s, futhi uthola \"it\'s\". Ukhiye usathayipha uhlamvu lwawo uma uwucindezela. Khetha ukhiye owodwa kuphela. Okhiye ababili benza wonke amagama angacaci kahle. Lesi sinyathelo asidingeki. Igama oliswayiphayo ngaphandle kwalo lisebenza kahle, futhi \"Lungisa opostrofi abalahlekile\" kusasebenza emagameni afana no-\"dont\". Ibha yesikhala iphinde iqede igama ekuhambeni, ngakho \"Swayipha kuyo yonke ibha yesikhala\" kuyama ngenkathi usebenzisa ibha yesikhala yopostrofi.
Shelela kukhiye we-apostrophe, lapho isakhiwo sinaso
Ukuthayipha ngokuslayida akukwazi ukubhala uphawu lokucaphuna
Slayida phezu kokhiye wesikhathi. Ukucindezela kusathayipha isikhathi
Slayida kubha yesikhala. \"Slayida kuyo yonke ibha yesikhala\" kuyama
Slayida phezu kokhiye owodwa ukuze ufake uphawu lokucaphuna egameni

Ngenkathi ushelela, umugqa udweba igama eliphambili ngokugqamile. Okugqamile kusho nje ukuthi lelo gama liza kuqala, ngakho igama ikhibhodi eliqinisekayo ngalo kanye negama eliqagela phakathi kwalo kubukeka kufana. Lesi silungiselelo sinika igama eliqinisekile umbala esikhundleni salokho, okuyisithembiso i-autocorrect esivele isenza ngombala ofanayo: phakamisa manje futhi yilokhu okutholayo. \"Uma uqinisekile\" imibala yegama kuphela uma ikhibhodi iqiniseka ngezinhlamvu ongakazisheleli, ngakho-ke ngokuthi \"Qeda amagama amade kusenesikhathi\" kusethwe ku-\"Eager\" okugqamile kusho phambi kwalokho okudwebile futhi umbala usho ukuqiniseka ngakho. \"Noma yiliphi igama lakuqala\" lifaka umbala kuwo wonke amagama agijima phambi kwesitroke sakho. \"Njalo\" lifaka umbala egameni eliphambili lokushelela ngakunye. Umbala ngulowo obekwe \"Umbala wegama le-Autocorrect\" kokuthi Ukubukeka, ngakho akukho okushintshayo uze ukhethe owodwa lapho.
Bonisa uma ikhibhodi iqinisekile, hhayi nje ukuthi yiliphi igama eliholayo

Umugqa weziphakamiso yilapho umbala wokulungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo ukhona, ngakho uhlala ubonisa umbala. Iphilisi legama lihamba ngaphezu komunwe wakho futhi yilokho abantu abaningi abakubukayo ngenkathi beslayida, ngakho liphethe umbala ngokuzenzakalelayo. Amagama adwetshwe ezikhiye nawo angawuthwala, okwenza lonke ibhodi liphendule shazi kodwa kungumbala omningi ngesikhathi esisodwa.
Umugqa wesiphakamiso, igama elingaphezu komunwe wakho, noma amagama akuzikhiye

I-glide idweba \"good\" kanye \"god\" ngendlela efanayo, ngoba u-o ungukhiye owodwa futhi umunwe wakho uwuwela kanye. Hlala kokhiye isikhashana ukuze usho ukuthi uhlamvu lukhona kabili. Inani liyisiphindaphindo sesivinini sakho kuleyo glide efanayo, hhayi inombolo yemizuzwana, ngakho isebenza ku-glide esheshayo neyancane ngokufanayo. Inani eliphansi lamukela ukuma okufushane, kodwa i-glide eqaphile ehamba kancane yonke indawo ibhala izinhlamvu kabili yodwa. Inani eliphezulu licela ukuma okucacile.
Isikhathi sokuhlala okhiye ukuze ubhale uhlamvu kabili

Kulinganiswa ngobubanzi bokhiye. Ikhibhodi inikeza igama kuphela uma uphakamise umunwe wakho usondele kuleli banga kuhlamvu lokugcina lwalelo gama. Ukuphela kokushelela kulapho ukunyakaza kume khona, ngakho-ke kuvame ukungabi nembile njengokuqala. Leli yinani elihlukile ngaleso sizathu. Likhuphule uma ukushelela kwakho kudlula uhlamvu lokugcina.
Ukuthi ukuphela kokuslayida kungaba kude kangakanani nohlamvu lokugcina

Ukuswayipha kuvame ukufundwa kusukela ekupheleni kuya ekupheleni: ikhibhodi ifanisa uhlamvu lokuqala nalapho uqale khona kanye nolokugcina lapho ume khona, ngakho igama elide alikwazi ukunikezwa uze uswayiphe zonke izinhlamvu zalo. Ukuthepha akusebenzi ngaleyo ndlela — izinhlamvu ezine ku-\"dictionary\" igama selivele likhona. Nalokhu kuvuliwe, ikhibhodi ingase inikeze igama umzamo wakho oqale ngawo kuphela, futhi ukuphakamisa umunwe wakho kulibhala. Kwenza lokho kuphela lapho lelo gama liwimpendulo engcono kakhulu kunanoma yini oyipelile ngempela, ngakho lihlala lithule emagameni amafushane nasezinyathelweni ezingaba yizinto eziningi. \"Uma uqinisekile\" kuqaphele; \"Eager\" inikeza igama ngokushesha nje lapho phambili. Ivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo. Ayitholakali ezakhiweni ze-phonetic ezifana ne-Avro, lapho unhlangothi lupela i-romanization esikhundleni segama uqobo.
Phakamisa igama ngaphambi kokuba uglide lonke

Kulinganiswa ngobubanzi benkinobho bendlela edwetshiwe. Inani eliphansi lifunda ukugoqa okuncane njengophawu, okungumsebenzi omncane ukuwudweba kodwa futhi kubamba ukuzamazama kokujika kancane. Inani eliphezulu lifuna isiyingi osidwebe ngenhloso.
Ukuthi umbuthano kufanele ube mkhulu kangakanani ukuze ubalwe njengowodwa

Kukalwa ngobubanzi bokhiye. Uphawu kufanele lube luncane ngokwanele ukuhlala kokhiye owodwa. Igama elinjenge-\"murderer\" lihamba lizungeze indandatho yokhiye abaseduze komunye nomunye futhi lidweba umbuthano obanzi ongasho lutho, ngakho gcina lokhu ngaphansi kobubanzi bokhiye owodwa. Inani eliphansi libala kuphela umbuthano oqinile futhi ligcina izinhlamvu ezizungezile ngaphandle kwawo.
Imibuthano ebanzi iyindlela edlula okhiye, hhayi uphawu kokukodwa

Lolu wuhlobo lophawu i-Swype eyalufundisa. Shelelela kuhlamvu, zungeza kulo kanye, bese uqhubeka. Umbuthano awubizi lutho egameni, ngoba ikhibhodi isusa i-loop ebangeni umunwe wakho owuhambile. Valela lokhu uma ukushelela kwakho kugobile endleleni futhi uthola izinhlamvu ezibhalwe kabili ongazicelanga.

Kulinganiswa ngobubanzi bokhiye. Ikhibhodi inikeza umbuthano okhiye oseduze naphakathi nendawo. Umbuthano odwetshwe ngokhiye uhlala cishe ingxenye yesithathu yokhiye ohlangothini olulodwa, ngakho inani eliphansi kakhulu alitholi hlamvu kulo futhi uphawu alwenzi lutho. Inani eliphezulu linganikeza uphawu okhiye olandelayo.
Ukuthi isikhungo sombuthano kufanele sibe seduze kangakanani nohlamvu
Dweba isiyingi esincane enkinobheni ukuze ubhale uhlamvu kabili

Kukalwa ngobubanzi bokhiye. Uhlamvu lutholakala egameni kuphela uma ukushelela kudlule kuseduze nokhiye walo. Inani eliphezulu likuvumela ukuba unqamule amakhona futhi usaluthola uhlamvu. Inani eliphansi ligcina ikhibhodi okhiye obathintile, okushesha kakhulu futhi okuqondile, kodwa ukunqamula ikhona kwenza ulahlekelwe yigama. Yinyuse le nto uma amagama amade ephuma enohlamvu olushodayo.
Ukuthi ukuslayida kungadlula kude kangakanani kunhlamvu endleleni
Noma nini lapho elinye igama lisondela

Amagama amabili kuya kwayisihlanu. Kuze kube amathathu angalingana emugqeni owodwa ngaphezu komunwe wakho. Amane noma amahlanu asebenzisa umugqa wesibili ngaphezu kowokuqala. Amagama amaningi anikeza ukukhetha okwengeziwe, kodwa ngalinye liwumgomo omncane wokufikela kuwo.
Mangaki amagama avela ngaphezu komunwe wakho
Lapho igama elingcono kakhulu lishaya kancane elilandelayo

Bamba umunwe wakho unganyakazi isikhathi eside kangaka ekupheleni kokuswayipha futhi amagama ayavela. Isikhathi esifushane siphendula ngokushesha kodwa singavula amagama uma ume kancane ukuze ucabange phakathi negama. Isikhathi eside asiwavuli ngengozi kodwa sikwenza ulinde. Ukunyakaza okuncane akubalwa: umunwe wakho ungaphumula engilazini futhi uzulazule kancane.
Kuthatha isikhathi esingakanani ukugcina umunwe wakho unganyakazi ngaphambi kokuba amagama avele
Njalo uma ume kancane, noma yini ikhibhodi ecabanga ukuthi iyiyo

Uma ikhibhodi iqinisekile ngokuswayipha ayibuzi ngesikhathi esijwayelekile. Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, qhubeka ubambe isikhathi esiphindwe kabili bese ibuzayo, ukuze ukwazi ukuhlola noma yikuphi ukuswayipha ngaphambi kokuba uphakamise umunwe. Kuyicime bese ukuswayipha ikhibhodi eqinisekile ngakho akubuzi, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ubambe isikhathi esingakanani.
Ukuswayipha okuqinisekile kusabuza uma ubambe isikhathi eside kabili
Bamba isikhathi eside ukuze ubuze njalo

Okunye ukuswayipha akunawo impendulo eyodwa efanele. Kusakhiwo esinqunyiwe sesi-Bengali izinhlamvu ক kanye no-খ zabelana ngokhiye owodwa, ngakho igama kanye ne-twin yalo efisayo idwetshwa ngendlela efanayo ncamashi, futhi kunoma yisiphi isakhiwo ukuswayipha okusheshayo kungalingana namagama amabili ngokulinganayo. Uma lokho kwenzeka, gcina umunwe wakho phansi uwubambe unganyakazi isikhashana: amagama aseduze avela ngaphansi komunwe wakho. Shelelela kwelinye bese uphakamisa ukuze ulithayiphe. Phakamisa ngaphandle kokukhetha bese ikhibhodi ithayipha ukuqagela kwayo okungcono kakhulu, njengoba yayihlale yenza, futhi amagama afanayo ahlala kubha yeziphakamiso noma ngabe yikuphi.
Kuphela lapho amagama amabili elingana kahle

Ngemva kokuswayipha ikhibhodi iqhathanisa ukufundwa kwayo okubili okungcono kakhulu. Uma eseduze, inciphisa ukuqiniseka kwayo. Ukusondelana kubuza kuphela uma amagama amabili elingana kahle. Ukusondelana okukhulu, okuzenzakalelayo, kubuza uma igama elingcono kakhulu lishaya elilandelayo kancane. Noma yikuphi ukungabaza kubuza noma nini lapho elinye igama lisondela. Konke ukuma kubuza njalo uma ubambe unyakazi, noma yini ikhibhodi ecabanga ngayo. Amagama afanayo asesikrinini seziphakamiso noma ngabe yikuphi.
Ukuthi ukuswayipha kufanele kusondele kangakanani ngaphambi kokuba kubuze
Bamba umunwe wakho unganyakazi ukuze ukhethe phakathi kwamagama aseduze kakhulu

Ngokuzenzakalelayo igama elintantayo lithatha umbala walo kusuka kutimu yekhibhodi, okuwumbala ofanayo ne-popup yokhiye. Khetha umbala lapha futhi izowusebenzisa esikhundleni salokho. Setha kabusha umugqa ukuze ulandele itimu futhi.
Ukuthi igama lintanta kude kangakanani ngaphezu komunwe wakho

Ngenkathi uslayida, igama ikhibhodi elifunda kuze kube manje lintanta ngaphezu komunwe wakho, futhi liyashintsha njengoba uhamba. Cisha lokhu bese igama livela kuphela emgqeni weziphakamiso. Lokhu akushintshi lokho okuthayishwa ukuslayida.

Isandla sakho simboza uhlangothi olulodwa lomunwe wakho kakhulu kunolunye. Hambisa igama kolunye uhlangothi futhi ungalifunda ngaphandle kokuhambisa isandla sakho. Inani elingalungile lilihambisela kwesobunxele. Inani elihle lilihambisela kwesokudla. Eduze komphetho wekhibhodi igama liyema emaphethelweni.
Hambisa igama kwesobunxele noma kwesokudla somunwe wakho
Lona usayizi wombhalo wegama elintantayo kuphela. Umugqa weziphakamiso nokhiye akushintshi.
Usayizi wegama elintantayo ngaphezu komunwe wakho
Ntanta igama ngaphezu komunwe wakho njengoba uslayida

Ngokuzenzakalelayo igama elintantayo lithatha umbala walo wombhalo kusuka kutimu yekhibhodi. Khetha umbala lapha futhi usebenzisa lowo esikhundleni salokho. Setha kabusha umugqa ukuze ulandele itimu futhi.

Ukuswayipha kutshela ikhibhodi ukuthi yiziphi izinkinobho umunwe wakho owusondele kuzo, ngakho lokho okuncintisana nakho kunquma ukuthi kulungile kangaki. Abantu abaningi babhala ngamagama ayizinkulungwane ezimbalwa, futhi uma ikhibhodi isifunde awakho, lonke isichazamazwi lincintisana kakhulu. \"Amagama ami kuphela\" kuyakususa lokho: ukuthayipha ngokuswayipha kuphendula ngamagama owabhalile, futhi akukho okunye. Ekuhloleni okufunda amagama owabhalayo ngamaphuzu amahlanu ngokunembile, futhi akukwazi ukukhiqiza igama ongakaze ulibhale nhlobo. \"Khetha amagama ami\" akushintshi cishe lutho ngokwalo — kusebenzisa kokubili futhi kubala ukuthi amagama akho ayenele kangaki, okuyilokho \"Okuzenzakalelayo\" okusebenzisayo ukunquma. \"Okuzenzakalelayo\" kuqala \"Egama ngalinye\" futhi kukubuza ngaphambi kokuba kukhuphuke. Noma yini oyikhethayo, ukubuyisela emuva igama eliswayiphiwe kusesha wonke amagama esichazamazwini ngomzila owudwebile, ngakho igama ikhibhodi engalifundanga alisoze laphuma ekufinyeleleni.
Vumela ukuthayipha ngokuswayipha kuncike emagameni ikhibhodi ekufunde kuwe

Uma ukuswayipha kukhipha igama elingalungile, umugqa owudwebile uwona kuphela irekhodi lalokho obukusho — izinhlamvu ezisele embhalweni yisilinganiso sekhibhodi, hhayi indlela yomunwe wakho. Ngakho ikhibhodi igcina imigqa eyishumi nambili yokugcina yomkhakha, futhi ukuthepha emuva kwelinye lalawo magama kungasesha umugqa walo kuzo zonke izinhlu zamagama onazo, ngaphezu kwanoma yimuphi umkhawulo wokuthayipha ngokuswayipha ovame ukusebenza ngawo. Lokho kusesha kuhlale kutholakala: bamba igama emgqeni weziphakamiso bese ukhetha \"Sesha wonke amagama\". Lesi silungiselelo sengeza i-chip eyinikezayo ngaphandle kokubamba, ngezindleko zesikhala esisodwa sesiphakamiso noma nini lapho ufunda igama eliswayiphiwe. Noma iyiphi indlela ofika ngayo kuyo, ukukhipha igama ekusesheni kulungisa umbhalo futhi kufundisa ikhibhodi lowo mugqa, ukuze ukuswayipha okufanayo kufundeke kahle ngokuzayo.
Bonisa inkinobho yokusesha wonke uhlu lwamagama uma uthepha emuva egameni eliswayiphiwe
Nikelela usesho oluphelele ngenkathi uhlola amaphutha

Kulinganiswa ngobubanzi bokhiye. Ikhibhodi inikeza igama kuphela uma umunwe wakho wehlela eduze kakhulu nohlamvu lokuqala lwalelo gama. Inani eliphezulu livumela ukushelela ukuthi kuqale ngaphandle kokhiye futhi kusathole igama. Inani eliphansi lala ukushelela okuqala endaweni engafanele, okuyinto eqinile kodwa engabangela ukulahlekelwa igama obulifuna. Likhuphule leli nani uma ukushelela kwakho kuqala sekwephuzile noma kuphansi.
Ukuthi ukuqala kokuslayida kungaba kude kangakanani nohlamvu lokuqala

Ngenkathi umunwe wakho ucindezelwe, ikhibhodi iphinda ifunde ukushaya izikhathi eziningi ngomzuzwana, futhi ekuqaleni kokushaya kuncane kakhulu okungatholakala — izinhlamvu ezimbili, amagama amaningi asafaneleka. Njengoba evela, iziphakamiso, igama elingaphezu komunwe wakho namagama akuzinkinobho konke kushintsha izikhathi eziningi ngesikhathi sokuslayida, okunzima ukukufunda futhi kudonsa amehlo akho kude nekhibhodi. Lesi silungiselelo senza igama elivele lisesikrinini ligcine indawo yalo ngaphandle kokuthi elinye igama lingcono ngokusobala, futhi linikeza isikhashana sokuzimela ngaphambi kokuthi noma yini ikwazi ukulithatha indawo. Igama eliyeka ukufanelana nokushaya kwakho lishintshwa ngaso leso sikhathi. Ukuphakamisa umunwe wakho kubhala igama olibonayo, ngakho ukubuka kuqala okuzinzile akusho ukuthayipha okuthile obungakuboni. \"Okulula\" kuyisilungiselelo esizenzakalelayo.
Vimbela igama ukuba lingashintshi ngaphansi komunwe wakho ekunyakazeni okuncane ngakunye

Ngenkathi ushelela, umugqa wesiphakamiso ubonisa wonke amagama afanelana nokushaywa kwakho, futhi amagama ayashintsha njengoba uhamba. Vula lokhu futhi umugqa ubonisa kuphela igama elibukwa ikhibhodi manje. Amanye amagama abuyela emgqeni uma uphakamisa umunwe wakho. Uma isikhethi sokungaqiniseki sivuliwe, sisabanikela phakathi nokushaywa. Lokhu akushintshi lokho okuthayishwa ukushelela.
Ngenkathi uswayipha, bonisa igama lamanje kuphela

Ukuswayipha kubuyela ekufundweni ngokumelene nezinkinobho njengoba kudwetshiwe, izimo odweba ngazo amagama nokufunda okulungisile kuyakhohlakala, futhi ukufunda kuqala kabusha kusukela ekuswayipheni kwakho okulandelayo. Amagama afundiwe awathinteki.

Akekho oswayipha phakathi nendawo yawo wonke okhiye. Isithupha sisika okhiye abakude futhi sihlale phansi kwabaseduze, futhi ikhibhodi yayijwayele ukushaja konke ukuswayipha ngalokho. Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, konke ukuswayipha okugcinayo kuqopha lapho umunwe wakho udlule khona ngempela uhlamvu ngalunye, futhi ukuswayipha kwakamuva kufundwa ngokumelene nokhiye abasuswe ukuze bafane. Kugcina ezinye zezimo zakho zegama ngalinye oliswayiphayo futhi ulishiye lunjalo, ngakho igama olidwebe ngaphambili lifundwa ngokumelene nendlela olidweba ngayo kanye nendlela yencwadi. Futhi kukhumbula uma uthatha elinye igama emgqeni, noma ususa igama eliswayiphiwe ngokushesha, ukuze unhlangothi olufanayo lufunde igama lakho kuqala ngokuzayo; iminwe ebhaliwe yalawo magama kuphela egcinwayo, hhayi amagama uqobo. Ukususa igama eliswayiphiwe kuthatha izifundo zalo emuva. Vala lokhu ukuze uqandise lokho okufundiwe, noma sebenzisa i-Forget ngezansi ukuze uqale phansi.
Lapho umunwe wakho ufika khona, indlela obhala ngayo igama ngalinye, nokuthi yikuphi ukufunda okulungisayo

Slayida umunwe wakho usuka kuhlamvu uye kuhlamvu ngaphandle kokuwususa. Ikhibhodi ithayipha igama uma ususa umunwe wakho. Okunye okufundwayo kubonakala emgqeni wesiphakamiso, ngakho ukucindezela okukodwa kulungisa ukuqagela okungalungile. Lokhu kusebenza ngesiNgisi kuphela okwamanje.
Swayipha phezu kwezinhlamvu ukuze uthayiphe igama

I-glide itshela ikhibhodi ukuthi yiziphi izinkinobho umunwe wakho owusondele, nangaluphi uhlelo. Amagama amaningi alingana nalokho ngokukhululekile, ngakho ikhibhodi isebenzisa imvamisa yamagama ukuze ikhethe elilodwa lawo. Isichazamazwi esikhulu siphethe amagama amaningi angavamile, futhi igama elingavamile elisimo salo silingana kangcono linganqoba phezu kwegama obulisho. Lesi silungiselelo sikhawulela i-glide kumagama ajwayelekile kakhulu esichazamazwini. Ishintsha ukuthayipha kwe-glide kuphela. Iziphakamiso, ukuqedwa kwamagama nokulungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo kusasebenzisa wonke amagama, ngoba izinhlamvu ozithayiphayo zisho okuningi kuneswayipha. Amagama owafundisa ikhibhodi awasoze akhawulelwa. Isichazamazwi esiza nekhibhodi sincane kunayo yonke imikhawulo lapha, ngakho lesi silungiselelo asenzi lutho uze ulande noma ungenise uhlu olukhulu lwamagama.
Nciphisa ukushelela emagameni ajwayelekile kakhulu esichazamazwi sakho

Kukalwa ngobubanzi bokhiye. Gcina lokhu ngaphansi kobubanzi bokhiye owodwa, noma igama elisuka kokhiye owodwa liye kokhiye olandelayo bese libuyela emuva lifundeka njengohlamvu olulodwa olubhalwe kabili. Kusetshenziswa kuphela ngenkathi inkinobho engenhla ivuliwe.
Ukuthi umunwe ungahamba ibanga elingakanani ekuhlikihleni

Olunye uphawu abantu abalusebenzisela uhlamvu olubhalwe kabili: esikhundleni sombuthano, basikhipha phezu kokhiye. Lokhu kuvaliwe, ngoba ukujika kancane okudwetshwe ngomunwe ongazinzile kubukeka kufana kakhulu, bese ikhibhodi ibhala izinhlamvu kabili ozibhale kanye. Yivule uma lokhu kuyiphawu olwenzayo.

Inani elingamaphesenti ayi-100 lenza uphawu lube luhle njengombuthano. Inani eliphansi lishiya njengokusikisela, okungase kuhlulwe yigama elivame kakhulu. Kusetshenziswa kuphela ngenkathi iswishi engenhla ivuliwe.
Ukuthi ukuhlikihla kubalwa kangakanani njengobufakazi bezinhlamvu ezimbili
Hlikihla emuva naphambili kokhiye ukuze ubhale uhlamvu kabili
Khulisa indawo yokuthinta yezinhlamvu ozithayiphayo ngokulandelayo
Ukulungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo, izinhlamvu ezinkulu, izimpawu zokuloba kanye nokuhlukanisa
Ukuthayipha ngokuslayida, ukuswayipha kwebha yesikhala nokubhala ngesandla

Lawa manani yindlela ikhibhodi efunda ngayo ukuslayida: ukuthi umunwe wakho kufanele usondele kangakanani ezinkinobho ukuze igama liphakanyiswe, nokuthi yini etshela ikhibhodi ukuthi ubhale uhlamvu kabili. Ziza namanani ikhibhodi elinganiswe ngawo. Hambisa elilodwa, slayida imisho embalwa, bese ucindezela ukusetha kabusha kulayini uma kwenzeke okubi kakhulu. Akukho lapha okungalimaza ikhibhodi.
Izinqamuleli, okhiye abashisayo kanye nokhiye wesinqamuleli
Intanta igama elilandelayo phezu kokhiye ongalifinyelela
Izibalo, izimali, amayunithi, izinsuku kanye nokubheka
Umugqa weziphakamiso, ukufunda, amagama kanye namagama ezinhlelo zokusebenza

Indlela ukulungisa kwakho okwenziwe ngayo, uhlamvu ngohlamvu. Ukulungisa okuzenzakalelayo kubheka lokhu kusebenza njengokungenzeka kuwe, ngakho ukusebenza okufanayo egameni ongakaze ulihlole kusaqondakala.

Izinhlamvu ezifana no-i, j no-t zidinga uphawu oluhlukile ngemuva komzila oyinhloko. Ngalolu sikhathi ngemuva kokudweba umzila, ukucindezela phezu kwezinhlamvu kuba omunye umzila womlingiswa ofanayo, ichashazi noma isiphambano. Akuthayiphi lowo khiye. Ukucindezela ngemuva kwewindi kuthayipha njengokujwayelekile. 0 kuyicisha lokhu.
Isikhathi sokwengeza ichashazi noma isiphambano ngaphambi kokuba ukucindezela kuthayiphe uhlamvu
Shintsha izinhlamvu, lungisa futhi uphakamise njengoba uthayipha kukhibhodi engokoqobo

Ukhiye ngamunye ubonisa uhlamvu lwawo lokuqala lokucindezela nokubamba ekhoneni, njengo-1 ku-q. Ukuswayipha okufushane, okusheshayo phansi okhiye kuthayipha lolo hlamvu ngaphandle kokubamba. Lokhu kusebenza kunoma yimuphi ukhiye onohlamvu lokucindezela nokubamba, kuzo zonke izingqimba. Ibha yesikhala, i-backspace kanye nokhiye bokushintsha nokulungisa bagcina ukuswayipha kwabo. Ukuswayipha kufanele kube kufushane, kuqonde phansi futhi kusheshe. Ukuhudula okude noma okunensa kuwukushelela, njengakuqala. Uma ukuthayipha kokushelela kuvuliwe, ukushelela okusheshayo kakhulu kwegama elifushane eliya phansi ngqo, njengo-\"ed\", kungathayipha icebo esikhundleni salokho. Lesi silungiselelo sivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Ukuswayipha okusheshayo phansi kukhiye kuthayipha uhlamvu lwayo oluncane lwekhona

Isikhala esithayiphelwe ngephutha phambi kophawu lokubhala siyasuswa lapho uphawu lufika. Uphawu kumele luze ngemuva kwegama, inombolo noma kubakaki abavalayo, ngakho uphawu ekuqaleni komugqa luyashiywa. Isikhala esisodwa emuva kwesikhala sibuyisela isikhala. Kuvaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo: ezinye izilimi zibeka isikhala phambi kophawu lombuzo noma ikholoni ngenhloso. Ikhibhodi ishiya izinkambu ezihleliwe zodwa: amaphasiwedi, amakheli e-imeyili, amakheli ewebhu, amaphedi ezinombolo namaphedi efoni.
Uhlamvu olulodwa lophawu ngalunye, ngaphandle kwezikhala phakathi kwazo

Ngekhibhodi engokoqobo, ngokuvamile akukho ikhibhodi esesikrinini, futhi ithuluzi alinawo umkhathi wokudweba. Ngalolu hlelo luvuliwe, isinqumo esivula ithuluzi sibonisa ikhibhodi. Uma uvala ithuluzi, ikhibhodi iyacasha futhi.
Isinqamuleli esivula ithuluzi siphinde sibonise ikhibhodi
I-Ctrl+1 ivula ibhokisi lamathuluzi, i-Ctrl+2 ithuluzi lokuqala, njalonjalo
I-Ctrl + inombolo ivula ithuluzi lebhala lamathuluzi
Indandatho kukhiye owodwa; inkinobho emaphakathi noma u-Enter iyayithayipha
I-Escape ivala kuphela lokho ikhibhodi evulekile. Uma kungekho thuluzi elivulekile, i-Escape iya ngqo kuhlelo lokusebenza, ngakho isayeka ukulayishwa kwekhasi noma iphuma kumodi yokufaka kusihleli.
I-Escape ivala ithuluzi elivuliwe esikhundleni sokuya kuhlelo lokusebenza

I-Ctrl+Space iya olimini olulandelayo kanti i-Ctrl+Shift+Space iya kulolo olungaphambi kwalo. Gcina i-Ctrl icindezelwe bese ucindezela i-Space futhi ukuze udlule ohlwini esikrinini — ikhibhodi iyashintsha uma i-Ctrl ikhishwa. I-Esc iyakhansela. Ezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza zisebenzisa i-Ctrl+Space ngokwazo, isibonelo abahleli bekhodi bayisebenzisa ukubonisa ukuqedwa. Ngenkathi lokhu kuvuliwe, ikhibhodi ithatha isinqamuleli uma uthayipha kulezo zinhlelo zokusebenza — yicime lapha ukuze uyibuyisele. Uma ukhiye wesinqamuleli ovula amathuluzi nawo usethwe ku-Ctrl+Space, ukushintsha kolimi kuyawina. Ikhibhodi enokhiye wayo wolimi ayidingi lesi silungiselelo: lowo khiye uhlale usebenza.
Bamba u-Ctrl ukuze uphequlule uhlu lolimi, dedela ukuze ushintshe

Kwekhibhodi eyenzelwe i-Mac. I-Command ingukhiye oseduze nebha yesikhala. I-Command+C, Command+V, Command+X kanye ne-Command+A kopisha, namathisela, sika futhi ukhethe konke. I-Command+Z ukuhlehlisa futhi i-Command+Shift+Z ukwenza futhi. I-Command+Left kanye ne-Command+Right ziya ekuqaleni nasekupheleni komugqa. I-Option+Left kanye ne-Option+Right zihambisa igama elilodwa. I-Option+Backspace isusa igama elilodwa, kanti i-Command+Backspace isusa kuze kube sekuqaleni komugqa. Bamba i-Shift ngokuhambisa ukuze ukhethe. I-Ctrl igcina ukuziphatha kwayo okujwayelekile, futhi zonke ezinye izinqamuleli ze-Command ziya kuhlelo lokusebenza. Amanye amadivayisi agcina inani elincane lezinqamuleli ze-Command zesistimu, futhi lezo azifinyeleli kukhibhodi.
I-Command ne-Option ziziphatha ngendlela eziziphatha ngayo ku-Mac
Bonisa u-Ctrl no-Shift okhiye esikhundleni sezimpawu zabo

Kuthuluzi, okhiye bomcibisholo bahambisa ukugqamisa phezu kwe-emoji, iziqeshana noma imiphumela. U-Enter usebenzisa into enokugqamisa. U-Tab uhambisa phakathi kwebhokisi lokusesha, ama-chips esigaba kanye nemiphumela. Ukugqamisa kubonakala kuphela ngemva kokuba ucindezele ukhiye. Akusoze kwavela ngenkathi usebenzisa ikhibhodi ngokuthinta.
Imicibisholo ihambisa okugqanyisiwe ethuluzini, u-Enter ukukhetha, u-Esc uvalela ithuluzi
Ukuthi okhiye bahlala isikhathi esingakanani esikrinini ngemva kokhiye wesinqamuleli
Vula amathuluzi kusuka kukhibhodi yangempela ngaphandle kokuthinta isikrini

Isiphakamiso ngasinye sikhombisa ukhiye osikhethayo, inqobo nje uma ikhibhodi engokomzimba ixhunyiwe. Lokhu kusebenza kuphela ku-\"Alt + inombolo\", engadingi ukhiye wesinqamuleli kuqala. Nge-\"Ngemva kokhiye wesinqamuleli\", izinombolo zivela ngemva kokuba ucindezele ukhiye wesinqamuleli, ngoba yilapho zisebenza khona.
Beka ukhiye ngaphansi kwesiphakamiso ngasinye ngenkathi ikhibhodi engokoqobo ixhunyiwe
Ukhiye owodwa ngaphansi, kodwa izinhlelo zokusebenza eziningi zisebenzisa u-Alt nenombolo kumathebhu azo

Awukwazi ukucindezela umugqa wesiphakamiso ngenkathi uthayipha kukhibhodi engokoqobo. Inkinobho yenombolo ikhetha isiphakamiso esikhundleni salokho. \"Ngemva kokhiye wesinqamuleli\" yisinqumo esiphephile, ngoba akukho okunye okuyisebenzisayo. \"Alt + inombolo\" idinga ukhiye owodwa omncane, kodwa iziphequluli, abahleli nezinhlelo zokusebenza zengxoxo zisebenzisa isilungisi nenombolo ukushintsha amathebhu nezindawo zokusebenza.
Ukukhetha okuphephile. Akukho okunye okusebenzisa ukhiye wesinqamuleli
Thayipha isiphakamiso ngenombolo yaso emgqeni weziphakamiso

Uma ukhetha inkambu yokungena, umphathi wakho wamaphasiwedi angahlinzeka ngamafayela alondoloziwe njengezinto ezincane emgqeni wokuphakamisa, esikhundleni se-popup ehlukile. Umphathi wamaphasiwedi uzidweba ngokwakhe lezo zinto. Ikhibhodi ithola usayizi wazo kuphela, futhi ayikaze ibone igama lomsebenzisi noma iphasiwedi ekuzona. Imodi ye-Incognito iyayicisha le nto ngokwayo. Lesi silungiselelo sidinga i-Android 11 noma entsha, kanye nomphathi wamaphasiwedi osethwe njengensiza yakho yokugcwalisa ngokuzenzakalela yohlelo.
Bonisa ukungena okugciniwe okuvela kusevisi yakho yokugcwalisa ngokuzenzakalelayo kumugqa wesiphakamiso

Thayipha ikholoni ekuqaleni kwegama ukuze ushintshe umugqa wokusikisela ube ukusesha kwe-emoji. \":cat\" inikeza 🐱, futhi ukucindezela kuthatha indawo yombhalo owuthayiphile. Cindezela inkinobho yokususa phezu kwekholoni ukuze ubuyele eziphakamisweni zamagama ezijwayelekile. Cindezela isikhala ukuze ugcine umbhalo njengoba uwuthayiphile.
Thayipha u-\":\" negama ukuze uthole i-emoji, njenge :smi ye-😄
Ukulungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo kulandela ulimi olutholiwe ngokumelene namagama ajwayelekile futhi
Ukutholwa okucacile kuthatha umkhondo, futhi ukulungisa okuzenzakalelayo kuyakulandela

Ikhibhodi igcina irekhodi, ngohlelo lokusebenza, lokuthi yiziphi izilimi zakho amagama owathayiphayo lapho angawazo. Uma uvula inkambu yombhalo kulolo hlelo lokusebenza, ukutholwa kuqala kulelo rekhodi esikhundleni sokungabi nalutho, ngakho umyalezo omusha kuhlelo lokusebenza lwengxoxo obhala ngalo i-Banglish utshekela ku-Banglish ngaphambi kokuba uthayiphe igama, futhi i-imeyili entsha iqala ngesiNgisi. Ukutsheka kubiza cishe igama elilodwa elithayiphiwe lobufakazi kakhulu, ngakho igama lokuqala olithayiphayo empeleni liyadlula futhi umyalezo ngolunye ulimi awulwiwa. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezinamagama ambalwa nje omlando zitshekela kancane. Irekhodi lihlala kule divayisi futhi lisulwa kanye nalo lonke idatha efundiwe.
Qala ngolimi ovame ukubhala ngalo kulolu hlelo lokusebenza
Ihlela kabusha iziphakamiso kuphela. Ulimi lwekhibhodi yakho luhlala lunqoba

Uma izilimi zakho zisebenzisa ikhibhodi efanayo, amagama asevele enkundleni yombhalo akhombisa ukuthi yiluphi ulimi olubhalayo manje. Ikhibhodi ithambekela eziphakamisweni zayo kanye nokulungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo kulolo limi, futhi ibuyela emuva uma ushintsha. Thayipha i-ami tomake kukhibhodi yesiNgisi futhi izoziphatha njenge-Banglish; thayipha i-how are you futhi izoziphatha njengesiNgisi futhi. Lokhu kusebenza ngenkundla yombhalo ngayinye futhi kudinga izilimi ezine-Also suggest from esethiwe, okuyinto izilimi zesi-romanized ezithola ngokuzenzakalelayo.

I-Gentle ihlela kabusha iziphakamiso kuphela futhi ayilokothi ivumele ulimi olutholiwe ukuba lunqobe olwekhibhodi. I-Balanced ivumela ulimi olutholiwe ngokucacile ukuba luhole, futhi ukulungisa okuzenzakalelayo kulandela wonke amagama ngaphandle kwawona ajwayelekile kakhulu. I-Aggressive inikela ngokuphelele, ngakho ukulungisa okuzenzakalelayo kulungisa amaphutha olimini olutholiwe ngisho naphambene namagama ajwayelekile kakhulu olimi lwekhibhodi.

Lesi yisikhethi esivuleka uma ubamba ibha yesikhala unezakhiwo ezingaphezu kwezine ezivuliwe, noma ucindezela ubambe ukhiye we-🌐. Uhlu lubonisa izakhiwo zakho kusuka phezulu kuye phansi, futhi ukubamba ibha yesikhala kuyayinyusa futhi kuyayiyehlisa. I-Carousel ibabonisa eceleni, igxile kulowo othayipha kuwo, futhi ukubamba okufanayo kuyayihambisa kwesobunxele nakwesokudla, ngendlela ukuswayipha kwebha yesikhala okuhamba ngayo kakade. Zombili zikuvumela ukuthi uthephe isakhiwo, futhi zombili zigcina Amanye amakhibhodi… ekugcineni.
Uhlu ongahudula kulo, noma i-carousel egcina ukuswayipha eceleni

IsiFulentshi sigcina isikhala phambi kophawu lokumemeza, uphawu lombuzo, i-semicolon, i-colon kanye ne-guillemet yokuvala, kanye nesikhala ngemuva kwe-guillemet yokuvula, kanjalo nesiBreton, isi-Occitan, isi-Walloon, isi-Picard, isi-Norman nesi-Franco-Provençal. Ikhibhodi ithayipha leso sikhala kuwe futhi ivimbele yonke eminye imithetho ukuthi ingasithathi. Kuyisikhala esingaphuli, ngakho uphawu alusoze lwasongeka emgqeni olandelayo lodwa. Uphawu kumele lulandele igama, inombolo noma ubakaki wokuvala, ngakho olulodwa ekuqaleni komugqa lushiywa lodwa. I-backspace eyodwa ngemuva nje isusa isikhala futhi. Zonke ezinye izilimi zithayipha njengakuqala. Ikhibhodi ishiya imikhakha ehleliwe yodwa: amaphasiwedi, amakheli e-imeyili, amakheli ewebhu, amaphedi ezinombolo namaphedi ocingo.

Uma ubuyela emuva ulungise igama ngesandla, ikhibhodi iyakhumbula ukuthi uthayipheni nokuthi ukushintshelephi. Lungisa iphutha elifanayo kabili bese ukulungisa okuzenzakalelayo kukwenzela lokho kulungisa kusukela lapho. Ngemuva kokulungisa okukodwa ikunikeza ukulungisa emgqeni esikhundleni salokho. Ikhibhodi iphinde ifunde iphutha elingemuva kokulungisa ngakunye, njengokushaya u-3 esikhundleni sika-e noma u-b esikhundleni sebha yesikhala, ukuze iphutha elifanayo kwamanye amagama liqondakale. Hlehlisa ukulungisa okufundiwe bese ikhibhodi iyayeka ukukwenza. Igama eliwigama langempela, njenge-form esikhundleni se-from, lishintsha kuphela ngemuva kokulungisa kathathu nalapho amagama akulo evumelana.
Amaphutha owalungisa ngesandla afundisa ukulungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo

Ikhibhodi ayilokothi ilungise igama elikufundile kuwe. Lokho kuvikela amagama akho nezinkulumo ezijwayelekile, kodwa futhi kusho ukuthi iphutha elilodwa olenzayo kanye livikelwe phakade. Khulisa lokhu ukuze wenze ikhibhodi ilinde ize ibone igama ngaphezu kwesikhathi esisodwa. Iziphakamiso azithinteki: igama elingaphansi kwalesi sibalo lingase lisaphakanyiswa, alivikelwe nje ekulungisweni. Lesi silungiselelo sisezingeni elilodwa ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Mangaki amathuba owabhala igama ngaphambi kokuba ukulungisa okuzenzakalelayo kukuyeke
Konke ukulungisa okufundisile kanye nakho konke ukushelela ikhibhodi ekubonile kukhohliwe. Amagama afundiwe nokulungiswa okungakenzeki akuthinteki.
