resources.string: Akukho okufundiwe okwamanje. Lungisa iphutha lokuthayipha ngesandla bese umbhangqwana uvela lapha uma umbhalo usuzinzile.
Ukulungisa okufundise ikhibhodi, kanye namaphutha eyibonile

Lapho ukubhala ngesandla kukhethiwe, ikhibhodi ifunda ukuswayipha phezu kwezikhi njengokubhala ngesandla. Dweba incwadi noma igama. Ngemuva kwekhefu elifushane ikhibhodi iyakubona lokho bese iyakubhala, futhi inikeza okunye ukufundwa emgqeni wesiphakamiso. Lokhu kudinga imodeli yokubhala ngesandla (Izilungiselelo → Ukubhala ngesandla). Ukucindezela okuvamile kusayithayipha ikhi yayo.
Dweba izinhlamvu phezu kwezinkinobho esikhundleni sokuthayipha ngokuslayida
Dweba incwadi noma igama phezu kwezinkinobho. Lokhu kudinga imodeli yokubhala ngesandla
Ukuswayipha phezu kokhiye kupela igama elilodwa

Amagama kuphela angaziwa isichazamazwi abalwayo. Igama elivele likusichazamazwi lifundwa ngesikhathi ulibhala. Ukusetshenziswa kubalwa kuphela uma usudlule futhi walishiya igama, ngakho iphutha lokubhala obuyela emuva ulilungise alibalwa neze. Yehlisa lokhu uma amagama akho kanye nezinkulumo ezijwayelekile kuthatha isikhathi eside ukubambeka. Yibeke ku-1 ukuze ulondoloze igama elisha ngokushesha, okuyilokho okwakwenziwa izinguqulo ezindala. Lesi silungiselelo siba ku-3 ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Mangaki izikhathi lapho uthayipha igama elingaqashelwa muntu ngaphambi kokuba lilondolozwe

Njengoba umugqa wezinombolo ucishiwe, umugqa ongaphezulu wezinhlamvu ubonisa inombolo encane ekhoneni ngalinye. Uma zonke izinhlamvu zegama ozibhayo zihlala kulezo zinkinobho, umugqa unikeza inombolo lezo zinombolo ezizipela endaweni yazo yokugcina, eceleni kwamagama, futhi ukucindezela okukodwa kuyayibhala. Igama ngokwalo alikaze lishintshwe ngaphandle kokucindezela. Izinhlamvu ezimbili noma ngaphezulu ziyadingeka, ngakho u-I owodwa noma u-A owodwa uhlala uyigama. Inombolo yezinombolo ezinhlanu noma ngaphezulu ihlelwa ngezihlukanisi uma Ukuhlela izinombolo ezinde kuvuliwe, kusetshenziswa isitayela sayo sokuhlela. Akukho okuhlinzekwayo ngenkathi umugqa wezinombolo uboniswa, njengoba izinombolo ziba sezinkinobho zazo. Lesi silungiselelo sicishiwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Thayipha u-qwe umugqa wezinombolo uvaliwe futhi umugqa uphinde unikeze u-123

Njengoba umugqa wezinombolo uvuliwe, ukuthepha okuhloselwe umugqa wezinhlamvu ophezulu kungahlala kudijithi, futhi i-as3 ivela esikhundleni se-ase. Nalesi silungiselelo sivuliwe, idijithi eyodwa ngaphakathi kwegama ingalungiswa ibe uhlamvu olungaphansi kwayo uma ucindezela isikhala. Ukulungiswa kushintsha kuphela idijithi ibe uhlamvu. Igama eliqala ngedijithi, negama elinezidijithi ezimbili noma ngaphezulu, alishintshi neze. Lesi silungiselelo sisebenza kuphela ngenkathi umugqa wezinombolo uboniswa.
Lungisa idijithi edukile uye encwadini engaphansi kwayo

Ku-3 noma ku-4 amagama kuphela ikhibhodi eqiniseka ngawo avela, okuyindlela i-BlackBerry eyenza ngayo, futhi ibhodi livame ukuhlala lingenalutho. Amanani aphezulu agcwalisa okhiye abaningi, futhi ngemva kuka-9 ikhibhodi ibheka igama lakho konke ukhiye engakwazi, okuyindlela ikhibhodi ye-Octopus eyenza ngayo. Ibhodi alikaze libonise igama elingakwazi ukulingana; ukhiye omncane kakhulu wegama ushiywa ungenalutho.
Mangaki amagama angahlala okhiye ngesikhathi esisodwa

Ikhibhodi ibhala igama elincane ngaphezu kwenkinobho elizoqhubeka negama olithayiphayo. Ngokuthayipha \"hel\", \"hello\" ihlala phezu kuka-l, \"help\" phezu kuka-p. Swayiphela phezulu kuleyo nkinobho, noma uthephe igama uqobo, bese lonke igama liyabhalwa. Ngemuva kwesikhala, ikhibhodi inikeza amagama alandelayo aphelele ngaphezu kwezinhlamvu zawo zokuqala esikhundleni salokho. Umugqa weziphakamiso uyaqhubeka nokusebenza njengakuqala; lokhu kwengeza kuphela kuwo. I-BlackBerry Z10 ithayiphe ngale ndlela, futhi yilokho ikhibhodi ye-Octopus ekukopishe.
Intanta igama elibikezelwe phezu kokhiye ozowucindezela ngokulandelayo

Flick phezulu ukusuka ekhiye ephethe igama bese lonke igama libhalwa. Okubalulekile yisiqondiso, hhayi isivinini: unhlangothi kufanele luye phezulu, futhi luye lapho luqonde kahle. Unhlangothi olutshekile noma olugobile luphathwa njengesiqalo sokuslayida esikhundleni salokho. I-flick ephuthelwayo imane ithayiphe uhlamvu. Ngamagama akhiye avuliwe, ukuslayida okuqala kuqonde phezulu ukusuka ekhiye ephethe eyodwa kunzima ukuqala; lokho ukuhweba.
Ukuthinta okusheshayo phezulu kukhiye kubhala igama lawo

Umugqa nomunwe onganyakazi ufuna izinto ezahlukene ezikhiye, ngakho ukuswayipha kunempendulo yako lapha futhi Okungase kuvele kushiywe ukusho ukuthi igama elithayiphiwe linganikeza ini. Akukho okugcina ibhodi lingenalutho uze uphakamise, okuyilokho okufunwa iningi labathayiphi abaswayiphayo: phakathi nokuswayipha ukuqedela akukwazi ukuthathwa futhi ukulungiswa akukwazi ukwahlulelwa. Okunye ukufunda kukhombisa ezinye izinketho ikhibhodi esazibambile, ngayinye ngaphezu kwesikhiye esiyifinyelelayo, ukuze ukwazi ukuqondisa kwenye. Igama elilandelayo linikeza lokho okungalandela igama olidwebayo, ngaphezu kwesikhiye eliqala ngaso, ukuze likwazi ukuflikwa ngesikhathi ukuswayipha kuphela. Noma yikuphi okukhethayo, ukuphakamisa umunwe wakho kubeka igama elilandelayo ezikhiyeni njengenjwayelo.

Uhlamvu oluncane ekhoneni eliphezulu lokhiye kanye negama elintantayo ziseduze ngokwanele ukuba zifundwe njengento eyodwa. Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, ukhiye obonisa igama ufihla iseluleko sawo sekhona isikhathi eside njengoba igama likhona; okhiye abangenalutho abazokusho bagcina okwabo.
Inkinobho ephethe igama ilahla iseluleko sayo sokucindezela isikhathi eside

Ukuqedela kuqhubeka negama olithayiphayo. Izilungiso ziyalilungisa, futhi zihlala phezu kokhiye lapho igama liyeka khona ukufana nalokho okuthayiphile, ngakho zidwetshwa ngombala ohlukile. Amagama alandelayo avela ngemva kwesikhala, ngaphezu kwezinhlamvu zawo zokuqala, ngaphambi kokuba uthayiphe noma yini. Ukucisha zontathu kushiya okhiye bengenalutho, okufana nokucisha sonke isici.

Ivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo. Igama elintantayo phezu kokhiye lithembisa ukuthi ukucindezela lowo khiye kubhala ingxenye elandelayo yalo, futhi uhlamvu ongalufinyelela kuphela ngokubamba ukhiye luyasiphula leso sithembiso. Ukuyivula lokhu kufinyelela amagama amaningi, ngenani lokuthi okhiye abathile banikeza igama elingeke liqedwe ngokucindezela nje.
Vumela amagama adinga ukucindezelwa isikhathi eside ukuze afinyelele uhlamvu lwawo olulandelayo

Ngenhla kwenkinobho kubeka igama ngalinye esikhaleni esingaphezu kwenkinobho yalo, ingxenye isenkinobheni kanti ingxenye ingaphezulu kwayo, futhi ikhibhodi ihlala inobude obufanayo. Umzila wami unika umugqa ngamunye umzila wawo ukuze kungabikho okugqagqana nanoma yini, futhi ikhibhodi ikhula kancane. Ngaphakathi kwenkinobho kubhala igama phezu kohlamvu, okungagqagqani kodwa kushiya kokubili indawo encane kakhulu.
Ngaphezu kokhiye, emzileni wawo, noma ngaphakathi kokhiye

Isilungiselelo ngasinye siwumumo onjengekhoni ozungeze phezulu, nokuthi umnyakazo kufanele uqonde kangakanani. Okunzima kudinga ukuswayipha okuqonde ngqo, okuyilokho okufunayo uma uswayipha kakhulu futhi uthola ukuthi ukuswayipha kwakho kuthathwa njengokukhetha. Okukhululekile kwamukela cishe noma yini eya phezulu, emabhodini lapho amagama ebaluleke kakhulu kunezwayipho. Okulinganiselayo kuphakathi kwakho kokubili.
Kude kangakanani ukushelela okungase kuthambekele phezulu futhi kusakwazi ukukhetha

Isiphindaphindi sosayizi amacebiso amancane ekhona awusebenzisayo. Amagama amakhulu kulula ukuwafunda kodwa agqagqana nomakhelwane bawo ngokushesha, futhi igama elingasalingani phezu kokhiye walo liyalahlwa esikhundleni sokufushaniswa ngaphezu kokufunda.

Igama elilodwa kukhiye ngamunye yikho okudwetshwe amakhibhodi e-BlackBerry ne-Octopus, futhi yikho konke okulingana kukhiye wosayizi wefoni. Kuthebhulethi izinkinobho zinde ngokwanele ezimbili noma ezintathu, zibekwe kude nokhiye onegama elingase libe yilo eliseduze kakhulu. Ukuswayiphela phezulu kuthatha igama eliseduze; ukuthepha kuthatha igama olithintayo. Mangaki amagama asakhawulela ikhibhodi yonke.
Mangaki amagama angathwalwa ukhiye owodwa, ebekwe ngokulandelana

Thepha ngqo egameni elintantayo ukuze ulibhale. Lokhu kulula ukukuthola kunokuflick, kodwa amagama angamalitshe amancane. Amagama emugqeni ongaphezulu alenga kancane ngaphezu kwekhibhodi, futhi ingxenye kuphela engaphezu kokhiye engathintwa; i-flick isebenza kuwo wonke.

Ukulungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo kufanele kuqiniseke cishe ngokuphelele ngaphambi kokuba kushintshe igama ngokwalo, ngoba ukwenza iphutha kulokho kubhala kabusha lokho obukubhalile futhi kungenzeka ungakuqapheli. Konke okungaphansi kokuqiniseka kwakulahliwa, ngisho nalapho kungenzeka ukuthi bekulungile. Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, lokho kuvela njengethiphu ekuqaleni komugqa weziphakamiso. Thepha ukuze usebenzise ukulungisa, noma uqhubeke uthayipha bese kuyanyamalala. Ukulungisa osuvele ukuhlehlisile kanye akusoze kwanikezwa. Kuvuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo, futhi kuvela kuphela lapho bekungekho lutho olwenzekayo.
Bonisa ithiphu yokulungisa okwakuseduze, esikhundleni sokuyilahla
I-chip ayikakwazi ukubona amakhodi afikayo. Cindezela ukuze uvule isishintshi sesistimu

Ikhibhodi ibheka izaziso ezingenayo ukuze ithole ikhodi yesikhathi esisodwa. Uma ithola eyodwa, i-chip enekhodi negama lohlelo lokusebenza oluyithumele ivela ngaphezu kwezikhiye. Cindezela i-chip ukuze uthayiphe ikhodi. Lokhu kudinga ukufinyelela kwesaziso. Ikhibhodi ifunda izaziso kudivayisi yakho kuphela, igcina ikhodi kwimemori kuphela, futhi ayithumeli lutho ndawo. Vala lokhu futhi ikhibhodi iyayeka ukufunda izaziso ngaso leso sikhathi.
Lapho ikhodi yokuqinisekisa ifika kwisaziso, yiphakamise ngaphezu kwezikhiye. Ukucindezela okukodwa kuyayithayipha

Ibhokisi lekhodi ngokuvamile licela ikhiphedi yezinombolo, noma lizibiza ngokuthi \"OTP\", \"PIN\" noma \"ikhodi yokuqinisekisa\". Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, i-chip ibonakala lapho kuphela hhayi kwenye indawo. Ezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza azinikezi ibhokisi lekhodi, futhi i-chip ayikwazi ukulithola — kushiye lokhu kuvaliwe futhi ikhodi izonikezwa kunoma yimuphi umkhakha ngenkathi isasebenza.
Bonisa i-chip kuphela lapho uhlelo lokusebenza lucela ikhodi, esikhundleni sokuba kuyo yonke imikhakha

Ikhodi esetshenzisiwe ayinasizathu sokuhlala ethunzini. Ngemva kokuba i-chip ithayiphe ikhodi, ikhibhodi iyasusa isaziso evela kuso. Lokhu kusebenzisa ukufinyelela kwesaziso okufanayo. Ezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza zithumela ikhodi yazo futhi ngemva kokususwa; cisha lokhu uma lokho kukukhathaza.
Chitha isaziso sekhodi ngemva kokuba ithiphu isithayiphile

Izinhlelo zokusebenza namawebhusayithi amaningi ahlukanisa ikhodi emgqeni wamabhokisi amancane, uhlamvu olulodwa ngalinye, bese edlulela ebhokisini elilandelayo. Ikhodi ephelele ethunyelwe ngesikhathi esisodwa ingena ebhokisini lokuqala, eligcina uhlamvu olulodwa bese lilahla okunye. Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, ikhibhodi ithayipha ikhodi uhlamvu ngalunye, ukuze ibhokisi ngalinye lithole elalo. Lokhu kusebenza kumakhodi avela ezazisweni nakumakhodi ananyathiselwe kusuka kubhodi lokunamathisela.
Kuma-fomu anikeza uhlamvu ngalunye lwekhodi ibhokisi lalo
Buyekeza, susa noma engeza amagama afundwe ikhibhodi
Slayida kusuka kukhiye wokhefana uye ku-s. Ukucindezela kusathayipha ukhefana

Khetha ukhiye lapha. Ukuswayipha okufushane nokuqondile ukusuka kulowo khiye kuya kokhiye u-s kwengeza u-\'s egameni elingaphambi kwekhesa, ngakho \"developer\" iba \"developer\'s\". Lokhu kusebenza ngemva kokuba uthayiphe igama nangemva kokuba uswayiphe elilodwa, ngokuthayipha okuswayiphelwayo kuvuliwe noma kuvaliwe. Isikhala ngemva kwegama sihamba ngemva kuka-\'s. Ukhiye usathayipha uhlamvu lwawo uma uwucindezela. Ukuswayipha kufanele kube kufushane futhi kuqonde. Indlela ende esuka kulowo khiye ofanayo iye ku-s iwukuswayipha, njengakuqala. Lokhu kusebenza ngesiNgisi kuphela. Ibha yesikhala ayikwazi ukuqala lokhu kuswayipha.
Swayipha kusuka kukhiye wokukhomba uye ku-s, lapho isakhiwo sinokukodwa
Swayipha kusuka kukhiye wesikhathi uye ku-s. Ukucindezela kusathayipha isikhathi
Swayipha kusuka kukhiye wokumisa amagama uye ku-s ukuze ungeze u-\'s egameni lokugcina

Umuntu ozongenela okhethweni ongcono kakhulu, lowo okhethwa ukulungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo, uya phakathi nomugqa. Umuntu ozongenela okhethweni wesibili uya kwesobunxele sakhe. Izikhibhodi eziningi zisebenzisa lesi sakhiwo. Vala lokhu ukuze uhlele abazongenela okhethweni kusuka kwesobunxele kuye kwesokudla.
Bonisa umuntu ozongenela okhethweni ongcono kakhulu endaweni ephakathi
Uphawu olulodwa ngohlamvu, ngokulandelana okufunayo. Shiya kungenalutho ukuze uthole . , ? ! \'

Ikhibhodi yengeza umugqa omfushane wezimpawu zokuloba ezivamile ekupheleni komugqa weziphakamiso ngenkathi amagama ashiwo evela. Isikhathi noma ukhefana kutholakala ngokucindezela kanye, ngaphandle koshintsho kusakhiwo sezimpawu. Ukucindezela kusebenza ngokufanayo nokhiye. Lapho ikhibhodi inikeza isibikezelo se-emoji, i-emoji ithatha ukuphela komugqa esikhundleni salokho.
Izinketho ze-. , ? ! kanye no-\' eceleni kwamagama aphakanyisiwe

Isisindo esifundiwe sihlela ukubala okufanayo okuboniswa isichazamazwi somuntu siqu: ukuthi ikhibhodi icabanga ukuthi ulithayiphe kangaki igama. Ayikwazi ukuphusha igama ngaphansi kwe-oda lohlu lwamagama, futhi 0 ikhohlwa igama. Ukulungiswa kwezinga kugcina ukulungiselelwa okuhlukile phezulu noma phansi kwegama okusebenza phezu kwayo yonke imigqa, ngakho noma yiliphi igama lingahamba nganoma iyiphi indlela ngaphandle kokushintsha lokho ikhibhodi ekufundile. Isisindo esifundiwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Ihambisa igama phezulu noma phansi emgqeni, noma ngabe livela kuliphi uhlu
Lokho okuhlelwa ukulawulwa kwezinga lekhadi legama
Ishintsha ukuthi isichazamazwi somuntu siwubona kangaki umusho owubhalile

Amagama okuxoxa afana ne-lol ne-gonna azoba sezingeni eliphezulu kancane ezinhlelweni zokuthumela imiyalezo, futhi aphansi kancane ezinhlelweni ze-imeyili nasezinkundleni ze-imeyili. Lokhu kuhlela kabusha iziphakamiso kuphela. Alikho igama elifihliwe noma elivinjiwe, futhi ukulungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo akushintshi.
Amagama ajwayelekile abaluleke kakhulu ezingxoxweni, kanti abaluleke kancane kuma-imeyili

Izinkambu zokuxoxa nokusesha zitshela ikhibhodi ukuthi u-Enter usho ukuthumela, hamba noma sesha. Ngokuvamile awukwazi ukubeka ikhefu lomugqa emlayezo ngaphandle kokuwuthumela. Ngalolu hlelo luvuliwe, cindezela u-shift kuqala, noma ubambe u-shift kukhibhodi engokomzimba, futhi u-Enter uthayipha umugqa omusha wangempela. Ukhiye u-Enter ubonisa uphawu lomugqa omusha ngenkathi u-shift ehlomile, ukuze ubone umphumela ngaphambi kokuba uwucindezele. U-shift owucindezela wena kuphela obalwayo. Ikhibhodi ayinaki u-shift izinhlamvu ezinkulu ezizenzakalelayo ezihlome ekuqaleni komlayezo, ngakho umugqa wokuqala womlayezo usathunyelwa. Ikhibhodi iphinde inganaki ukhiye we-caps lock. Lolu hlelo luvaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo, ngoba ukuziphatha okujwayelekile ukulandela isenzo sika-Enter sohlelo lokusebenza.
Engeza ikhefu lomugqa kuhlelo lokusebenza lwengxoxo esikhundleni sokuthumela umlayezo

Ukulayida igama bekusho ukuma ukuze uthephe u-Shift kuqala, okuyinto ephazamisa ukubhala. Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, dweba ngokusebenzisa ukhiye u-Shift endleleni yakho bese igama liphuma linezinhlamvu ezinkulu; liwele kabili bese lonke igama liba nezinhlamvu ezinkulu. Ukhiye kufanele uwelwe ngempela, futhi ingxenye yawo yendlela iyanakwa uma igama lifundwa, ngakho ukuchezuka akungezi nhlamvu.
Dweba ngokhiye we-Shift phakathi nokuswayipha ukuze uthole uhlamvu olukhulu
Slayida phezu kuka-Shift ukuze wenze izinhlamvu ezinkulu

Igama lonke: ukudlula okukodwa kwenza igama libe nosonhlamvukazi futhi ukudlula kwesibili kwenza konke kube nosonhlamvukazi. Uhlamvu olulodwa: ukudlula ngakunye phezu kuka-Shift kwenza uhlamvu owusuka kulo lube nosonhlamvukazi, ngakho ukushaya kungabhala u-HeLLo noma u-LeanType, futhi ukuqeda ukushaya kukhiye ka-Shift kwenza igama lonke libe nosonhlamvukazi ohambweni olulodwa.
Igama lonke, noma uhlamvu osusanda kusuka kulo

Uma ukhetha umbhalo bese ucindezela u-shift, ikhibhodi ishintsha usayizi wohlamvu lokukhethiwe. Ayiwuvuli u-shift ohlamvini olulandelayo. Ukucindezela ngakunye kudlula ezinhlamvini ezincane, Usayizi Wesihloko kanye nezinhlamvu EZINKULU. Akukho okushintshayo ezinhlelweni ezingenazo izinhlamvu ezinkulu/ezincane, njengesi-Bengali. Vala lokhu ukuze ugcine u-shift ohlamvini olulandelayo kuphela, ngisho nalapho umbhalo ukhethiwe.
Ukushintsha umbhalo okhethiwe kuhlanganisa izinhlamvu ezincane, Izinhlamvu Ezinkulu Ekuqaleni namagama aphelele ngezinhlamvu EZINKULU

Ngokuvamile uthayipha ama-acronym, noma amagama anezinhlamvu ezinkulu ukuze ugcizelele, ngenhloso. Izibonelo: ASAP, OFC, NOOO. Ukulungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo kushiya wonke amagama anezinhlamvu ezinkulu njengoba enjalo. Cisha lokhu ukuze ulungise lawa magama njenganoma yiliphi elinye igama.
Shiya amagama athayiphiwe ngezinhlamvu ezinkulu njengoba enjalo

Umugqa wesiphakamiso uvame ukugcina indawo eyodwa yegama njengoba ulithayiphile, okuyindlela ogcina ngayo isipelingi isichazamazwi esingasazi. Vula lokhu futhi leyo ndawo inikezwa esinye isiphakamiso esikhundleni salokho, ngakho zontathu zinikeza okuthile okusha. Izindleko wukuthi igama ikhibhodi engaliboni linendlela eyodwa encane yokusinda ekulungisweni, futhi umugqa awusakukhombisi ukuthi yimuphi umuntu oyinto ngqo oyibhalile.

Uma ithuluzi lingaphendula umbhalo owubhalile, umugqa wesiphakamiso unikeza impendulo esikhundleni samagama. Cindezela impendulo ukuze uthayiphe umphumela. Cindezela inkinobho engakwesokudla kwayo ukuze uvule ithuluzi eligcwele elinezinombolo ezifanayo kulo. Ikhibhodi ibona konke okudivayisi yakho. Ilanda kuphela amanani okushintshanisa, futhi kuphela ngemva kokuba uthayiphe inani ngemali ethile.
Phendula izibalo, ukuguqulwa kanye namagama angukhiye wamathuluzi emgqeni weziphakamiso
\"150 usd\", \"150$\" noma \"150 dollars\" inikeza inani ku-%1$s
\"ngoLwesihlanu oluzayo\" inikeza usuku oluwela kulo, nekhalenda elivulwe lapho

Njengoba uthayipha igama, uhlu lwamagama lubikezela izinhlamvu ezilandelayo. Ikhibhodi yenza indawo yokuthinta yokhiye ngamunye ibe nkulu kulezo zinhlamvu. Ukucindezela okufika ngaphakathi nje kokhiye olandelayo kusakunikeza uhlamvu obulufuna, kodwa eduze komphetho owabiwe kuphela. Ikhibhodi ayilokothi ishintshe ukucindezela phakathi nendawo yokhiye. Lokhu kusebenza kusendlalelo sezinhlamvu kuphela, futhi kudinga ukuthi Iziphakamiso zivuliwe.
Hambisa ukucindezela emaphethelweni okhiye uye encwadini okungenzeka ukuthi ubuyifuna
\"define serendipity\" inikeza isichazamazwi, \"who is Tesla\" inikeza i-Wikipedia
Landela ulimi oluthayiphwayo: I-South Asian ye-Bangla, isi-Hindi nezilimi eziseceleni kwazo, izinkulungwane kuyo yonke indawo
Amadijithi amathathu, bese kuba amabili: 12,34,567 kanye no-1,00,000

Inombolo enamadijithi amahlanu noma ngaphezulu, uma ithayiphiwe yodwa, inikezwa ngezihlukanisi. Izinombolo eziqala ngoziro ziyashiywa njengoba zinjalo, kanjalo nanoma yini ehlanganiswe nohlamvu, umugqa noma i-slash, ngoba lezo yizinombolo zocingo, izinsuku namakhodi kunokuba kube amanani.
Thayipha u-1234567 bese umugqa uwunikeza uqoqiwe. Ukucindezela okukodwa kuthayipha inombolo eqoqiwe

I-Android System Intelligence ingafunda ingxoxo esesikrinini futhi inikeze izimpendulo ezimfushane, njengokuthi \"Ngisendleleni!\". Izimpendulo zivela njengamachips eceleni kweziphakamiso zamagama, kufika kwezintathu ngesikhathi. Uhlelo luzidweba, hhayi ikhibhodi. Ziza ngomzila ofanayo namachips omphathi wephasiwedi, kodwa ziyabalwa futhi zishintshe ngokuhlukile kuzo. Ungaba nokungena ngemvume okulondoloziwe emgqeni weziphakamiso ngaphandle kokuthi uhlelo lufunde imiyalezo yakho, noma okuphambene nalokho. Imodi ye-Incognito icisha lokhu ngokwayo. Lesi silungiselelo sidinga i-Android 11 noma entsha, futhi izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithile kuphela ezinikeza izimpendulo.
Vumela isistimu inikeze izimpendulo kumlayezo owuphendulayo

Ithuluzi ngalinye linamagama angukhiye ambalwa. Thayipha igama elilodwa elingukhiye uwedwa bese umugqa wesiphakamiso unikeza ukuvula lelo thuluzi futhi ususe igama olithayiphile. Izilungiselelo zethuluzi ngalinye zibala amagama alo angukhiye, lapho ungawashintsha khona noma uwasuse.
Thayipha \"wiki\" bese umugqa unikeza ithuba lokuvula i-Wikipedia
Ithuluzi u-%1$s licishiwe, ngakho lezi zinkomba azinayo inkinobho yokulivula
Ithuluzi %1$s licishiwe, ngakho ama-chip alo awabonakali
Amathuluzi %1$s kanye %2$s avaliwe, ngakho ama-chip awo awabonakali
\"will it rain\" ikhombisa isibikezelo sezulu emgqeni. Idinga indawo yesimo sezulu

Lesi silungiselelo sivuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo. Ikhibhodi ithayipha isikhala ngemva kwegama elishelelayo, ukuze igama elilandelayo lingahlangani nalo. Ungashelela igama elilandelayo, noma ulithayiphe okhiye. Thayipha . , ? ! ; : noma ubakaki ovalayo ngokulandelayo, bese ikhibhodi isusa isikhala kuqala. Ukucindezela ibha yesikhala kubalwa njengesikhala esivele sikhona. I-Backspace isusa igama elishelelayo nesikhala salo ndawonye. Ikhibhodi ayengezi sikhala kuphasiwedi, ikheli le-imeyili, ikheli lewebhu, iphedi yezinombolo noma iphedi yefoni.
Engeza isikhala lapho uphakamisa umunwe wakho ekupheleni kokuslayida

Lesi silungiselelo sivuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo. Uma ucindezela isiphakamiso, ikhibhodi ithayipha igama nesikhala ngemva kwalo, ukuze igama elilandelayo liqale lihlanzekile. Sivala ukuze uthayiphe igama ngaphandle kwesikhala. Lokhu kusiza ezilimini noma ezinkundleni lapho isikhala ngemva kwegama ngokuvamile singalungile. Uma ubuyela egameni futhi uliqhuba, ikhibhodi ayikaze yengeze isikhala sesibili.
Engeza isikhala uma ukhetha igama emgqeni weziphakamiso

Lesi silungiselelo sishintsha ukuswayipha kwebha yesikhala kusebenze njenge-touchpad. Isikhombisi sihamba kwesobunxele nakwesokudla, futhi ukuswayiphela phezulu noma phansi kuhambisa isikhombisi phakathi kwemigqa. Lokhu kusebenza kuphela ezenzweni zokuswayipha ezisethwe kokuthi \"Isikhombisi\" ngenhla.
Ukuhlephula kwesikhombisi nakho kuhamba phezulu naphansi

Ibanga elincane lihambisa isikhombisi ngokushesha, ngakho ibha yesikhala emfushane isengawela umugqa omude. Elikhulu lizinzile uma amaslayidi akho ethambekele ekudluleleni. Lesi silungiselelo singu-16 dp ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Ukuthi uslayida kude kangakanani kubha yesikhala ukuze uhambise uhlamvu olulodwa

Gcina umunwe wakho phansi. Swayipha igama, swayipha phezu kwebha yesikhala, bese uswayipha igama elilandelayo. Ukunyakaza ngakunye kubhala igama nesikhala, ngakho ukunyakaza okukodwa kunikeza umusho ogcwele. Uma lesi silungiselelo sivaliwe, ukuswayipha phezu kwebha yesikhala kwenza igama elilodwa.
Swayipha phezu kwebha yesikhala ukuze uqhubeke negama elilandelayo

Thayipha izinhlamvu ozifunayo kubha yesikhala ngokucindezela isikhathi eside, nesikhala phakathi kwenhlamu ngayinye. Isibonelo: 🙂 ❤️ 👍. Ikhibhodi bese ibabonisa ku-popup uma ucindezela ubambe ibha yesikhala. Shiya lokhu kungenalutho ukuze ugcine ukucindezela isikhathi eside okujwayelekile, okuvula isikhethi solimi noma okuphinda izikhala.
Okhiye bokucindezela isikhathi eside kubha yesikhala

Cindezela uphinde ubambe ibha yesikhala ngemuva kokulibaziseka kokubamba, bese uswayipha. Lokhu kunika ibha yesikhala isenzo sesibili nesihlukile sokuswayipha. Isibonelo: ukuswayipha ngokushesha kushintsha ulimi, nokucindezela nokubamba ngokuswayipha kuhambisa isikhombi. Ungaphinda usethe kokubili ukuba kwenze isenzo esifanayo.
Cindezela ubambe ibha yesikhala, bese uswayipha

Slayida kwesobunxele noma kwesokudla kubha yesikhala ngaphandle kokuphumula. \"Ulimi\" luhamba ngezindlela zakho zokufaka, ngokubuka kuqala okubukhoma ngaphezu kwebha yesikhala. Phakamisa umunwe wakho ukuze ushintshe. Cindezela ubambe ibha yesikhala ukuze ubonise isikhethi ngaphambi kokuslayida. \"Isikhombisi\" sihambisa isikhombisi sombhalo uhlamvu olulodwa ngesinyathelo ngasinye. Ukucindezela ngaphandle kokunyakaza kuhlale kuthayipha isikhala.

Swayiphela phansi ngqo kubha yesikhala (spacebar) ukuze uvale ikhibhodi. Lesi silungiselelo sivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo, ngakho ukuswayipha phansi ngephutha akusoze kwavala ikhibhodi. Uma i-touchpad yekhesa ye-2-D ivuliwe, ukuswayipha phansi kuhambisa ikhesa esikhundleni salokho. I-touchpad inokubaluleka kokuqala.
Ukuswayipha phansi kubha yesikhala kuvala ikhibhodi

Ulimi lubonisa igama lolimi lwamanje. Isakhiwo sibonisa igama lesakhiwo samanje. Zombili zibonisa \"Ulimi (Isakhiwo)\". Uma ulimi olulodwa lunokwedlula isakhiwo esisodwa, ikhibhodi yengeza igama lesakhiwo, ukuze ubone umehluko.

Ikhibhodi idweba u-◀ no-▶ omncane ohlangothini ngalunye lwegama lolimi kubha yesikhala. Ayisikiselo nje, futhi ukuswayipha kusebenza ngaphandle kwawo. Ahlala efihliwe ngenkathi imodi eyodwa yokufaka ivuliwe.
Shiya lokhu kungenalutho ukuze ugcine ilebula yebha yesikhala evamile. Thayipha u-%1$s ukuze ubeke leyo lebula embhalweni wakho. Isibonelo: ~ %1$s ~

Okokuqala, igama elide liyancipha ukuze lingene endaweni yalo. Uma lisemide kakhulu, ikhibhodi isusa ezinye izinhlamvu bese ibonisa amachashazi (…) esikhundleni sazo. Phakathi kugcina isiqalo nesiphetho segama, isibonelo \"Punct…tion\". Amakhibhodi amaningi enza lokhu. Ekugcineni kugcina isiqalo kuphela, isibonelo \"Punctuat…\". Lesi silungiselelo asinawo umphumela ngenkathi Ukuskrola iziphakamiso kuvuliwe, ngoba igama ngalinye ligcina usayizi walo ogcwele.
Lapho ungasika khona igama elingalingani esikhaleni salo

Ngokuvamile umugqa uhlukanisa ububanzi bawo ngokulinganayo futhi unciphise amagama amade ukuze alingane nesikhala sawo. Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, wonke amagama agcina usayizi wawo wemvelo futhi umugqa upheqa eceleni esikhundleni salokho. Amagama amafushane asagcwalisa umugqa njengakuqala, ngakho akukho okushintshayo kuze kube yilapho igama lidlula umkhawulo. Yivule uma ufuna iziphakamiso ezinhlanu noma eziyisithupha ocingweni oluncane. Lesi silungiselelo sivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Bonisa igama ngalinye ngosayizi ogcwele bese upheqa umugqa eceleni uma lingalingani

Umugqa uhlukanisa ububanzi bawo ngokulinganayo phakathi kweziphakamiso, ngakho-ke okuningi kwazo kusho ukuthi ngasinye sincane futhi amagama amade ancishiswa kakhulu ukuze alingane. Okuthathu kufanele ifoni. Ithebhulethi noma isikrini se-landscape sinendawo eyengeziwe. Lesi silungiselelo singu-3 ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Mangaki amagama umugqa wesiphakamiso owakhombisayo ngesikhathi esisodwa

Ezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza, njenge-Instagram ne-Google Keep, zitshela ikhibhodi ukuthi ifihle umugqa weziphakamiso ezinkambini zombhalo ezijwayelekile. Lesi silungiselelo sivuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo, futhi ikhibhodi ibonisa umugqa noma kunjalo, njengoba kwenza izikhibhodi eziningi. Sivala ukuze ulandele uhlelo lokusebenza futhi ufihle umugqa. Ukulungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo, ukuthayipha ngokuslayida kanye nokubhala ngesi-Bengali (Avro) kusebenza nganoma iyiphi indlela, ngoba akusancikile emugqeni. Izinkambu zephasiwedi namaphedi ezinombolo azikaze zibonise iziphakamiso.
Bonisa umugqa weziphakamiso ngisho nalapho uhlelo lokusebenza lucela ukuthi ufihlwe

Ngokuvamile ibha engaphezulu ikhombisa ibha yamathuluzi, futhi ishintshela eziphakamisweni kuphela uma kukhona amagama angaba khona. Ngalolu lungiselelo oluvuliwe, ibha engaphezulu ikhombisa umugqa weziphakamiso uma ungasebenzi, ngakho izibikezelo zegama elilandelayo zihlala zibonakala. Umcibisholo ongakwesobunxele uvula ibha yamathuluzi uma udinga ithuluzi.
Gcina umugqa weziphakamiso ubonakala ngaphambi kokuba uthayiphe

Ikhibhodi ikhombisa iziphakamiso ezintathu ngenhla kwezinkinobho ngenkathi uthayipha: ukuqedela amagama, ukulungisa amaphutha, nokubikezela igama elilandelayo. Ikhibhodi ifunda izibikezelo ekuthayipheni kwakho. Cindezela isiphakamiso ukuze usithayiphe nesikhala ngemva kwaso.

Lokhu ukunyakaza komunwe okushintsha ukucindezela kube ukuslayida. Kuyisiphindaphindi sokuthinta kwesistimu. Inani eliphansi liqala ukuslayida ngokushesha futhi lizwela kakhulu, kodwa ukucindezela okunganyakazi kungaqala ukuslayida. Inani eliphezulu lidinga ukuswayipha okucabangisisiwe.
Kude kangakanani okufanele uhambe ngaphambi kokuba ukuslayida kuqale. Inani eliphansi lizwela kakhulu

Ikhibhodi ilinganisa ukuthi uthayipha ngokushesha kangakanani igama ngalinye. Uma uthayipha ngokushesha, amaphutha okuthayipha maningi, ngakho ukulungisa okuzenzakalelayo kusebenza ngentshiseko eyengeziwe. Uma uthayipha kancane nangokucophelela, ngegama elingajwayelekile noma igama elivela kolunye ulimi, ukulungisa okuzenzakalelayo kuyabambezeleka. Isilayidi sibeka ukuthi isigqi sithonya kanjani isinqumo. Uziro uyayicisha isignali.
Vumela isivinini sakho sokuthayipha sithonye ukulungisa okuzenzakalelayo
Isikhathi eside kangakanani umkhondo uhlala ngemuva komunwe wakho

Cindezela i-backspace ngokushesha ngemva kokuba ukulungisa okuzenzakalelayo kushintshe igama. Ikhibhodi ibuyisela isipelingi sakho sokuqala futhi iyasifunda, ngakho ngeke ilungise lelo gama futhi. Vala lokhu ukuze i-backspace ihlale isusa uhlamvu olulodwa.
Ukucindezela i-backspace ngemva kokulungiswa kubuyisela lokho okubhale

Ukucindezela okungemuva (backspace) kuhlehlisa ukulungiswa okwenzeke ngaleso sikhathi kuphela. Thayipha uhlamvu olulodwa olwengeziwe bese ukulungiswa sekungasatholakali, futhi yilapho uvame ukukubona khona. Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, ikhibhodi ibeka ithiphu ekuqaleni komugqa weziphakamiso enesipelingi sakho kuyo. Cindezela ithiphu bese ikhibhodi ibuyisela lelo gama, futhi ifunde ukungaphindi ukwenza ukulungiswa okufanayo. Ithiphu ivela phakathi kwamagama futhi ihlala kuze kube yilapho uqeda umusho. Akuyona yonke imilungiso ethola eyodwa. Izilungiselelo ezingezansi zisho ukuthi yimiphi imilungiso eyenzayo.

Izilungiso eziningi azidingi ukuhlehliswa. Ikhibhodi ibiqinisekile, ushintsho luncane, futhi ungabona okwenzekile. I-chip ngemva kwesilungiso ngasinye iyaphazamisa, futhi ufunda ukungayinaki. Lesi silungiselelo sibeka umkhawulo. Ikhibhodi ilinganisa isilungiso ngasinye ngezinto ezimbili. Eyokuqala ukuthi ikhibhodi ibiqiniseke kangakanani. Eyesibili ukuthi igama elisha likude kangakanani nalokho okuthayiphile. Igama elifushane elinohlamvu olulodwa oluseduze olushintshiwe lithola amaphuzu aphezulu. Ukuqagela, noma igama elihlukaniswe kabili, lithola amaphuzu aphansi. Isilungiso esithola amaphuzu angaphansi kwalo mkhawulo sithola i-chip. Kusilungiselelo esiphansi kakhulu cishe asikho isilungiso esithola i-chip. Kusilungiselelo esiphakeme kakhulu zonke izilungiso ziyayithola.
Isilungiselelo esiphakeme sibeka i-chip ekulungiseni okuningi

Uma uhlehlisa ukulungiswa, ikhibhodi ikhumbula leyo mbhangqwana yamagama eqondile futhi iyeka ukwenza ukulungiswa okufanayo. Lesi silungiselelo sisho ukuthi ikhibhodi iyigcina isikhathi esingakanani leyo nkumbulo. Ikhibhodi ifunda ukuhlehlisa ngezindlela ezimbili. I-Backspace, ecindezelwe ngemva nje kokulungiswa, iwukuhlehlisa okucacile. Ikhibhodi iphinde ihlole umbhalo kamuva, futhi ikubala njengokuhlehlisa lapho isipelingi sakho simi lapho kwakukhona ukulungiswa khona. Ukufunda kwesibili kubuthakathaka. Ungabuyela emuva ukuze ulungise iphutha lokuthayipha ngesandla ngaphandle kokubona ukuthi ikhibhodi isivele ililungisile, bese uthayipha iphutha elifanayo futhi. Kuwo wonke amazinga ngaphandle kwe-Strict, ikhibhodi ikuziba lokho kufunda kwesibili lapho isipelingi sakho singelona igama elikwaziyo.
Ukulungiswa okuhlehlisayo kudinga ukuzethemba okwengeziwe ukuze kusetshenziswe futhi. Ikhibhodi ayilokothi iyimise unomphela
Ukuhlehlisa okukodwa kumisa ukulungiswa kokuphumula komlayezo. Okubili kukumisa unomphela, futhi ikhibhodi ikubuza ngakho kanye futhi ngemva kwesikhathi eside sokuthula
Ikhibhodi ikhohlwa ukuhlehlisa ngaso leso sikhathi futhi ilungisa igama futhi ngokuzayo
Ukuhlehlisa kokuqala kumisa ukulungiswa unomphela, futhi ikhibhodi ayisabuzi ngakho futhi
Ukuthi ukulungiswa okuhlehlisayo kuhlala isikhathi esingakanani kungalungisiwe

Ngenkathi ikhibhodi ivuliwe, ukwehlisa ivolumu kuhambisa isikhombisi uhlamvu olulodwa kwesobunxele, futhi ukukhulisa ivolumu kukuhambisa uhlamvu olulodwa kwesokudla. Cindezela ubambe ukhiye ukuze uphinde. Kuyo yonke indawo, futhi ngokushesha nje lapho ikhibhodi ivaleka, okhiye bevolumu basebenza njengokujwayelekile.
